import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const handle = searchParams.get('handle')?.trim();

  if (!handle) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pseudo manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const user = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1) LIMIT 1",
      [handle]
    );
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 404 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    // On sÃ©curise chaque requÃªte pour Ã©viter qu'une table manquante ne fasse planter tout le profil
    let totalSealed = 0, totalHosted = 0, totalSize = 0;
    try {
      const stats = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(id) as total_sealed, SUM(CASE WHEN is_hosted = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_hosted, SUM(file_size) as total_size FROM seals WHERE author_id = $1`, [userId]);
      totalSealed = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_sealed || 0);
      totalHosted = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_hosted || 0);
      totalSize = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_size || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Stats error:', e.message); }

    let seals = [];
    try {
      const sealsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.timestamp, s.visibility, s.is_flash, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, encode(s.hash, 'base64') as hash,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE seal_id = s.id) as likes_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE seal_id = s.id) as comments_count
        FROM seals s WHERE s.author_id = $1 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      seals = sealsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Seals error:', e.message); }

    let totalPacts = 0;
    try {
      const pacts = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pacts FROM pact_signatures WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
      totalPacts = parseInt(pacts.rows[0].total_pacts || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Pacts error:', e.message); }

    let friendsCount = 0;
    try {
      const friendsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = $1 OR addressee_id = $1) AND status = 'accepted'`, [userId]);
      friendsCount = parseInt(friendsRes.rows[0].count || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Friends error:', e.message); }

    let projects = [];
    try {
      const projectsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.merkle_root, p.created_at, p.ots_proof,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_files WHERE project_id = p.id) as files_count
        FROM projects p WHERE p.author_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      projects = projectsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Projects error:', e.message); }

    let favorites = [];
    try {
      const favoritesQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
        FROM favorites f JOIN seals s ON f.seal_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      favorites = favoritesQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Favorites error:', e.message); }

    let streak = 0;
    try {
      const uniqueDatesSet = new Set(seals.map((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0]));
      let cursor = new Date();
      cursor.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if (!uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
      while (uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) { streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

    const badges = [];
    if (totalSealed >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸŒ±', name: 'Apprenti', desc: 'PremiÃ¨re Å“uvre scellÃ©e' });
    if (totalSealed >= 10) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‰', name: 'Archiviste', desc: '10 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (totalSealed >= 50) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‡', name: 'Gardien', desc: '50 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (isPro) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ‘‘', name: 'PRO', desc: 'Compte vÃ©rifiÃ© PRO' });
    if (streak >= 3) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ”¥', name: 'En Feu', desc: '3 jours consÃ©cutifs' });
    if (totalPacts >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¤', name: 'NÃ©gociateur', desc: 'A signÃ© un pacte' });

    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle, bio: user.rows[0].bio,
      open_to_collaboration: user.rows[0].open_to_collaboration || false,
      first_name: user.rows[0].first_name, last_name: user.rows[0].last_name, birth_date: user.rows[0].birth_date,
      role: user.rows[0].role, is_pro: isPro, streak: streak, favorites: favorites,
      sealed: totalSealed, hosted: totalHosted, used_bytes: totalSize,
      friends_count: friendsCount, pacts: totalPacts, badges: badges, seals: seals, projects: projects
    });
  } catch (error: any) { 
    console.error("[api/profil]", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 }); 
  }
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ArchivePage() {
  const [archives, setArchives] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isPro, setIsPro] = useState(false);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(3);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedDiff, setSelectedDiff] = useState<any>(null);

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  const loadArchives = async () => {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) { setArchives(d.archives || []); setIsPro(d.is_pro); setLimit(d.limit); }
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadArchives(); }, [pubkey]);

  async function handleAdd() {
    if (!url || !pubkey) return;
    setAdding(true); setError('');
    const res = await fetch('/api/archive', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url }) });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) setError(d.error);
    else { setUrl(''); loadArchives(); }
    setAdding(false);
  }

  async function checkUrl(id: string) {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    setChecking(id);
    const res = await fetch('/api/archive', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url: id, action: 'check' }) });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      if (d.status === 'modified') alert(`Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e ! ${d.changes} changements trouvÃ©s.`);
      loadArchives();
    } else alert(d.error);
    setChecking(null);
  }

  async function deleteUrl(id: string) {
    if (!pubkey || !confirm('Supprimer cette surveillance ?')) return;
    await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}&id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    loadArchives();
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto font-sans w-full min-h-screen">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-serif mb-2" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>SCEAU Archive</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">Surveillez l'intÃ©gritÃ© des sites web. DÃ©tectez les modifications en un clic.</p>
        </div>
        <a href="/downloads/sceau-extension.zip" download className="bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:border-[#E76F51] transition shadow-sm hidden md:block">TÃ©lÃ©charger l'Extension Chrome</a>
        {!isPro && (
          <div className="bg-[#FDF4F0] border border-[#FCE0D6] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-right hidden md:block">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#C44A2E]">Quota Gratuit</p>
            <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-[#C44A2E]">{archives.length} / {limit} URLs</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mb-8">
        <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2 font-mono uppercase">Ajouter une URL Ã  surveiller</label>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input type="url" placeholder="https://www.concurrent.com" className="flex-1 border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl bg-transparent outline-none focus:border-[#4A90C2]" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={url} onChange={e => setUrl(e.target.value)} />
          <button onClick={handleAdd} disabled={adding || (!isPro && archives.length >= limit)} className="bg-[#1A1513] text-white px-6 rounded-xl font-bold disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-black transition">{adding ? '...' : 'Sceller'}</button>
        </div>
        {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm font-bold mt-2">{error}</p>}
        {!isPro && archives.length >= limit && (
          <p className="text-sm text-[#C44A2E] mt-3 font-bold">âš ï¸ Limite de 3 URLs atteinte. <button onClick={() => alert("SCEAU PRO arrive bientÃ´t !")} className="underline">Passez Ã  PRO</button> pour en ajouter plus.</p>

      {loading ? (

      ) : (
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm">
          {archives.map((a, i) => (
            <div key={a.id} className={`flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between p-4 ${i !== archives.length - 1 ? 'border-b border-[var(--border-color)]' : ''} ${a.last_status === 'modified' ? 'bg-[#FDF4F0]' : ''}`}>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3 md:mb-0">
                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${a.last_status === 'modified' ? 'bg-red-500' : a.last_status === 'error' ? 'bg-orange-500' : 'bg-green-500'}`}></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-bold text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{a.title || a.url}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate max-w-[300px]">{a.url}</p>
                  {a.last_status === 'modified' && <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-red-600 font-bold uppercase mt-1">Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e</p>}

              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {a.diff_data && (
                  <button onClick={() => setSelectedDiff(a.diff_data)} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-gray-50 transition shadow-sm">Voir le Diff</button>
                )}
                <span className="text-[0.65rem] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] mr-2 hidden sm:block">VÃ©rifiÃ© le {new Date(a.last_checked_at).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</span>
                <button onClick={() => checkUrl(a.id)} disabled={checking === a.id} className="bg-[#F0F6FC] text-[#2D6A9E] border border-[#C9D8E8] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#E0EDF8] transition">{checking === a.id ? 'Scan...' : 'VÃ©rifier'}</button>

  -not -name '*.zip' \
  -not -name '*.ico' \
  -not -name '*.png' \
  -not -name '*.jpg' \

  | sort | while read -r f; do
    echo ""
    echo "========================================="
    echo "FICHIER : $f"

    echo ""
    cat "$f"
  done > sceau_full_code.txt

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

const MAX_PAGES = 10;

function isSafeUrl(urlString: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(urlString);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    const h = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1') return false;
    if (/^10\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

function extractInternalLinks(html: string, baseUrl: string): string[] {
  const links: Set<string> = new Set();
  const regex = /<a[^>]+href=["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
  let match;
  const base = new URL(baseUrl);
  while ((match = regex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(match[1], baseUrl);
      if (url.hostname === base.hostname && url.protocol.startsWith('http')) {
        url.hash = '';
        links.add(url.toString());
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return Array.from(links);
}

async function fetchSitemap(siteRoot: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${siteRoot}/sitemap.xml`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const xml = await res.text();
    const matches = xml.match(/<loc>([^<]+)<\/loc>/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => m.replace(/<\/?loc>/g, '').trim()).slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
  } catch { return []; }
}

async function scanPage(url: string): Promise<{ text: string; hash: string } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      redirect: 'follow',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const html = await res.text();
    if (html.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    const text = cleanHtmlToText(html);
    const hash = Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text))).toString('hex');
    return { text, hash };
  } catch { return null; }
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const o = oldLines[i] || '';
    const n = newLines[i] || '';
    if (o !== n) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: o.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: n.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (o.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: o.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, url, site_root, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data, pages_scanned, scan_count, ai_summary
      FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: result.rows, 
      is_pro: user.rows[0].is_pro,
      limit: user.rows[0].is_pro ? 50 : 3
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    const countQuery = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
    const currentCount = parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? 50 : 3;

    if (currentCount >= maxLimit && action !== 'check') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} sites max).` }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // === VÃ‰RIFICATION (scan manuel) ===
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, url, site_root, last_hash, last_content FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
        [url, userId]
      );
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const siteRoot = archive.rows[0].site_root || new URL(targetUrl).origin;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;
      const oldContent = archive.rows[0].last_content || '';

      const scan = await scanPage(targetUrl);
      if (!scan) {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'error', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = scan_count + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: 'Impossible de vÃ©rifier le site.' });
      }

      if (oldHash !== scan.hash) {
        const diffResult = generateDiff(oldContent, scan.text);
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE web_archives 
           SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, 
               last_hash = $2, last_content = $3, scan_count = scan_count + 1 
           WHERE id = $4`,
          [JSON.stringify(diffResult), scan.hash, scan.text, url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified', changes: diffResult.changesCount });
      } else {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = scan_count + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // === AJOUT D'UN SITE (crawl complet) ===
    if (!isSafeUrl(url)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide ou non autorisÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(url);
    const siteRoot = `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}`;

    // DÃ©couvre les pages Ã  scanner
    let pages: string[] = [];
    const sitemapPages = await fetchSitemap(siteRoot);
    if (sitemapPages.length > 0) {
      pages = sitemapPages;
    } else {
      const rootHtml = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      }).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : null).catch(() => null);

      if (!rootHtml) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site.' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const internalLinks = extractInternalLinks(rootHtml, url);
      pages = [url, ...internalLinks.filter(l => l !== url)].slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
    }

    // Scanne les pages en parallÃ¨le
    const scanResults = await Promise.all(pages.map(p => scanPage(p)));
    const validResults = scanResults.filter((r, i): r is { text: string; hash: string } => r !== null);
    
    if (validResults.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Aucune page n\'a pu Ãªtre scannÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // CrÃ©e une entrÃ©e par page
    for (let i = 0; i < validResults.length; i++) {
      const pageUrl = pages[i];
      const pageData = validResults[i];
      const title = new URL(pageUrl).pathname || '/';
      
      await pool.query(`
        INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, site_root, title, last_hash, last_content, last_status, pages_scanned, scan_count)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'intact', $7, 1)
      `, [userId, pageUrl, siteRoot, title, pageData.hash, pageData.text, validResults.length]);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      pages_scanned: validResults.length,
      site_root: siteRoot,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[archive POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

'use client';

export default function ArchiveDetail() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [archive, setArchive] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState(false);

  const loadArchive = async () => {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) { router.replace('/login'); return; }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      const found = (d.archives || []).find((a: any) => a.id === params.id);
      if (found) setArchive(found);
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadArchive(); }, [params.id]);

  async function runCheck() {
    if (!archive) return;
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return;

    setChecking(true);

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

const MAX_PAGES = 10;
const FREE_LIMIT = 5;  // Sites gratuits (pas pages)
const PRO_LIMIT = 50;

function isSafeUrl(urlString: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(urlString);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    const h = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1') return false;
    if (/^10\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

function extractPageTitle(html: string, fallbackUrl: string): string {
  // Cherche <title>...</title>
  const titleMatch = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  if (titleMatch && titleMatch[1]) {
    const clean = titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 200) return clean;
  }
  // Cherche <h1>...</h1>
  const h1Match = html.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);
  if (h1Match && h1Match[1]) {
    const clean = h1Match[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 100) return clean;
  }
  // Fallback : hostname + pathname
  try {
    const u = new URL(fallbackUrl);
    if (u.pathname === '/' || u.pathname === '') return u.hostname;
    return `${u.hostname}${u.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return fallbackUrl;
  }
}

function extractInternalLinks(html: string, baseUrl: string): string[] {
  const links: Set<string> = new Set();
  const regex = /<a[^>]+href=["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
  let match;
  const base = new URL(baseUrl);
  while ((match = regex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(match[1], baseUrl);
      if (url.hostname === base.hostname && url.protocol.startsWith('http')) {
        url.hash = '';
        url.search = ''; // ignore query strings pour Ã©viter les doublons
        links.add(url.toString());
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return Array.from(links);
}

async function fetchSitemap(siteRoot: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${siteRoot}/sitemap.xml`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const xml = await res.text();
    const matches = xml.match(/<loc>([^<]+)<\/loc>/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => m.replace(/<\/?loc>/g, '').trim()).slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
  } catch { return []; }
}

async function scanPage(url: string): Promise<{ text: string; hash: string; title: string } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      redirect: 'follow',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const html = await res.text();
    if (html.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    const text = cleanHtmlToText(html);
    const hash = Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text))).toString('hex');
    const title = extractPageTitle(html, url);
    return { text, hash, title };
  } catch { return null; }
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const o = oldLines[i] || '';
    const n = newLines[i] || '';
    if (o !== n) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: o.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: n.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (o.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: o.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    // RÃ©cupÃ¨re toutes les pages, puis regroupe par site_root cÃ´tÃ© serveur
    let pages;
    try {
      pages = await pool.query(`
        SELECT id, url, site_root, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data, pages_scanned, scan_count, ai_summary
        FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
    } catch (colErr) {
      // Fallback si colonnes manquantes
      pages = await pool.query(`
        SELECT id, url, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data
        FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
    }

    // Regroupement par site_root (site principal)
    const sitesMap = new Map<string, any>();
    for (const page of pages.rows) {
      const siteRoot = page.site_root || (() => {
        try { return new URL(page.url).origin; } catch { return page.url; }
      })();
      
      if (!sitesMap.has(siteRoot)) {
        sitesMap.set(siteRoot, {
          site_root: siteRoot,
          main_id: page.id,          // la page principale (premiÃ¨re = l'URL ajoutÃ©e)
          main_title: page.site_root === null ? page.title : null, // Ã  remplir
          main_url: page.url,
          pages_count: 0,
          last_checked_at: page.last_checked_at,
          created_at: page.created_at,
          scan_count: page.scan_count || 1,
          has_modifications: false,
          pages: [],
        });
      }
      
      const site = sitesMap.get(siteRoot);
      site.pages_count++;
      site.pages.push(page);
      
      // Le main_id doit Ãªtre celui de la page racine (pathname === '/')
      try {
        const u = new URL(page.url);
        if (u.pathname === '/' || u.pathname === '') {
          site.main_id = page.id;
          site.main_title = page.title;
          site.main_url = page.url;
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
      
      if (page.last_status === 'modified') site.has_modifications = true;
      if (new Date(page.last_checked_at) > new Date(site.last_checked_at)) {
        site.last_checked_at = page.last_checked_at;
      }
    }

    // Si le titre principal n'a pas Ã©tÃ© trouvÃ©, fallback sur le hostname
    for (const site of sitesMap.values()) {
      if (!site.main_title) {
        try { site.main_title = new URL(site.site_root).hostname; }
        catch { site.main_title = site.site_root; }
      }
    }

    const sitesArray = Array.from(sitesMap.values());

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: sitesArray, 
      is_pro: isPro,
      limit: isPro ? PRO_LIMIT : FREE_LIMIT,
      total_sites: sitesArray.length,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[archive GET]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    // === VÃ‰RIFICATION (action 'check') ===
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, url, last_hash, last_content FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
        [url, userId]
      );
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;
      const oldContent = archive.rows[0].last_content || '';

      const scan = await scanPage(targetUrl);
      if (!scan) {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'error', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error' });
      }

      if (oldHash !== scan.hash) {
        const diffResult = generateDiff(oldContent, scan.text);
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE web_archives 
           SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, 
               last_hash = $2, last_content = $3, scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 
           WHERE id = $4`,
          [JSON.stringify(diffResult), scan.hash, scan.text, url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified', changes: diffResult.changesCount });
      } else {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // === AJOUT D'UN NOUVEAU SITE ===
    if (!isSafeUrl(url)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide ou non autorisÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(url);
    const siteRoot = `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}`;

    // COMPTAGE PAR SITE (pas par page) : combien de sites distincts ?
    const sitesCountQuery = await pool.query(
      "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT site_root) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root IS NOT NULL",
      [userId]
    );
    const sitesCount = parseInt(sitesCountQuery.rows[0].count || 0);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? PRO_LIMIT : FREE_LIMIT;

    // VÃ©rifie si ce site existe dÃ©jÃ 
    const existingSite = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root = $2 LIMIT 1",
      [userId, siteRoot]
    );

    if (existingSite.rows.length === 0 && sitesCount >= maxLimit) {
      return NextResponse.json({ 
        error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} sites max). Passez Ã  SCEAU PRO pour en ajouter plus.` 
      }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Si le site existe dÃ©jÃ , on ajoute juste les nouvelles pages
    // Sinon, on crawle comme d'habitude

    let pages: string[] = [];
    const sitemapPages = await fetchSitemap(siteRoot);
    if (sitemapPages.length > 0) {
      pages = sitemapPages;
    } else {
      const rootHtml = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      }).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : null).catch(() => null);

      if (!rootHtml) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site.' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const internalLinks = extractInternalLinks(rootHtml, url);
      pages = [url, ...internalLinks.filter(l => l !== url)].slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
    }

    const scanResults = await Promise.all(pages.map(p => scanPage(p)));
    
    let insertedCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
      const pageUrl = pages[i];
      const pageData = scanResults[i];
      if (!pageData) continue;
      
      // VÃ©rifie si cette page existe dÃ©jÃ 
      const existing = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND url = $2",
        [userId, pageUrl]
      );
      
      if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
        await pool.query(`
          INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, site_root, title, last_hash, last_content, last_status, pages_scanned, scan_count)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'intact', $7, 1)
        `, [userId, pageUrl, siteRoot, pageData.title, pageData.hash, pageData.text, pages.length]);
        insertedCount++;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      pages_scanned: insertedCount,
      total_pages: pages.length,
      site_root: siteRoot,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[archive POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur serveur.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    // Si c'est un site entier, on supprime toutes ses pages
    const site = await pool.query(
      "SELECT site_root FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
      [id, user.rows[0].id]
    );
    
    if (site.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

    if (site.rows[0].site_root) {
      await pool.query(
        "DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root = $2",
        [user.rows[0].id, site.rows[0].site_root]
      );
    } else {
      await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ArchivePage() {
  const [sites, setSites] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isPro, setIsPro] = useState(false);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(5);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  const loadArchives = async () => {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        setSites(d.archives || []);
        setIsPro(d.is_pro);
        setLimit(d.limit || 5);
      }
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadArchives(); }, [pubkey]);

  async function handleAdd() {
    if (!url || !pubkey) return;
    setAdding(true); setError('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/archive', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url })
      });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) setError(d.error || 'Erreur');
      else { setUrl(''); loadArchives(); }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Erreur rÃ©seau');
    }
    setAdding(false);
  }

  return (

        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-serif mb-2" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>SCEAU Archive</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">Surveillez l'intÃ©gritÃ© des sites web. DÃ©tectez les modifications en un clic.</p>
        </div>
        <a 
          href="/downloads/sceau-extension.zip" 
          download 
          className="bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:border-[#E76F51] transition shadow-sm hidden md:block"
        >
          TÃ©lÃ©charger l'Extension Chrome
        </a>
      </div>

      {/* Quota */}
      {!isPro && (
        <div className="bg-[#FDF4F0] border border-[#FCE0D6] rounded-xl px-4 py-2 mb-6 inline-block">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#C44A2E]">
            Quota Gratuit : {sites.length} / {limit} sites
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Formulaire */}
      <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mb-8">
        <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2 font-mono uppercase">
          Ajouter un site Ã  surveiller
        </label>
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2">
          <input 
            type="url" 
            placeholder="https://www.exemple.com" 
            className="flex-1 min-w-0 border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl bg-transparent outline-none focus:border-[#4A90C2]"
            style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}
            value={url}
            onChange={e => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && handleAdd()}
          />
          <button 
            onClick={handleAdd} 
            disabled={adding || (!isPro && sites.length >= limit)}
            className="bg-[#1A1513] text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-black transition whitespace-nowrap"
          >
            {adding ? '...' : 'Sceller'}
          </button>
        </div>
        {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm font-bold mt-2">{error}</p>}
        {!isPro && sites.length >= limit && (
          <p className="text-sm text-[#C44A2E] mt-3 font-bold">

          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Liste groupÃ©e */}
      {loading ? (
        <p className="text-center font-mono py-10">Chargement...</p>

            >
              <Link href={`/archive/${s.main_id}`} className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3 md:mb-0 flex-1 min-w-0">

  const [site, setSite] = useState<any>(null);

  const loadArchive = async () => {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      const found = (d.archives || []).find((s: any) => s.main_id === params.id || s.pages.some((p: any) => p.id === params.id));
      if (found) {
        setSite(found);
        const page = found.pages.find((p: any) => p.id === params.id) || found.pages.find((p: any) => p.url === found.main_url) || found.pages[0];

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ activities: [] });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ activities: [] });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT 
        a.action,
        a.context,
        a.created_at,
        u.handle as viewer_handle,
        u.created_at as viewer_created_at,
        s.title as seal_title,
        s.id as seal_id
      FROM access_log a
      JOIN seals s ON a.seal_id = s.id
      JOIN users u ON a.viewer_id = u.id
      WHERE s.author_id = $1
      ORDER BY a.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 5
    `, [userId]);

    const activities = res.rows.map((r: any) => {
      const daysOld = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(r.viewer_created_at).getTime()) / 86400000);
      return {
        action: r.action,
        context: r.context,
        viewer: r.viewer_handle,
        seal_title: r.seal_title,
        seal_id: r.seal_id,
        created_at: r.created_at,
        is_new_account: daysOld < 7,
        days_old: daysOld,
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ activities });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ activities: [] });
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

# ==========================================================
# 1. Correction de l'API Projects (Hash reÃ§u, pas calculÃ©)
# ==========================================================
say "1/3 â†’ Correction API /api/projects (Hash client)"

cat > "src/app/api/projects/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { submitToOts } from '@/lib/ots';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';
import { safeKeyPart } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { apiError } from '@/lib/api-error';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const title = ((data.get('title') as string) || '').trim();
    const description = ((data.get('description') as string) || '').trim();
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const isHosted = data.get('isHosted') !== 'false';
    const merkleRoot = data.get('merkle_root') as string;
    const manifestStr = data.get('manifest') as string; // JSON array of {name, hash, size}
    const files = (data.getAll('files') as File[]).filter((f) => f && f.size > 0);

    if (!title) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Titre requis' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!merkleRoot || !manifestStr) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Manifest Merkle manquant' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const authorId = user.rows[0].id;

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestStr) as { name: string; hash: string; size: number }[];

    // 1. VÃ‰RIFICATION : On s'assure que le Root fourni correspond aux hashs
    const calculatedRoot = buildMerkleRoot(manifest.map(m => m.hash));
    if (calculatedRoot !== merkleRoot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'IncohÃ©rence cryptographique (Merkle)' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // 2. Ancrage OTS
    let otsProof: string | null = null;
    try {
      const ots = await submitToOts(new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(merkleRoot, 'base64')));
      if (ots.ok && ots.proof) otsProof = ots.proof.toString('base64');
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[OTS]', e); }

    // 3. Upload
    const uploadedRecords: { name: string; hash: string; size: number; path: string | null }[] = [];
    if (isHosted) {
      const { endpoint, bucket } = requireS3();
      for (const file of files) {
        // On retrouve le hash correspondant dans le manifest (basÃ© sur le nom)
        const rec = manifest.find(m => m.name === file.name);
        if (!rec) continue;

        const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
        const safeName = safeKeyPart(file.name, 60);
        const key = `projects/${authorId.slice(0, 8)}/${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
        
        await r2Client.send(new PutObjectCommand({
          Bucket: bucket, Key: key, Body: buffer,
          ContentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        }));
        uploadedRecords.push({ ...rec, path: `${endpoint}/${bucket}/${key}` });
      }
    } else {
      manifest.forEach(rec => uploadedRecords.push({ ...rec, path: null }));
    }

    // 4. Transaction DB
    const client = await pool.connect();
    let projectId: string;
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const projectRes = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO projects (author_id, title, description, merkle_root, ots_proof) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id`,
        [authorId, title, description, merkleRoot, otsProof]
      );
      projectId = projectRes.rows[0].id;

      for (const rec of uploadedRecords) {
        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,
          [projectId, rec.name, rec.hash, rec.size, rec.path]
        );
      }
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      throw e;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, project_id: projectId, merkle_root: merkleRoot, files_count: manifest.length });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation du projet');
  }
}
EOF

FICHIER : ./fix-db-final.sql

-- =====================================================
-- TABLE PROJECTS (Arbre de Merkle)
-- =====================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  merkle_root TEXT,
  ots_proof TEXT,
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Ajout des colonnes manquantes (si la table existait dÃ©jÃ )
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS merkle_root TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ots_proof TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- Migration : si l'ancienne colonne "name" existe, on la copie vers "title"
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'projects' AND column_name = 'name') THEN
    UPDATE projects SET title = name WHERE title IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- =====================================================
-- TABLE PROJECT_FILES (fichiers de chaque projet)
-- =====================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  file_path TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- =====================================================
-- TABLE WEB_ARCHIVES (nouvelles colonnes)
-- =====================================================
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS site_root TEXT;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pages_scanned INTEGER DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scan_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_summary TEXT;

-- =====================================================
-- INDEX (performance)
-- =====================================================
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_files_project ON project_files(project_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_author ON projects(author_id);

    ""

    import re
    pattern = re.compile(r"const\s*\[\s*mode\s*,\s*setMode\s*\]\s*=\s*useState<[^>]*>\([^)]*initialMode[^)]*\);", re.S)
    if pattern.search(s):
        s = pattern.sub(

# CrÃ©er la route pour liker
mkdir -p "src/app/api/creations/like"
cat > "src/app/api/creations/like/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { creation_id, pubkey } = await req.json();
    if (!creation_id || !pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    // VÃ©rifier si le like existe dÃ©jÃ 
    const existing = await pool.query("SELECT 1 FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [creation_id, userId]);
    
    if (existing.rows.length > 0) {
      // On retire le like
      await pool.query("DELETE FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [creation_id, userId]);
      return NextResponse.json({ liked: false });
    } else {
      // On ajoute le like
      await pool.query("INSERT INTO creation_likes (attachment_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2)", [creation_id, userId]);
      return NextResponse.json({ liked: true });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creation_like]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
EOF

# Mettre Ã  jour le GET pour ramener le nombre de likes
python3 - << 'PYEOF'

    "SELECT a.id, a.type, a.content, a.media_url, a.created_at, a.parent_id, u.handle as author, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = a.id) as likes_count"

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}
EOF

echo ""
echo -e "${GREEN}âœ… Typage corrigÃ©. On vÃ©rifie le build...${NC}"
npm run build

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

say "1/2 â†’ RÃ©Ã©criture propre de pacts/create/route.ts"

cat > "src/app/api/pacts/create/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { PutObjectCommand, DeleteObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { safeKeyPart } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { apiError } from '@/lib/api-error';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const uploadedKeys: string[] = [];
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const title = ((data.get('title') as string) || '').trim();
    const description = ((data.get('description') as string) || '').trim();
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const groupId = (data.get('group_id') as string) || null;
    const requiredSignatures = parseInt((data.get('required_signatures') as string) || '2', 10);
    const hash = data.get('hash') as string;
    const files = (data.getAll('files') as File[]).filter((f) => f && f.size > 0);
    
    // âœ… On dÃ©clare le thÃ¨me proprement ici
    const theme = (data.get('theme') as string) || 'serieux';

    if (!title) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Titre requis' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!hash) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Hash requis' }, { status: 400 });
    if (requiredSignatures < 2 || requiredSignatures > 50) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'required_signatures doit Ãªtre entre 2 et 50' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (files.length > 10) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Trop de fichiers (max 10)' }, { status: 400 });
    if (files.reduce((s, f) => s + f.size, 0) > 4 * 1024 * 1024) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichiers trop lourds (max 4 Mo au total)' }, { status: 413 });
    }

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const creatorId = user.rows[0].id as string;
    const { endpoint, bucket } = requireS3();

    const mediaUrls: string[] = [];
    for (const file of files) {
      const safeName = safeKeyPart(file.name, 60);
      const key = `pact/${creatorId.slice(0, 8)}/${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
      const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
      await r2Client.send(new PutObjectCommand({
        Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET,
        Key: key,
        Body: buffer,
        ContentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        ContentLength: buffer.length,
      }));
      uploadedKeys.push(key);
      mediaUrls.push(`${endpoint}/${bucket}/${key}`);
    }

    const client = await pool.connect();
    let pactId: string;
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const pact = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO pacts (title, description, creator_id, group_id, required_signatures, hash, media_urls, is_hosted, category, theme)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, decode($6, 'base64'), $7, $8, 'Art', $9) RETURNING id`,
        [title, description, creatorId, groupId, requiredSignatures, hash, JSON.stringify(mediaUrls), mediaUrls.length > 0, theme]
      );
      pactId = pact.rows[0].id;
      await client.query(
        "INSERT INTO pact_signatures (pact_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
        [pactId, creatorId]
      );
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      for (const key of uploadedKeys) {
        r2Client.send(new DeleteObjectCommand({ Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET, Key: key })).catch(() => {});
      }
      throw e;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ id: pactId, title });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation du pacte');
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash

cat > fix-db-final.sql << 'EOF'
-- =====================================================
-- TABLE PROJECTS (Arbre de Merkle)
-- =====================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  merkle_root TEXT,
  ots_proof TEXT,
  parent_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Ajout des colonnes manquantes (si la table existait dÃ©jÃ )
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS description TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS merkle_root TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ots_proof TEXT;
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;

-- Migration : si l'ancienne colonne "name" existe, on la copie vers "title"
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name = 'projects' AND column_name = 'name') THEN
    UPDATE projects SET title = name WHERE title IS NULL AND name IS NOT NULL;
  END IF;
END $$;

-- =====================================================
-- TABLE PROJECT_FILES (fichiers de chaque projet)
-- =====================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS project_files (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  project_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  file_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  file_size INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  file_path TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- =====================================================
-- TABLE WEB_ARCHIVES (nouvelles colonnes)
-- =====================================================
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS site_root TEXT;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pages_scanned INTEGER DEFAULT 1;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scan_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0;
ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_summary TEXT;

-- =====================================================
-- INDEX (performance)
-- =====================================================
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_project_files_project ON project_files(project_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_author ON projects(author_id);
EOF

# ==========================================================
# 2. API /api/projects : robustesse (fallback manifest)
# ==========================================================
say "2/5 â†’ Renforcement de l'API /api/projects"

cat > "src/app/api/projects/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { submitToOts } from '@/lib/ots';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';
import { safeKeyPart } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const title = ((data.get('title') as string) || '').trim();
    const description = ((data.get('description') as string) || '').trim();
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const isHosted = data.get('isHosted') !== 'false';
    const parentId = data.get('parent_id') || null;
    const merkleRoot = data.get('merkle_root') as string;
    const manifestStr = data.get('manifest') as string;
    const files = (data.getAll('files') as File[]).filter((f) => f && f.size > 0);

    if (!title) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Titre requis' }, { status: 400 });
    if (!merkleRoot || !manifestStr) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Manifest Merkle manquant' }, { status: 400 });
    if (files.length > 100) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Maximum 100 fichiers par projet' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const authorId = user.rows[0].id;

    const manifest = JSON.parse(manifestStr) as { name: string; hash: string; size: number }[];

    // VÃ©rification crypto Merkle
    const calculatedRoot = buildMerkleRoot(manifest.map(m => m.hash));
    if (calculatedRoot !== merkleRoot) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'IncohÃ©rence cryptographique (Merkle)' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Ancrage OTS
    let otsProof: string | null = null;
    try {
      const ots = await submitToOts(new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(merkleRoot, 'base64')));
      if (ots.ok && ots.proof) otsProof = ots.proof.toString('base64');
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[OTS]', e); }

    // Upload (match par index, plus robuste que par nom)
    const uploadedRecords: { name: string; hash: string; size: number; path: string | null }[] = [];
    if (isHosted) {
      const { endpoint, bucket } = requireS3();
      for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
        const file = files[i];
        // Fallback : d'abord par nom, sinon par index
        let rec = manifest.find(m => m.name === file.name);
        if (!rec) rec = manifest[i];
        if (!rec) {
          console.warn('[projects] fichier orphelin :', file.name);
          continue;
        }

        const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
        const safeName = safeKeyPart(file.name, 60);
        const key = `projects/${authorId.slice(0, 8)}/${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
        
        await r2Client.send(new PutObjectCommand({
          Bucket: bucket, Key: key, Body: buffer,
          ContentType: file.type || 'application/octet-stream',
        }));
        uploadedRecords.push({ ...rec, path: `${endpoint}/${bucket}/${key}` });
      }
    } else {
      manifest.forEach((rec, i) => uploadedRecords.push({ ...rec, path: null }));
    }

    // Transaction DB
    const client = await pool.connect();
    let projectId: string;
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const projectRes = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO projects (author_id, title, description, merkle_root, ots_proof, parent_id)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6) RETURNING id`,
        [authorId, title, description, merkleRoot, otsProof, parentId]
      );
      projectId = projectRes.rows[0].id;

      for (const rec of uploadedRecords) {
        await client.query(
          `INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)`,
          [projectId, rec.name, rec.hash, rec.size, rec.path]
        );
      }
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK');
      throw e;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      project_id: projectId, 
      merkle_root: merkleRoot, 
      files_count: uploadedRecords.length 
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[projects POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur lors de la crÃ©ation du projet' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
EOF

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ count: 0 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ count: 0 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    const res = await pool.query(`
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) as count
      FROM pacts p
      LEFT JOIN pact_signatures ps ON p.id = ps.pact_id
      WHERE (p.creator_id = $1 OR ps.user_id = $1)
        AND p.status != 'scelle'
    `, [userId]);

    return NextResponse.json({ count: parseInt(res.rows[0].count || 0) });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ count: 0 });
  }
}
EOF

// Module d'Intelligence Artificielle pour SCEAU Archive.
// Utilise l'API gratuite de Groq (modÃ¨le Llama 3) si la clÃ© est fournie.
// Si aucune clÃ© n'est configurÃ©e, il renvoie un message gÃ©nÃ©rique.

export async function summarizeChanges(diffDetails: any[]): Promise<string | null> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return null; // Pas de clÃ©, l'IA est dÃ©sactivÃ©e

  // On extrait uniquement les changements (ajoutÃ©s/supprimÃ©s) pour ne pas surcharger l'IA
  const changes = diffDetails
    .filter(d => d.type === 'added' || d.type === 'removed')
    .map(d => `${d.type === 'added' ? '[AJOUTÃ‰]' : '[SUPPRIMÃ‰]'} ${d.text}`)
    .join('\n')
    .slice(0, 4000); // On limite pour respecter le contexte

  if (!changes.trim()) return null;

  const prompt = `Tu es un assistant de veille B2B. Voici les modifications dÃ©tectÃ©es sur un site web concurrent. 
RÃ©sume les changements en franÃ§ais, en 1 phrase courte, claire et professionnelle. 
Concentre-toi sur l'impact business (ex: "Le prix a augmentÃ©", "Nouvelle fonctionnalitÃ© ajoutÃ©e"). 
Ne dis pas "Il y a des ajouts et des suppressions". Dis ce qui a CONCRÃˆTEMENT changÃ©.

Voici les modifications :
${changes}

RÃ©sumÃ© :`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        model: 'llama3-8b-8192', // ModÃ¨le gratuit ultra-rapide
        messages: [{ role: 'user', content: prompt }],
        max_tokens: 100,
        temperature: 0.3
      })
    });

    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = await res.json();
    return data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || null;
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('AI summarize error:', e);
    return null;
  }
}

import { useState, useRef, Suspense } from 'react';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';

function SealContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const isPactMode = searchParams.get('pact') === 'true';
  const chatId = searchParams.get('chat_id');
  const chatType = searchParams.get('chat_type');
  const challengeIdParam = searchParams.get('challenge_id');

  const [isFlashMode, setIsFlashMode] = useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'file' | 'text' | 'media' | 'audio'>('file');

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('');
  const [textContent, setTextContent] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pactFiles, setPactFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState('public');
  const [isHosted, setIsHosted] = useState(true);
  const [isMystery, setIsMystery] = useState(false);
  const [isEphemeral, setIsEphemeral] = useState(false);
  const [unlockLikes, setUnlockLikes] = useState(10);

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  async function startRecording() {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        setFile(new File([audioBlob], `audio-${Date.now()}.webm`, { type: 'audio/webm' }));
        setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob));
      };
      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
    } catch { setStatus("âŒ Impossible d'accÃ©der au micro."); }
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSeal() {
    setStatus('');

    if (!title.trim()) return setStatus("âŒ Un titre est requis");
    if (isPactMode && pactFiles.length === 0) return setStatus("âŒ Ajoute au moins un fichier au pacte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'text' && !textContent.trim()) return setStatus("âŒ Ã‰cris ton texte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'file' && !file) return setStatus("âŒ Choisis un fichier Ã  sceller");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'media' && !file) return setStatus("âŒ Prends une photo ou une vidÃ©o");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'audio' && !file) return setStatus("âŒ Enregistre un audio");

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "PrÃ©paration du pacte..." : "Calcul de l'empreinte...");
    try {
      let hashContent: Uint8Array;

      if (isPactMode) {
        const metaString = `${title}-${desc}-${pactFiles.map(f => f.name).join(',')}`;
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(metaString));
      } else if (mode === 'text') {
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(textContent));
      } else {
        if (!file) return setStatus("âŒ Fichier manquant");
        hashContent = sha256(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()));
      }

      let hashStr = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < hashContent.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hashContent[i]);
      await sendToServer(btoa(hashStr));
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus("âŒ Erreur de gravure : " + (e?.message || 'inconnue'));
    }
  }

  async function sendToServer(hashB64: string) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return setStatus("âŒ Connecte-toi d'abord !");

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('hash', hashB64);
    formData.append('title', title);
    formData.append('description', mode === 'text' ? textContent : desc);
    formData.append('pubkey', pubkey);

    let endpoint = '/api/seal';

    if (isPactMode) {
      endpoint = '/api/pacts/create';
      formData.append('group_id', chatType === 'group' ? (chatId as string) : '');
      formData.append('required_signatures', requiredSignatures.toString());
      pactFiles.forEach(f => formData.append('files', f));
    } else {
      formData.append('isFlash', isFlashMode.toString());
      formData.append('visibility', visibility);
      formData.append('isMystery', isMystery.toString());
      formData.append('isEphemeral', isEphemeral.toString());
      formData.append('unlockLikes', unlockLikes.toString());
      formData.append('isHosted', isHosted.toString());
      if (challengeIdParam) formData.append('challenge_id', challengeIdParam);
      if (mode !== 'text' && file) formData.append('file', file);
    }

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "Envoi du pacte..." : "Ancrage dans la blockchain (max 8s)â€¦");

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));

      if (!res.ok) {
        return setStatus("âŒ " + (data?.error || `Erreur serveur (${res.status})`));
      }

      if (isPactMode) {
        const msg = `[PACTE]${data.id}|${data.title}`;
        if (chatType === 'dm') {
          await fetch('/api/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), receiver_handle: chatId, content: msg }) });
        } else {
          await fetch('/api/groups/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ group_id: chatId, sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), content: msg }) });
        }
        window.location.href = '/messages';
      } else {
        setStatus("âœ… ScellÃ© !");
        setSealedResult({ title, hash: hashB64, date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR'), isFlash: isFlashMode, ots: !!data.ots_secured });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus("âŒ Erreur rÃ©seau : " + (e?.message || 'impossible de contacter le serveur'));
    }
  }

  if (sealedResult) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 font-sans text-center flex flex-col items-center max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="text-6xl mb-4">{sealedResult.isFlash ? 'âš¡' : 'âœ…'}</div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>C'est gravÃ©.</h1>
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--border-color)] w-full text-left shadow-lg mt-6">
          <h3 className="font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{sealedResult.title}</h3>
          <p className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono break-all text-[var(--text-muted)] bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-2 rounded border border-[var(--border-color)]">{sealedResult.hash}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-right mt-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">ScellÃ© le {sealedResult.date}</p>
          {sealedResult.ots && <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-[#5D7A3A] font-bold">âœ… Preuve horodatÃ©e</p>}
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="mt-8 bg-[#2C1810] text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full">Sceller une autre Å“uvre</button>
        <Link href="/feed" className="mt-3 border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] text-[var(--text-main)] p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full text-center">Voir le Feed</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 font-sans max-w-md mx-auto">

      {/* === ONGLETS SCeller / VÃ©rifier === */}

            <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>ğŸ” VÃ©rifier</Link>

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}
EOF

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { hash, query } = await req.json();
    
    // 1. Recherche par Hash (VÃ©rification classique + Projets)
    if (hash) {
      // a) On cherche dans les sceaux individuels
      const sealResult = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.title, s.timestamp, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, u.handle as author,
               'seal' as type
        FROM seals s JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE encode(s.hash, 'base64') = $1
      `, [hash]);

      // b) On cherche dans les fichiers de projets (Arbre de Merkle)
      const projectResult = await pool.query(`
        SELECT pf.file_name as title, p.created_at as timestamp, 
               CASE WHEN pf.file_path IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END as is_hosted, 
               pf.file_path, 'Projet' as category, u.handle as author,
               'project' as type, p.title as project_title, p.id as project_id
        FROM project_files pf 
        JOIN projects p ON pf.project_id = p.id
        JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id
        WHERE pf.file_hash = $1
      `, [hash]);

      const combinedSeals = [...sealResult.rows, ...projectResult.rows];

      if (combinedSeals.length > 0) {
        return NextResponse.json({ found: true, seals: combinedSeals });
      }
      return NextResponse.json({ found: false });
    }

    // 2. Recherche par Titre (DÃ©couverte publique)
    if (query) {
      const result = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.title, s.timestamp, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, encode(s.hash, 'base64') as hash, u.handle as author
        FROM seals s JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE s.title ILIKE $1 AND s.is_public = TRUE
        ORDER BY s.timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
      `, [`%${query}%`]);
      
      return NextResponse.json({ found: result.rows.length > 0, seals: result.rows });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'RequÃªte invalide' }, { status: 400 });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

          </div>
        </div>
      )}

  );
}
