import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}

// En-tÃªte .ots complet (31 octets) :
// \x00 + "OpenTimestamps" (14) + \x00\x00 + "Proof" (5) + \x00 + 8 octets magiques
const HEADER_MAGIC = Buffer.from(
  '004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e89294',
  'hex'
);

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

const CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

export type OtsResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  // Si le calendar a renvoyÃ© une preuve partielle sans header, on l'encapsule proprement
  const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash);
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    hashBuffer,
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

  // Fond
  doc.setFillColor(253, 248, 240);
  doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');

  doc.setDrawColor(232, 120, 60);
  doc.setLineWidth(2);

  doc.text("CERTIFICAT D'INTÃ‰GRITÃ‰", 105, 30, { align: 'center' });
  
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(122, 90, 58);
  doc.text("Dossier Miroir (Arbre de Merkle)", 105, 40, { align: 'center' });

  doc.setFontSize(14);
  doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
  doc.text(`Projet : ${title}`, 20, 55);
  doc.text(`CrÃ©ateur : @${author}`, 20, 63);
  doc.text(`Date de scellement : ${new Date(date).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`, 20, 71);

  doc.setFont('courier', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.text("EMPREINTE RACINE (MERKLE ROOT) :", 20, 85);
  
  const chunks = merkleRoot.match(/.{1,50}/g) || [merkleRoot];
  doc.setFont('courier', 'normal');
  chunks.forEach((chunk, i) => {
    doc.text(chunk, 20, 91 + i * 5);
  });

  // Liste des fichiers
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.text("FICHIERS INCLUS :", 20, 115);
  
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  let y = 122;
  files.slice(0, 30).forEach((f) => {
    if (y > 270) return; // Limite de page
    doc.text(`- ${f.file_name}`, 20, y);
    doc.text(`  Hash: ${f.file_hash.slice(0, 20)}...`, 25, y + 4);
    y += 10;
  });

  if (files.length > 30) {
    doc.text(`... et ${files.length - 30} autres fichiers.`, 20, y + 5);
  }

  doc.save(`Projet-${title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-')}.pdf`);
}

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

# ==========================================================
# 1. LE PATCH DE CLAUDE (SÃ©curitÃ© Profil PropriÃ©taire vs Public)
# ==========================================================
say "1/6 â†’ Application du patch de Claude (API Profil)"

cat > "src/app/api/profil/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const handle = searchParams.get('handle')?.trim();
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey')?.trim();

  if (!handle && !pubkey) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pseudo ou clÃ© manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    let isOwner = false;
    let user;
    
    if (pubkey) {
      user = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1 LIMIT 1",
        [pubkey]
      );
      isOwner = user.rows.length > 0;
    } else {
      user = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1) LIMIT 1",
        [handle]
      );
    }
    
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 404 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    let totalSealed = 0, totalHosted = 0, totalSize = 0;
    try {
      const stats = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(id) as total_sealed, SUM(CASE WHEN is_hosted = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_hosted, SUM(file_size) as total_size FROM seals WHERE author_id = $1`, [userId]);
      totalSealed = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_sealed || 0);
      totalHosted = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_hosted || 0);
      totalSize = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_size || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Stats error:', e.message); }

    let seals = [];
    try {
      const sealsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.timestamp, s.visibility, s.is_flash, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, encode(s.hash, 'base64') as hash,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE seal_id = s.id) as likes_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE seal_id = s.id) as comments_count
        FROM seals s WHERE s.author_id = $1 ${isOwner ? '' : "AND s.visibility = 'public'"} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      seals = sealsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Seals error:', e.message); }

    let totalPacts = 0;
    try {
      const pacts = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pacts FROM pact_signatures WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
      totalPacts = parseInt(pacts.rows[0].total_pacts || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Pacts error:', e.message); }

    let friendsCount = 0;
    try {
      const friendsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = $1 OR addressee_id = $1) AND status = 'accepted'`, [userId]);
      friendsCount = parseInt(friendsRes.rows[0].count || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Friends error:', e.message); }

    let projects = [];
    try {
      const projectsQuery = !isOwner ? { rows: [] } : await pool.query(`
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.merkle_root, p.created_at, p.ots_proof,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_files WHERE project_id = p.id) as files_count
        FROM projects p WHERE p.author_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      projects = projectsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Projects error:', e.message); }

    let favorites = [];
    try {
      const favoritesQuery = !isOwner ? { rows: [] } : await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
        FROM favorites f JOIN seals s ON f.seal_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      favorites = favoritesQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Favorites error:', e.message); }

    let streak = 0;
    try {
      const uniqueDatesSet = new Set(seals.map((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0]));
      let cursor = new Date();
      cursor.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if (!uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
      while (uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) { streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
    } catch (e) {}

    const badges = [];
    if (totalSealed >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸŒ±', name: 'Apprenti', desc: 'PremiÃ¨re Å“uvre scellÃ©e' });
    if (totalSealed >= 10) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‰', name: 'Archiviste', desc: '10 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (totalSealed >= 50) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‡', name: 'Gardien', desc: '50 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (isPro) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ‘‘', name: 'PRO', desc: 'Compte vÃ©rifiÃ© PRO' });
    if (streak >= 3) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ”¥', name: 'En Feu', desc: '3 jours consÃ©cutifs' });
    if (totalPacts >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¤', name: 'NÃ©gociateur', desc: 'A signÃ© un pacte' });

    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle, bio: user.rows[0].bio,
      open_to_collaboration: user.rows[0].open_to_collaboration || false,
      first_name: isOwner ? user.rows[0].first_name : null, 
      last_name: isOwner ? user.rows[0].last_name : null, 
      birth_date: isOwner ? user.rows[0].birth_date : null,
      role: user.rows[0].role, is_pro: isPro, streak: streak, favorites: favorites,
      sealed: totalSealed, hosted: totalHosted, used_bytes: totalSize,
      friends_count: friendsCount, pacts: totalPacts, badges: badges, seals: seals, projects: projects
    });
  } catch (error: any) { 
    console.error("[api/profil]", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 }); 
  }
}
EOF

# ==========================================================
# 2. LE DIFF DE CLAUDE (Page Profil envoie la Pubkey)
# ==========================================================
say "2/6 â†’ Application du diff de Claude (Frontend Profil)"

python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import sys
p = 'src/app/profil/page.tsx'
s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()

old_fetch = """      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle.trim())}`,
        { cache: 'no-store' }
      );"""

new_fetch = """      const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle.trim())}${pubkey ? `&pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}` : ''}`,
        { cache: 'no-store' }
      );"""

if old_fetch in s:

// Validation centralisÃ©e des variables d'environnement.
// Ã‰choue TÃ”T avec un message clair au lieu de produire `undefined/undefined/clÃ©`.

function clean(v: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  return v.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
}

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = clean(process.env[name]);
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Variable d'environnement manquante ou vide : ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function optional(name: string, def = ''): string {
  return clean(process.env[name]) ?? def;
}

export function requireS3(): { endpoint: string; bucket: string; region: string } {
  const endpoint = required('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = required('S3_BUCKET').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const region = optional('AWS_REGION', 'us-west-004');
  return { endpoint, bucket, region };
}

export function requireDb(): string {
  return required('DATABASE_URL');
}
EOF

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function isDbError(e: any): boolean {
  const code = e?.code;
  if (['ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ETIMEDOUT', '28P01', '3D000', '57P01'].includes(code)) return true;
  return /ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|timeout|connect.*pool|database/i.test(String(e?.message || ''));
}

export function apiError(e: unknown, fallback = 'Erreur serveur'): NextResponse {
  if (isDbError(e)) {
    console.error('[api-error] base injoignable :', (e as any)?.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Base de donnÃ©es injoignable. RÃ©essayez dans un instant.' },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
  console.error('[api-error]', e);
  return NextResponse.json({ error: fallback }, { status: 500 });
}
EOF

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}
EOF

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { requireDb } from '@/lib/env';

let _pool: Pool | null = null;

function create(): Pool {
  const url = requireDb();
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: url,
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: true },
  });
  pool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[pg] idle client error:', err.message);
  });
  return pool;
}

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!_pool) _pool = create();
  return _pool;
}

// Compat : `import { pool } from '@/db/pool'` continue de fonctionner.
export const pool = new Proxy({} as Pool, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getPool() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});
EOF

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});
EOF

  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    Buffer.from(hash),
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { GetObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { extractS3Key } from '@/lib/safe-key';
import { apiError } from '@/lib/api-error';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

function encodeContentDisposition(filename: string): string {
  const asciiFallback = filename
    .normalize('NFD')
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
    .replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, '_')
    .replace(/["\\]/g, '_');
  return `attachment; filename="${asciiFallback}"; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(filename)}`;
}

async function toWebStream(body: any): Promise<ReadableStream> {
  if (body instanceof Readable) return Readable.toWeb(body) as unknown as ReadableStream;
  if (body && typeof body.getReader === 'function') return body as ReadableStream;
  if (body && typeof body[Symbol.asyncIterator] === 'function') {
    return new ReadableStream({
      async start(controller) {
        try {
          for await (const chunk of body) controller.enqueue(chunk);
          controller.close();
        } catch (e) { controller.error(e); }
      },
    });
  }
  throw new Error('Body S3 non supportÃ©');
}

export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const viewerPubkey = searchParams.get('viewer');

  try {
    const res = await pool.query(
      "SELECT file_path FROM seals WHERE id = $1 AND visibility = 'public'",
      [id]
    );
    if (res.rows.length === 0 || !res.rows[0].file_path) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    }

    const key = extractS3Key(res.rows[0].file_path);
    if (!key) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© S3 invalide' }, { status: 500 });

    const obj = await r2Client.send(new GetObjectCommand({
      Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET,
      Key: key,
    }));
    if (!obj.Body) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

    if (viewerPubkey) {
      pool.query(
        "INSERT INTO access_log (seal_id, viewer_id, action, context) SELECT $1, id, 'download', 'public' FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $2",
        [id, viewerPubkey]
      ).catch((e) => console.warn('[download] log Ã©chouÃ©', e));
    }

    const webStream = await toWebStream(obj.Body);
    const filename = key.split('/').pop() || 'file';

    return new NextResponse(webStream, {
      status: 200,
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': obj.ContentType || 'application/octet-stream',
        'Content-Disposition': encodeContentDisposition(filename),
        'Content-Length': obj.ContentLength ? String(obj.ContentLength) : '',
        'Cache-Control': 'private, max-age=0, must-revalidate',
      },
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors du tÃ©lÃ©chargement');
  }
}

      [upgraded.toString('base64'), id]
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ status: 'upgraded', size: upgraded.length });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors de la mise Ã  jour de la preuve');
  }

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { anchorToBitcoin, hashDocument } from '../../../../../../sceau-protocol/src/index';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

const LIMIT = 10;
const WINDOW_MS = 60_000;
const MAX_ENTRIES = 5_000;
const MAX_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024;

type Entry = { count: number; resetAt: number };
const ipCache = new Map<string, Entry>();

function getClientIp(req: Request): string {
  const xff = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for');
  if (xff) return xff.split(',')[0].trim();
  const real = req.headers.get('x-real-ip');
  if (real) return real.trim();
  return 'unknown';
}

function rateLimit(ip: string): { ok: boolean; retryAfter?: number } {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (ipCache.size > MAX_ENTRIES) {
    for (const [k, v] of ipCache) if (v.resetAt < now) ipCache.delete(k);
    while (ipCache.size > MAX_ENTRIES) {
      const first = ipCache.keys().next().value;
      if (first === undefined) break;
      ipCache.delete(first);
    }
  }
  let e = ipCache.get(ip);
  if (!e || e.resetAt < now) {
    e = { count: 0, resetAt: now + WINDOW_MS };
    ipCache.set(ip, e);
  }
  if (e.count >= LIMIT) return { ok: false, retryAfter: Math.ceil((e.resetAt - now) / 1000) };
  e.count++;
  return { ok: true };
}

const CORS = {
  'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'POST, OPTIONS',
  'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type',
  'Access-Control-Max-Age': '86400',
};

export async function OPTIONS() {
  return new NextResponse(null, { status: 204, headers: CORS });
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = getClientIp(req);
  const rl = rateLimit(ip);
  if (!rl.ok) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: `Trop de requÃªtes. RÃ©essayez dans ${rl.retryAfter}s.` },
      { status: 429, headers: { ...CORS, 'Retry-After': String(rl.retryAfter ?? 60) } }
    );
  }

  try {
    const len = req.headers.get('content-length');
    if (len && parseInt(len, 10) > MAX_BYTES) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier trop lourd (max 4 Mo)' }, { status: 413, headers: CORS });
    }
    const data = await req.formData();
    const file = data.get('file') as File | null;
    if (!file) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier manquant.' }, { status: 400, headers: CORS });
    if (file.size === 0 || file.size > MAX_BYTES) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Fichier vide ou trop lourd (max 4 Mo).' }, { status: 413, headers: CORS });
    }

    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    const hashHex = hashDocument(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    const { otsProof, calendars } = await anchorToBitcoin(hashHex);

    return NextResponse.json({
      success: true,
      protocol: 'SCEAU v1.0',
      document: { name: file.name, hash_sha256: hashHex },
      bitcoin_anchor: {
        secured: otsProof !== null,
        ots_proof_base64: otsProof,
        calendars_used: calendars,
      },

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\033[0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

say "1/2 â†’ Modification de l'API (GÃ©nÃ©ration du Diff Textuel)"

cat > "src/app/api/archive/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

function hashContent(content: string): string {
  const hash = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(content));
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

// Fonction basique de Diff (Ligne par ligne, sans IA)
function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];

  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const oldLine = oldLines[i] || '';
    const newLine = newLines[i] || '';

    if (oldLine !== newLine) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: oldLine.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: newLine.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (oldLine.trim() !== '') {
      // On garde les lignes identiques pour le contexte (max 3 par bloc)
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: oldLine.trim() });
    }
  }

  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) }; // On limite Ã  100 lignes pour l'affichage
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, url, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data
      FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: result.rows, 
      is_pro: user.rows[0].is_pro,
      limit: user.rows[0].is_pro ? 50 : 3
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    const countQuery = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
    const currentCount = parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? 50 : 3;

    if (currentCount >= maxLimit && action !== 'check') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} URLs max).` }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // === VÃ‰RIFICATION (Le Scan) ===
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query("SELECT id, url, last_hash, last_content FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [url, userId]);
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;
      const oldContent = archive.rows[0].last_content || '';

      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
      const html = await res.text();
      
      // On extrait le texte brut (sans les balises HTML pour un diff propre)
      const newText = html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n').replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n').trim();
      const newHash = hashContent(newText);

      const isModified = oldHash !== newHash;
      
      if (isModified) {
        const diffResult = generateDiff(oldContent, newText);
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1 WHERE id = $2", 
          [JSON.stringify(diffResult), url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified', changes: diffResult.changesCount });
      } else {
        await pool.query("UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = NULL WHERE id = $1", [url]);
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // === AJOUT D'UNE NOUVELLE URL ===
    if (!url.startsWith('http://') && !url.startsWith('https://')) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
    if (!res.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site.' }, { status: 400 });
    
    const html = await res.text();
    const cleanText = html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n').replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n').trim();
    const newHash = hashContent(cleanText);
    const title = new URL(url).hostname;

    await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, title, last_hash, last_content, last_status) 
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'intact')
    `, [userId, url, title, newHash, cleanText]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });

  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur : ' + e.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

            <div key={a.id} className={`flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between p-4 ${i !== archives.length - 1 ? 'border-b border-[var(--border-color)]' : ''} ${a.last_status === 'modified' ? 'bg-[#FDF4F0]' : ''}`}>
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3 md:mb-0">
                <div className={`w-2 h-2 rounded-full ${a.last_status === 'modified' ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-green-500'}`}></div>
                <div>
                  <p className="font-bold text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{a.title || a.url}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] truncate max-w-[300px]">{a.url}</p>
                  {a.last_status === 'modified' && <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-red-600 font-bold uppercase mt-1">Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e</p>}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                {a.diff_data && (
                  <button onClick={() => setSelectedDiff(a.diff_data)} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-gray-50 transition shadow-sm">
                    Voir le Diff
                  </button>
                )}
                <span className="text-[0.65rem] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] mr-2 hidden sm:block">
                  VÃ©rifiÃ© le {new Date(a.last_checked_at).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}
                </span>
                <button 
                  onClick={() => checkUrl(a.id)} 
                  disabled={checking === a.id}
                  className="bg-[#F0F6FC] text-[#2D6A9E] border border-[#C9D8E8] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold hover:bg-[#E0EDF8] transition"
                >
                  {checking === a.id ? 'Scan...' : 'VÃ©rifier'}

                <button onClick={() => deleteUrl(a.id)} className="text-red-400 hover:text-red-600 px-2 text-lg">âœ•</button>
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* MODALE DE DIFF GIT-LIKE */}
      {selectedDiff && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-white w-full max-w-3xl rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
            <div className="bg-gray-100 p-4 border-b border-gray-200 flex justify-between items-center">
              <h3 className="font-bold text-gray-800 font-mono text-sm">Diff de la page (Comparaison)</h3>
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedDiff(null)} className="text-gray-500 hover:text-black font-bold text-xl">âœ•</button>
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 overflow-y-auto font-mono text-xs bg-gray-50">
              {selectedDiff.details?.map((line: any, i: number) => (
                <div key={i} className={`py-1 px-2 whitespace-pre-wrap ${
                  line.type === 'added' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-l-2 border-green-500' :
                  line.type === 'removed' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-l-2 border-red-500 line-through opacity-70' :
                  'text-gray-500'
                }`}>
                  <span className="select-none opacity-50 mr-2">{line.type === 'added' ? '+' : line.type === 'removed' ? '-' : ' '}</span>
                  {line.text || ' '}
                </div>
              ))}
              {!selectedDiff.details?.length && <p className="text-gray-500 italic text-center">Aucune diffÃ©rence textuelle visible.</p>}
            </div>
            <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-200 bg-white flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">Total : {selectedDiff.changesCount} modifications</span>
              <button onClick={() => setSelectedDiff(null)} className="bg-black text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm">Fermer</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

    </div>
  );
}

============================================================
FICHIER : ./archive-product.sh
============================================================

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\033[0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

# ==========================================================
# 1. LE CRON JOB (Scan Automatique 24h/24)
# ==========================================================
say "1/3 â†’ CrÃ©ation du Cron Job (Vercel)"

mkdir -p "src/app/api/cron/archive-scan"
cat > "src/app/api/cron/archive-scan/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import { Resend } from 'resend';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 60;

function hashContent(content: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(content))).toString('hex');
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;

  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const oldLine = oldLines[i] || '';
    const newLine = newLines[i] || '';
    if (oldLine !== newLine) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: oldLine.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: newLine.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (oldLine.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: oldLine.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const authHeader = req.headers.get('authorization');
  if (process.env.CRON_SECRET && authHeader !== `Bearer ${process.env.CRON_SECRET}`) {
    return new NextResponse('Unauthorized', { status: 401 });
  }

  try {
    const archives = await pool.query(`
      SELECT a.id, a.url, a.last_hash, a.last_content, u.email 
      FROM web_archives a 
      JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
    `);
    
    const resend = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY ? new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) : null;
    let scanned = 0;
    let modifiedCount = 0;

    for (const archive of archives.rows) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(archive.url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
        if (!res.ok) continue;
        
        const html = await res.text();
        const newText = html.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n').replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n').trim();
        const newHash = hashContent(newText);

        if (archive.last_hash !== newHash) {
          const diffResult = generateDiff(archive.last_content || '', newText);
          
          await pool.query(
            "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, last_hash = $2, last_content = $3 WHERE id = $4",
            [JSON.stringify(diffResult), newHash, newText, archive.id]
          );

          if (resend && archive.email) {
            await resend.emails.send({
              from: 'SCEAU Archive <alerte@sceau-app.vercel.app>',
              to: archive.email,
              subject: `ğŸš¨ Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e sur ${archive.url}`,
              html: `
                <div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 600px; margin: 0 auto;">
                  <h2 style="color: #E76F51;">SCEAU Archive</h2>
                  <p>Une modification a Ã©tÃ© dÃ©tectÃ©e sur la page que vous surveillez :</p>
                  <p><a href="${archive.url}" style="background: #eee; padding: 10px; display: block; border-radius: 8px; color: #333; text-decoration: none;">${archive.url}</a></p>
                  <p><strong>${diffResult.changesCount} changements</strong> ont Ã©tÃ© trouvÃ©s.</p>
                  <a href="https://sceau-app.vercel.app/archive" style="display: inline-block; background: #1A1513; color: white; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; margin-top: 20px;">Voir le Diff complet</a>
                </div>
              `
            });
          }
          modifiedCount++;
        } else {
          await pool.query(
            "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1",
            [archive.id]
          );
        }
        scanned++;
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(`Erreur scan ${archive.url}:`, e);
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, scanned, modifiedCount });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cron Error' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
EOF

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const handle = searchParams.get('handle')?.trim();

  if (!handle) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pseudo manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    const user = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1) LIMIT 1",
      [handle]
    );
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 404 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    // On sÃ©curise chaque requÃªte pour Ã©viter qu'une table manquante ne fasse planter tout le profil
    let totalSealed = 0, totalHosted = 0, totalSize = 0;
    try {
      const stats = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(id) as total_sealed, SUM(CASE WHEN is_hosted = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_hosted, SUM(file_size) as total_size FROM seals WHERE author_id = $1`, [userId]);
      totalSealed = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_sealed || 0);
      totalHosted = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_hosted || 0);
      totalSize = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_size || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Stats error:', e.message); }

    let seals = [];
    try {
      const sealsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.timestamp, s.visibility, s.is_flash, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, encode(s.hash, 'base64') as hash,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE seal_id = s.id) as likes_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE seal_id = s.id) as comments_count
        FROM seals s WHERE s.author_id = $1 ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      seals = sealsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Seals error:', e.message); }

    let totalPacts = 0;
    try {
      const pacts = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pacts FROM pact_signatures WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
      totalPacts = parseInt(pacts.rows[0].total_pacts || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Pacts error:', e.message); }

    let friendsCount = 0;
    try {
      const friendsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = $1 OR addressee_id = $1) AND status = 'accepted'`, [userId]);
      friendsCount = parseInt(friendsRes.rows[0].count || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Friends error:', e.message); }

    let projects = [];
    try {
      const projectsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.merkle_root, p.created_at, p.ots_proof,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_files WHERE project_id = p.id) as files_count
        FROM projects p WHERE p.author_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      projects = projectsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Projects error:', e.message); }

    let favorites = [];
    try {
      const favoritesQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
        FROM favorites f JOIN seals s ON f.seal_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      favorites = favoritesQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Favorites error:', e.message); }

    let streak = 0;
    try {
      const uniqueDatesSet = new Set(seals.map((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0]));
      let cursor = new Date();
      cursor.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if (!uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
      while (uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) { streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }

    const badges = [];
    if (totalSealed >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸŒ±', name: 'Apprenti', desc: 'PremiÃ¨re Å“uvre scellÃ©e' });
    if (totalSealed >= 10) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‰', name: 'Archiviste', desc: '10 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (totalSealed >= 50) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‡', name: 'Gardien', desc: '50 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (isPro) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ‘‘', name: 'PRO', desc: 'Compte vÃ©rifiÃ© PRO' });
    if (streak >= 3) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ”¥', name: 'En Feu', desc: '3 jours consÃ©cutifs' });
    if (totalPacts >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¤', name: 'NÃ©gociateur', desc: 'A signÃ© un pacte' });

    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle, bio: user.rows[0].bio,
      open_to_collaboration: user.rows[0].open_to_collaboration || false,
      first_name: user.rows[0].first_name, last_name: user.rows[0].last_name, birth_date: user.rows[0].birth_date,
      role: user.rows[0].role, is_pro: isPro, streak: streak, favorites: favorites,
      sealed: totalSealed, hosted: totalHosted, used_bytes: totalSize,
      friends_count: friendsCount, pacts: totalPacts, badges: badges, seals: seals, projects: projects
    });
  } catch (error: any) { 
    console.error("[api/profil]", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 }); 
  }
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ArchivePage() {
  const [archives, setArchives] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isPro, setIsPro] = useState(false);
  const [limit, setLimit] = useState(3);
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [checking, setChecking] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedDiff, setSelectedDiff] = useState<any>(null);

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  const loadArchives = async () => {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) { setArchives(d.archives || []); setIsPro(d.is_pro); setLimit(d.limit); }
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadArchives(); }, [pubkey]);

  async function handleAdd() {
    if (!url || !pubkey) return;
    setAdding(true); setError('');
    const res = await fetch('/api/archive', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url }) });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) setError(d.error);
    else { setUrl(''); loadArchives(); }
    setAdding(false);
  }

  async function checkUrl(id: string) {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    setChecking(id);
    const res = await fetch('/api/archive', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url: id, action: 'check' }) });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      if (d.status === 'modified') alert(`Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e ! ${d.changes} changements trouvÃ©s.`);
      loadArchives();
    } else alert(d.error);
    setChecking(null);
  }

  async function deleteUrl(id: string) {
    if (!pubkey || !confirm('Supprimer cette surveillance ?')) return;
    await fetch(`/api/archive?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}&id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    loadArchives();
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-4xl mx-auto font-sans w-full min-h-screen">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-8">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-serif mb-2" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>SCEAU Archive</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">Surveillez l'intÃ©gritÃ© des sites web. DÃ©tectez les modifications en un clic.</p>
        </div>
        <a href="/downloads/sceau-extension.zip" download className="bg-white border-2 border-gray-200 text-gray-800 px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xs hover:border-[#E76F51] transition shadow-sm hidden md:block">TÃ©lÃ©charger l'Extension Chrome</a>
        {!isPro && (
          <div className="bg-[#FDF4F0] border border-[#FCE0D6] px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-right hidden md:block">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#C44A2E]">Quota Gratuit</p>
            <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-[#C44A2E]">{archives.length} / {limit} URLs</p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mb-8">
        <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2 font-mono uppercase">Ajouter une URL Ã  surveiller</label>
        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <input type="url" placeholder="https://www.concurrent.com" className="flex-1 border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl bg-transparent outline-none focus:border-[#4A90C2]" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={url} onChange={e => setUrl(e.target.value)} />
          <button onClick={handleAdd} disabled={adding || (!isPro && archives.length >= limit)} className="bg-[#1A1513] text-white px-6 rounded-xl font-bold disabled:opacity-50 hover:bg-black transition">{adding ? '...' : 'Sceller'}</button>
        </div>
        {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm font-bold mt-2">{error}</p>}

          <p className="text-sm text-[#C44A2E] mt-3 font-bold">âš ï¸ Limite de 3 URLs atteinte. <button onClick={() => alert("SCEAU PRO arrive bientÃ´t !")} className="underline">Passez Ã  PRO</button> pour en ajouter plus.</p>

# 2. CRAWLER COMPLET : POST /api/archive

say "2/5 â†’ RÃ©Ã©criture POST /api/archive (scan complet du site)"

cat > "src/app/api/archive/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

const MAX_PAGES = 10;

function isSafeUrl(urlString: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(urlString);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    const h = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1') return false;
    if (/^10\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

function extractInternalLinks(html: string, baseUrl: string): string[] {
  const links: Set<string> = new Set();
  const regex = /<a[^>]+href=["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
  let match;
  const base = new URL(baseUrl);
  while ((match = regex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(match[1], baseUrl);
      if (url.hostname === base.hostname && url.protocol.startsWith('http')) {
        url.hash = '';
        links.add(url.toString());
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return Array.from(links);
}

async function fetchSitemap(siteRoot: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${siteRoot}/sitemap.xml`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const xml = await res.text();
    const matches = xml.match(/<loc>([^<]+)<\/loc>/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => m.replace(/<\/?loc>/g, '').trim()).slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
  } catch { return []; }
}

async function scanPage(url: string): Promise<{ text: string; hash: string } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      redirect: 'follow',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const html = await res.text();
    if (html.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    const text = cleanHtmlToText(html);
    const hash = Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text))).toString('hex');
    return { text, hash };
  } catch { return null; }
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const o = oldLines[i] || '';
    const n = newLines[i] || '';
    if (o !== n) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: o.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: n.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (o.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: o.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, url, site_root, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data, pages_scanned, scan_count, ai_summary
      FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: result.rows, 
      is_pro: user.rows[0].is_pro,
      limit: user.rows[0].is_pro ? 50 : 3
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    const countQuery = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
    const currentCount = parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? 50 : 3;

    if (currentCount >= maxLimit && action !== 'check') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} sites max).` }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // === VÃ‰RIFICATION (scan manuel) ===
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, url, site_root, last_hash, last_content FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
        [url, userId]
      );
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const siteRoot = archive.rows[0].site_root || new URL(targetUrl).origin;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;
      const oldContent = archive.rows[0].last_content || '';

      const scan = await scanPage(targetUrl);
      if (!scan) {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'error', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = scan_count + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error', message: 'Impossible de vÃ©rifier le site.' });
      }

      if (oldHash !== scan.hash) {
        const diffResult = generateDiff(oldContent, scan.text);
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE web_archives 
           SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, 
               last_hash = $2, last_content = $3, scan_count = scan_count + 1 
           WHERE id = $4`,
          [JSON.stringify(diffResult), scan.hash, scan.text, url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified', changes: diffResult.changesCount });
      } else {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = scan_count + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // === AJOUT D'UN SITE (crawl complet) ===
    if (!isSafeUrl(url)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide ou non autorisÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(url);
    const siteRoot = `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}`;

    // DÃ©couvre les pages Ã  scanner
    let pages: string[] = [];
    const sitemapPages = await fetchSitemap(siteRoot);
    if (sitemapPages.length > 0) {
      pages = sitemapPages;
    } else {
      const rootHtml = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      }).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : null).catch(() => null);

      if (!rootHtml) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site.' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const internalLinks = extractInternalLinks(rootHtml, url);
      pages = [url, ...internalLinks.filter(l => l !== url)].slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
    }

    // Scanne les pages en parallÃ¨le
    const scanResults = await Promise.all(pages.map(p => scanPage(p)));
    const validResults = scanResults.filter((r, i): r is { text: string; hash: string } => r !== null);
    
    if (validResults.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Aucune page n\'a pu Ãªtre scannÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // CrÃ©e une entrÃ©e par page
    for (let i = 0; i < validResults.length; i++) {
      const pageUrl = pages[i];
      const pageData = validResults[i];
      const title = new URL(pageUrl).pathname || '/';
      
      await pool.query(`
        INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, site_root, title, last_hash, last_content, last_status, pages_scanned, scan_count)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'intact', $7, 1)
      `, [userId, pageUrl, siteRoot, title, pageData.hash, pageData.text, validResults.length]);
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      pages_scanned: validResults.length,
      site_root: siteRoot,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[archive POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e

say "1/4 â†’ RÃ©Ã©criture POST /api/archive (quota par site + titre propre)"

cat > "src/app/api/archive/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30;

const MAX_PAGES = 10;
const FREE_LIMIT = 5;  // Sites gratuits (pas pages)
const PRO_LIMIT = 50;

function isSafeUrl(urlString: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(urlString);
    if (url.protocol !== 'http:' && url.protocol !== 'https:') return false;
    const h = url.hostname.toLowerCase();
    if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1') return false;
    if (/^10\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return false;
    if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return false;
    return true;
  } catch { return false; }
}

function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

function extractPageTitle(html: string, fallbackUrl: string): string {
  // Cherche <title>...</title>
  const titleMatch = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  if (titleMatch && titleMatch[1]) {
    const clean = titleMatch[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 200) return clean;
  }
  // Cherche <h1>...</h1>
  const h1Match = html.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);
  if (h1Match && h1Match[1]) {
    const clean = h1Match[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 100) return clean;
  }
  // Fallback : hostname + pathname
  try {
    const u = new URL(fallbackUrl);
    if (u.pathname === '/' || u.pathname === '') return u.hostname;
    return `${u.hostname}${u.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return fallbackUrl;
  }
}

function extractInternalLinks(html: string, baseUrl: string): string[] {
  const links: Set<string> = new Set();
  const regex = /<a[^>]+href=["']([^"']+)["']/gi;
  let match;
  const base = new URL(baseUrl);
  while ((match = regex.exec(html)) !== null) {
    try {
      const url = new URL(match[1], baseUrl);
      if (url.hostname === base.hostname && url.protocol.startsWith('http')) {
        url.hash = '';
        url.search = ''; // ignore query strings pour Ã©viter les doublons
        links.add(url.toString());
      }
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
  }
  return Array.from(links);
}

async function fetchSitemap(siteRoot: string): Promise<string[]> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${siteRoot}/sitemap.xml`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) return [];
    const xml = await res.text();
    const matches = xml.match(/<loc>([^<]+)<\/loc>/g) || [];
    return matches.map(m => m.replace(/<\/?loc>/g, '').trim()).slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
  } catch { return []; }
}

async function scanPage(url: string): Promise<{ text: string; hash: string; title: string } | null> {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(url, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      redirect: 'follow',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const html = await res.text();
    if (html.length > 5 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    const text = cleanHtmlToText(html);
    const hash = Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text))).toString('hex');
    const title = extractPageTitle(html, url);
    return { text, hash, title };
  } catch { return null; }
}

function generateDiff(oldText: string, newText: string) {
  const oldLines = oldText.split('\n');
  const newLines = newText.split('\n');
  const diff = [];
  const maxLines = Math.max(oldLines.length, newLines.length);
  let changesCount = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < maxLines; i++) {
    const o = oldLines[i] || '';
    const n = newLines[i] || '';
    if (o !== n) {
      diff.push({ type: 'removed', text: o.trim() });
      diff.push({ type: 'added', text: n.trim() });
      changesCount++;
    } else if (o.trim() !== '') {
      diff.push({ type: 'unchanged', text: o.trim() });
    }
  }
  return { changesCount, details: diff.slice(0, 100) };
}

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    // RÃ©cupÃ¨re toutes les pages, puis regroupe par site_root cÃ´tÃ© serveur
    let pages;
    try {
      pages = await pool.query(`
        SELECT id, url, site_root, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data, pages_scanned, scan_count, ai_summary
        FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
    } catch (colErr) {
      // Fallback si colonnes manquantes
      pages = await pool.query(`
        SELECT id, url, title, last_status, last_checked_at, created_at, diff_data
        FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
    }

    // Regroupement par site_root (site principal)
    const sitesMap = new Map<string, any>();
    for (const page of pages.rows) {
      const siteRoot = page.site_root || (() => {
        try { return new URL(page.url).origin; } catch { return page.url; }
      })();
      
      if (!sitesMap.has(siteRoot)) {
        sitesMap.set(siteRoot, {
          site_root: siteRoot,
          main_id: page.id,          // la page principale (premiÃ¨re = l'URL ajoutÃ©e)
          main_title: page.site_root === null ? page.title : null, // Ã  remplir
          main_url: page.url,
          pages_count: 0,
          last_checked_at: page.last_checked_at,
          created_at: page.created_at,
          scan_count: page.scan_count || 1,
          has_modifications: false,
          pages: [],
        });
      }
      
      const site = sitesMap.get(siteRoot);
      site.pages_count++;
      site.pages.push(page);
      
      // Le main_id doit Ãªtre celui de la page racine (pathname === '/')
      try {
        const u = new URL(page.url);
        if (u.pathname === '/' || u.pathname === '') {
          site.main_id = page.id;
          site.main_title = page.title;
          site.main_url = page.url;
        }
      } catch { /* ignore */ }
      
      if (page.last_status === 'modified') site.has_modifications = true;
      if (new Date(page.last_checked_at) > new Date(site.last_checked_at)) {
        site.last_checked_at = page.last_checked_at;
      }
    }

    // Si le titre principal n'a pas Ã©tÃ© trouvÃ©, fallback sur le hostname
    for (const site of sitesMap.values()) {
      if (!site.main_title) {
        try { site.main_title = new URL(site.site_root).hostname; }
        catch { site.main_title = site.site_root; }
      }
    }

    const sitesArray = Array.from(sitesMap.values());

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: sitesArray, 
      is_pro: isPro,
      limit: isPro ? PRO_LIMIT : FREE_LIMIT,
      total_sites: sitesArray.length,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[archive GET]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    // === VÃ‰RIFICATION (action 'check') ===
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, url, last_hash, last_content FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
        [url, userId]
      );
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;
      const oldContent = archive.rows[0].last_content || '';

      const scan = await scanPage(targetUrl);
      if (!scan) {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'error', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'error' });
      }

      if (oldHash !== scan.hash) {
        const diffResult = generateDiff(oldContent, scan.text);
        await pool.query(
          `UPDATE web_archives 
           SET last_status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, 
               last_hash = $2, last_content = $3, scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 
           WHERE id = $4`,
          [JSON.stringify(diffResult), scan.hash, scan.text, url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified', changes: diffResult.changesCount });
      } else {
        await pool.query(
          "UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $1",
          [url]
        );
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // === AJOUT D'UN NOUVEAU SITE ===
    if (!isSafeUrl(url)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide ou non autorisÃ©e.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const urlObj = new URL(url);
    const siteRoot = `${urlObj.protocol}//${urlObj.hostname}`;

    // COMPTAGE PAR SITE (pas par page) : combien de sites distincts ?
    const sitesCountQuery = await pool.query(
      "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT site_root) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root IS NOT NULL",
      [userId]
    );
    const sitesCount = parseInt(sitesCountQuery.rows[0].count || 0);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? PRO_LIMIT : FREE_LIMIT;

    // VÃ©rifie si ce site existe dÃ©jÃ 
    const existingSite = await pool.query(
      "SELECT id FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root = $2 LIMIT 1",
      [userId, siteRoot]
    );

    if (existingSite.rows.length === 0 && sitesCount >= maxLimit) {
      return NextResponse.json({ 
        error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} sites max). Passez Ã  SCEAU PRO pour en ajouter plus.` 
      }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // Si le site existe dÃ©jÃ , on ajoute juste les nouvelles pages
    // Sinon, on crawle comme d'habitude

    let pages: string[] = [];
    const sitemapPages = await fetchSitemap(siteRoot);
    if (sitemapPages.length > 0) {
      pages = sitemapPages;
    } else {
      const rootHtml = await fetch(url, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
      }).then(r => r.ok ? r.text() : null).catch(() => null);

      if (!rootHtml) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site.' }, { status: 400 });
      }
      const internalLinks = extractInternalLinks(rootHtml, url);
      pages = [url, ...internalLinks.filter(l => l !== url)].slice(0, MAX_PAGES);
    }

    const scanResults = await Promise.all(pages.map(p => scanPage(p)));
    
    let insertedCount = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < pages.length; i++) {
      const pageUrl = pages[i];
      const pageData = scanResults[i];
      if (!pageData) continue;
      
      // VÃ©rifie si cette page existe dÃ©jÃ 
      const existing = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND url = $2",
        [userId, pageUrl]
      );
      
      if (existing.rows.length === 0) {
        await pool.query(`
          INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, site_root, title, last_hash, last_content, last_status, pages_scanned, scan_count)
          VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 'intact', $7, 1)
        `, [userId, pageUrl, siteRoot, pageData.title, pageData.hash, pageData.text, pages.length]);
        insertedCount++;
      }
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      pages_scanned: insertedCount,
      total_pages: pages.length,
      site_root: siteRoot,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[archive POST]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur serveur.' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    // Si c'est un site entier, on supprime toutes ses pages
    const site = await pool.query(
      "SELECT site_root FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2",
      [id, user.rows[0].id]
    );
    
    if (site.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });

    if (site.rows[0].site_root) {
      await pool.query(
        "DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND site_root = $2",
        [user.rows[0].id, site.rows[0].site_root]
      );
    } else {
      await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    }
    
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
