function PactModal({ pactId, onClose }: { pactId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [pact, setPact] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [isSigning, setIsSigning] = useState(false);
  const [justSealed, setJustSealed] = useState(false);
  
  const loadPact = () => fetch(`/api/pacts/${pactId}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => setPact(d));
  useEffect(() => { loadPact(); }, [pactId]);

  async function signPact() {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return alert("Connecte-toi.");
    
    setIsSigning(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/pacts/sign', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pact_id: pactId, pubkey }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    
    if (data.success) {
      if (data.isNowSealed) {
        fireConfetti();
        setJustSealed(true);
      }
      loadPact();
    } else {
      alert(data.error);
    }
    setIsSigning(false);
  }

  async function downloadCertificate() {
    if (!pact) return;
    setIsDownloading(true);
    const verifyUrl = `${window.location.origin}/o/${pact.id}`;
    const qrDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(verifyUrl, { width: 300, margin: 1 });
    generatePactCertificate(
      pact.title, pact.description, pact.creator, pact.signataires || [], 
      pact.hash_str || 'Hash en cours de calcul', qrDataUrl, pact.id
    );
    setIsDownloading(false);
  }

  if (!pact) return null;
  const myHandle = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
  const hasSigned = pact.signataires?.includes(myHandle);
  const isSealed = pact.status === 'scelle';

  if (justSealed) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="bg-[#FDF8F0] w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-8 border-4 border-[#E9C46A] shadow-2xl relative text-center">
           <div className="text-6xl mb-4">ğŸ†</div>
           <h2 className="text-3xl font-serif font-bold text-[#2C1810] mb-2">Pacte ScellÃ© !</h2>
           <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-6">L'empreinte de ce contrat a Ã©tÃ© gravÃ©e sur Bitcoin pour l'Ã©ternitÃ©.</p>
           
           <div className="space-y-3">
             <a href={`/api/pacts/${pact.id}/ots`} download className="w-full block bg-[#5D7A3A] text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-[#4A6330] transition">
               TÃ©lÃ©charger la preuve .ots
             </a>
             <button onClick={downloadCertificate} disabled={isDownloading} className="w-full bg-[#E9C46A] text-[#2C1810] py-3 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-[#F4D03F] transition">
               {isDownloading ? 'GÃ©nÃ©ration...' : 'TÃ©lÃ©charger le Certificat PDF'}
             </button>
             <button onClick={onClose} className="w-full py-2 font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 transition">
               Fermer
             </button>
           </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const progress = Math.min(100, ((pact.signataires?.length || 0) / pact.required_signatures) * 100);

  return (

        {isSealed && (
          <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full bg-[#E9C46A] text-[#2C1810] py-1.5 rounded-t-2xl text-center text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">
            Contrat ScellÃ© sur Bitcoin
          </div>
        )}

                  <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">Empreinte SHA-256</p>

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

type Message = {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
  sources?: any[];
  captures?: number;
};

export default function OraclePage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  async function ask() {
    if (!url.trim() || !question.trim()) return;
    if (!pubkey) { setError('Connecte-toi pour utiliser Oracle.'); return; }

    setError('');
    const userMsg: Message = { role: 'user', content: question };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setQuestion('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/oracle/ask', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url: url.trim(), question }),
      });

      const d = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(d.error || 'Erreur');
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: `âŒ ${d.error}` }]);
      } else {
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, {
          role: 'assistant',
          content: d.answer,
          sources: d.sources,
          captures: d.captures_used,
        }]);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Erreur rÃ©seau');
    }
    setLoading(false);
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 md:pb-6 max-w-3xl mx-auto font-sans w-full min-h-screen flex flex-col">
      
      <div className="mb-6">

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export default function AccessLogModal({ sealId, onClose }: { sealId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('recent');

  useEffect(() => {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setLoading(true);
    fetch(`/api/seal/${sealId}/access-log?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey || '')}&search=${search}&sort=${sort}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { setEntries(d.entries || []); setLoading(false); });
  }, [sealId, search, sort]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { generatePortfolioPDF } from '@/lib/pdf';
import AccessLogModal from './AccessLogModal';

export default function Profil() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('public');

  const [showPortfolioModal, setShowPortfolioModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSeals, setSelectedSeals] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [accessLogSealId, setAccessLogSealId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showAccessLogList, setShowAccessLogList] = useState(false);
  const [showTechProofs, setShowTechProofs] = useState(false);
  const [refreshingId, setRefreshingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function loadProfil() {
    const handle = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');

    // Le pseudo est nÃ©cessaire pour retrouver le profil.
    if (!handle || !handle.trim()) {
      router.replace('/login');
      return;
    }

    setError('');

    try {
      const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle.trim())}${pubkey ? `&pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}` : ''}`,
        { cache: 'no-store' }
      );

      const d = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(
          res.status === 404
            ? "Profil introuvable. VÃ©rifie ton pseudo ou reconnecte-toi."
            : (d.error || "Impossible de charger le profil.")
        );
        return;
      }

      if (d.handle) {
        setData({
          ...d,
          seals: d.seals || [],
          badges: d.badges || [],
          favorites: d.favorites || [],
          projects: d.projects || []
        });
      } else {
        setError("Les donnÃ©es du profil sont incomplÃ¨tes.");
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("Erreur chargement profil :", e);
      setError("Erreur serveur. RÃ©essaie dans quelques instants.");
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    loadProfil();
  }, [router]);

  const openPortfolioModal = () => {
    setShowPortfolioModal(true);
    setSelectedSeals(data.seals.map((s: any) => s.id));
    setFilterType('all');
    setStartDate('');
    setEndDate('');
  };

  const applyFilters = (type: string, start: string, end: string) => {
    let filtered = data.seals;
    if (type !== 'all') {
      if (type === 'flash') filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => s.is_flash);
      else filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => s.visibility === type && !s.is_flash);
    }
    if (start) filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp) >= new Date(start));
    if (end) filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp) <= new Date(end));
    setSelectedSeals(filtered.map((s: any) => s.id));
  };

  const handleTypeChange = (type: string) => { setFilterType(type); applyFilters(type, startDate, endDate); };
  const handleStartDate = (date: string) => { setStartDate(date); applyFilters(filterType, date, endDate); };
  const handleEndDate = (date: string) => { setEndDate(date); applyFilters(filterType, startDate, date); };

  const toggleSeal = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedSeals.includes(id)) setSelectedSeals(selectedSeals.filter(sid => sid !== id));
    else setSelectedSeals([...selectedSeals, id]);
  };

  const generatePDF = () => {
    const sealsToInclude = data.seals.filter((s: any) => selectedSeals.includes(s.id));
    if (sealsToInclude.length === 0) return alert("SÃ©lectionne au moins une Å“uvre !");
    generatePortfolioPDF(data.handle, sealsToInclude, startDate, endDate, data.is_pro);
    setShowPortfolioModal(false);
  };

  async function changeVisibility(sealId: string, newVisibility: string) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    await fetch('/api/seal/update-visibility', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ seal_id: sealId, pubkey, visibility: newVisibility })

    } catch (e) {}

'use client';
import { useState, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

function ResetForm() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const token = searchParams.get('token');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  async function handleReset() {
    if (!password) return setStatus('Mot de passe requis');
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/reset-password', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ token, newPassword: password }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      setStatus('âœ… Mot de passe modifiÃ© !');
      setTimeout(() => router.push('/login'), 1500);
    } else setStatus('âŒ ' + data.error);
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#FFFCF7] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[#EFE0CA] shadow-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 font-serif">Nouveau mot de passe</h1>
      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <input type={show ? "text" : "password"} placeholder="Nouveau mot de passe" className="w-full border-2 border-[#EFE0CA] p-3 rounded-xl pr-10" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <button onClick={() => setShow(!show)} className="absolute right-3 top-3">{show ? "ğŸ™ˆ" : "ğŸ‘ï¸"}</button>
      </div>
      <button onClick={handleReset} className="w-full bg-[#2C1810] text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-bold">Valider</button>
      {status && <p className="mt-4 text-center font-bold">{status}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ResetPassword() {
  return <Suspense fallback={<div>Chargement...</div>}><ResetForm /></Suspense>;
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/seal/page.tsx

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, Suspense } from 'react';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';

function SealContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const isPactMode = searchParams.get('pact') === 'true';
  const chatId = searchParams.get('chat_id');
  const chatType = searchParams.get('chat_type');
  const challengeIdParam = searchParams.get('challenge_id');

  const [isFlashMode, setIsFlashMode] = useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'file' | 'text' | 'media' | 'audio' | 'project'>(
    (searchParams.get('mode') === 'project' ? 'project' : 'file') as any
  );
  const [projectFiles, setProjectFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('');
  const [textContent, setTextContent] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pactFiles, setPactFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState('public');
  const [isHosted, setIsHosted] = useState(true);
  const [isMystery, setIsMystery] = useState(false);
  
  const [unlockLikes, setUnlockLikes] = useState(10);
  const [revealAt, setRevealAt] = useState('');
  const [requiredSignatures, setRequiredSignatures] = useState(2);
  const [pactTheme, setPactTheme] = useState('serieux');

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [sealedResult, setSealedResult] = useState<any>(null);

  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  async function startRecording() {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        setFile(new File([audioBlob], `audio-${Date.now()}.webm`, { type: 'audio/webm' }));
        setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob));
      };
      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
    } catch { setStatus(" Impossible d'accÃ©der au micro."); }
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSeal() {
    setStatus('');

    if (!title.trim()) return setStatus(" Un titre est requis");
    if (mode === 'project' && projectFiles.length === 0) return setStatus(" SÃ©lectionne des fichiers pour ton projet");
    if (isPactMode && pactFiles.length === 0) return setStatus(" Ajoute au moins un fichier au pacte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'text' && !textContent.trim()) return setStatus(" Ã‰cris ton texte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'file' && !file) return setStatus(" Choisis un fichier Ã  sceller");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'media' && !file) return setStatus(" Prends une photo ou une vidÃ©o");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'audio' && !file) return setStatus(" Enregistre un audio");

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "PrÃ©paration du pacte..." : "Calcul de l'empreinte...");
    try {
      let hashContent: Uint8Array;
      let projectManifest: any[] = [];
      let merkleRoot = '';

      if (mode === 'project') {
        // On calcule les hashs de tous les fichiers localement
        for (const f of projectFiles) {
          const buf = await f.arrayBuffer();
          const h = sha256(new Uint8Array(buf));
          const hB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...h));
          projectManifest.push({ name: f.name, hash: hB64, size: f.size });
        }
        merkleRoot = buildMerkleRoot(projectManifest.map(m => m.hash));
        // Le hash principal du sceau (pour l'affichage) sera le Merkle Root
        hashContent = new Uint8Array(Array.from(atob(merkleRoot), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
      } else if (isPactMode) {
        const metaString = `${title}-${desc}-${pactFiles.map(f => f.name).join(',')}`;
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(metaString));
      } else if (mode === 'text') {
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(textContent));
      } else {
        if (!file) return setStatus(" Fichier manquant");
        hashContent = sha256(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()));
      }

      let hashStr = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < hashContent.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hashContent[i]);
      if (mode === 'project') {
        await sendToServer(merkleRoot, merkleRoot, projectManifest);
      } else {
        await sendToServer(btoa(hashStr));
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus(" Erreur de gravure : " + (e?.message || 'inconnue'));
    }
  }

  async function sendToServer(hashB64: string, merkleRoot?: string, projectManifest?: any[]) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return setStatus(" Connecte-toi d'abord !");

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('hash', hashB64);
    formData.append('title', title);
    formData.append('description', mode === 'text' ? textContent : desc);
    formData.append('pubkey', pubkey);

    let endpoint = '/api/seal';

    if (mode === 'project') {
      endpoint = '/api/projects';
      formData.append('isHosted', isHosted.toString());
      formData.append('merkle_root', merkleRoot as string); // On ajoute le root calculÃ© client
      formData.append('manifest', JSON.stringify(projectManifest || []));
      projectFiles.forEach(f => formData.append('files', f));
    } else if (isPactMode) {
      endpoint = '/api/pacts/create';
      formData.append('group_id', chatType === 'group' ? (chatId as string) : '');
      formData.append('required_signatures', requiredSignatures.toString());
      formData.append('theme', pactTheme);
      pactFiles.forEach(f => formData.append('files', f));
    } else {
      formData.append('isFlash', isFlashMode.toString());
      formData.append('visibility', visibility);
      formData.append('isMystery', isMystery.toString());
      formData.append('isEphemeral', 'false');
      formData.append('unlockLikes', unlockLikes.toString());
      formData.append('reveal_at', revealAt);
      formData.append('isHosted', isHosted.toString());
      if (challengeIdParam) formData.append('challenge_id', challengeIdParam);
      if (mode !== 'text' && file) formData.append('file', file);
    }

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "Envoi du pacte..." : "Ancrage dans la blockchain (max 8s)â€¦");

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));

      if (!res.ok) {
        return setStatus(" " + (data?.error || `Erreur serveur (${res.status})`));
      }

      if (isPactMode) {
        const msg = `[PACTE]${data.id}|${data.title}`;
        if (chatType === 'dm') {
          await fetch('/api/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), receiver_handle: chatId, content: msg }) });
        } else {
          await fetch('/api/groups/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ group_id: chatId, sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), content: msg }) });
        }
        window.location.href = '/messages';
      } else {
        setStatus(" ScellÃ© !");
        setSealedResult({ title, hash: hashB64, date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR'), isFlash: isFlashMode, ots: !!data.ots_secured });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus(" Erreur rÃ©seau : " + (e?.message || 'impossible de contacter le serveur'));
    }
  }

  if (sealedResult) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 font-sans text-center flex flex-col items-center max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="text-6xl mb-4">{sealedResult.isFlash ? 'âš¡' : ''}</div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>C'est gravÃ©.</h1>
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] w-full text-left shadow-sm mt-6">
          <h3 className="font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{sealedResult.title}</h3>
          <p className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono break-all text-[var(--text-muted)] bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-2 rounded border border-[var(--border-color)]">{sealedResult.hash}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-right mt-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">ScellÃ© le {sealedResult.date}</p>
          {sealedResult.ots && <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-[#5D7A3A] font-bold"> Preuve horodatÃ©e</p>}
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="mt-8 bg-[#2C1810] text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full">Sceller une autre Å“uvre</button>
        <Link href="/feed" className="mt-3 border border-[var(--border-soft)] text-[var(--text-main)] p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full text-center">Voir le Feed</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 font-sans max-w-md md:max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full">

      {/* === ONGLETS SCeller / VÃ©rifier === */}
      {!isPactMode && (
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
          <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
            <Link href="/seal" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]">Sceller</Link>
            <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>VÃ©rifier</Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="text-center mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
          {isPactMode ? "Nouveau Pacte." : (isFlashMode ? "Flash." : "L'Atelier.")}
        </h1>
      </div>

      {/* === Toggle Normal / Flash === */}
      {!isPactMode && (
        <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl mb-4 border border-[var(--border-color)]">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setIsFlashMode(false); setMode('file'); setIsHosted(true); setVisibility('public'); }} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition ${!isFlashMode ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Standard</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setIsFlashMode(true); setIsHosted(false); setVisibility('private'); }} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition ${isFlashMode ? 'bg-[#2C1810] text-white shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Mode Flash</button>
        </div>

        {/* === SÃ©lecteur de mode === */}
        {!isPactMode && (
          <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('file')} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${mode === 'file' ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Fichier</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('text')} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${mode === 'text' ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Texte</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('media')} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${mode === 'media' ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Image</button>

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Settings() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');

  const [oldHandle, setOldHandle] = useState('');
  const [newHandle, setNewHandle] = useState('');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState('createur');
  const [openToCollab, setOpenToCollab] = useState(false);
  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState('');
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState('');
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState('');
  const [identityCount, setIdentityCount] = useState(0);
  const [identityHistory, setIdentityHistory] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [pubkey, setPubkey] = useState('');
  const [apiKeys, setApiKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [newKeyName, setNewKeyName] = useState('');
  const [generatedKey, setGeneratedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isGeneratingKey, setIsGeneratingKey] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const p = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!h || !p) { router.push('/login'); return; }

    setOldHandle(h);
    setNewHandle(h);
    setPubkey(p);

    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(p)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        if (d.handle) {
          setBio(d.bio || '');
          setRole(d.role || 'createur');
          setOpenToCollab(d.open_to_collaboration === true);
          setFirstName(d.first_name || '');
          setLastName(d.last_name || '');
          setBirthDate(d.birth_date ? d.birth_date.split('T')[0] : '');
          setIdentityCount(d.identity_changes_count || 0);
          setIdentityHistory(d.identity_history || []);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [router]);

  async function saveProfile() {
    setSaving(true); setMsg('');
    const res = await fetch('/api/profil/update', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        pubkey,
        old_handle: oldHandle,
        new_handle: newHandle,
        bio,
        role,
        open_to_collaboration: openToCollab,
        first_name: firstName,
        last_name: lastName,
        birth_date: birthDate,
      }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();

    if (res.ok) {
      setMsg('âœ… Profil mis Ã  jour !');
      localStorage.setItem('sceau_handle', data.new_handle);
      setOldHandle(data.new_handle);
    } else {
      setMsg('âŒ ' + data.error);
    }
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function loadApiKeys() {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
    if (res.ok) {
      const d = await res.json();
      setApiKeys(d.keys || []);
    }
  }

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pubkey) loadApiKeys();
  }, [pubkey]);

  async function generateApiKey() {
    if (!newKeyName.trim()) return alert("Donne un nom Ã  ta clÃ© (ex: WordPress, GitHub)");
    setIsGeneratingKey(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/api-keys', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, name: newKeyName })
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      setGeneratedKey(data.key);
      setNewKeyName('');
      loadApiKeys();
    } else {
      alert('Erreur: ' + data.error);
    }
    setIsGeneratingKey(false);
  }

  async function revokeApiKey(id: string) {
    if (!confirm('Voulez-vous vraiment rÃ©voquer cette clÃ© ? Les plugins qui l\'utilisent cesseront de fonctionner.')) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}&id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    if (res.ok) loadApiKeys();
    else alert('Erreur lors de la rÃ©vocation');
  }

  function logout() {
    localStorage.clear();
    router.push('/login');
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono">Chargement...</div>;

  return (

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ed25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Signup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  async function handleSignup() {
    if (!handle || !email || !password) return setStatus("Tous les champs sont requis");
    setStatus("CrÃ©ation en cours...");
    
    try {
      const secret = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
      const pubkey = ed25519.getPublicKey(secret);
      let pubkeyStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < pubkey.length; i++) pubkeyStr += String.fromCharCode(pubkey[i]);
      let secretStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < secret.length; i++) secretStr += String.fromCharCode(secret[i]);
      const pubkeyB64 = btoa(pubkeyStr);

      localStorage.setItem('sceau_secret', btoa(secretStr));

      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/signup', { 
        method: 'POST', 
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, 
        body: JSON.stringify({ handle, email, password, pubkey: pubkeyB64 }) 
      });
      
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (res.ok) {
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_pubkey', pubkeyB64);
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_handle', handle);
        setStatus("âœ… Compte crÃ©Ã© !");
        setTimeout(() => router.push('/feed'), 500);
      } else {
        setStatus("âŒ " + (data.error || "Une erreur est survenue"));
      }
    } catch (e) { setStatus("âŒ Impossible de contacter le serveur. VÃ©rifiez votre connexion."); }
  }

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSignup(); };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 font-serif" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>CrÃ©er un compte</h1>
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Pseudo</label>
      <input type="text" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={handle} onChange={(e) => setHandle(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Email</label>
      <input type="email" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Mot de passe</label>
      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <input type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl pr-10 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)} className="absolute right-3 top-3 opacity-50">{showPassword ? "ğŸ™ˆ" : "ğŸ‘ï¸"}</button>
      </div>
      
      <button onClick={handleSignup} className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E76F51] to-[#F4A261] text-white p-4 rounded-xl font-bold">S'inscrire</button>
      {status && <p className="mt-4 text-center font-bold text-[#E76F51]">{status}</p>}
      
      <p className="text-center mt-4 text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">DÃ©jÃ  un compte ? <Link href="/login" className="underline font-bold">Se connecter</Link></p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link'; // L'IMPORT MANQUANT EST ICI
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export default function Verify() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('file');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [titleQuery, setTitleQuery] = useState('');
  
  const [timelineData, setTimelineData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [timelineLoading, setTimelineLoading] = useState(true);
  const [timelineMode, setTimelineMode] = useState<'live' | 'period'>('live');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'timeline') return;
    const fetchTimeline = () => {
      setTimelineLoading(true);
      const url = timelineMode === 'live' 
        ? '/api/verify/timeline?live=true'
        : `/api/verify/timeline?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}`;
        
      fetch(url).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
        setTimelineData(data.timeline || []);
        setTimelineLoading(false);
      });
    };
    fetchTimeline();
    if (timelineMode === 'live') {
      const interval = setInterval(fetchTimeline, 5000);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [tab, timelineMode, startDate, endDate]);

  async function verifyFile(file: File) {
    setLoading(true);
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const hash = sha256(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: btoa(hashStr) }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function verifyHash(input: string) {
    if(!input) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: input }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function searchByTitle() {
    if(!titleQuery) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: titleQuery }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return "Ã€ l'instant";
    if (diff === 1) return "Il y a 1 minute";
    if (diff < 60) return `Il y a ${diff} minutes`;
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR');
  };

  return (

        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('hash');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='hash'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Hash</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('title');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='title'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Titre</button>

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);

  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setHandle(h);

    if (!pubkey) { setLoading(false); return; }

    // Profil
    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { if (d.handle) setProfile(d); })
      .catch(() => {});

    // ActivitÃ© (rafraÃ®chie toutes les 30s)
    const fetchActivity = () => {
      fetch(`/api/profil/activity?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setActivities(d.activities || []))
        .catch(() => {});
    };
    fetchActivity();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchActivity, 30000);

      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => setPendingPacts(d.count || 0))

=========================================
FICHIER : ./src/db/pool.ts
=========================================

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { requireDb } from '@/lib/env';

let _pool: Pool | null = null;

function create(): Pool {
  const url = requireDb();
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: url,
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: true },
  });
  pool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[pg] idle client error:', err.message);
  });
  return pool;
}

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!_pool) _pool = create();
  return _pool;
}

// Compat : `import { pool } from '@/db/pool'` continue de fonctionner.
export const pool = new Proxy({} as Pool, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getPool() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

FICHIER : ./src/db/schema.sql

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  email TEXT UNIQUE,
  password_hash TEXT,
  pubkey BYTEA NOT NULL,
  recovery_email TEXT,
  reset_token TEXT,
  reset_expiry TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS seals (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  hash BYTEA NOT NULL,
  timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  author_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),
  title TEXT,
  description TEXT,
  category TEXT DEFAULT 'Art',
  is_public BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  is_hosted BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  file_path TEXT,
  file_size INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  CONSTRAINT unique_seal UNIQUE (hash, author_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  sender_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  receiver_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  content TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS likes (

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function isDbError(e: any): boolean {
  const code = e?.code;
  if (['ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ETIMEDOUT', '28P01', '3D000', '57P01'].includes(code)) return true;
  return /ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|timeout|connect.*pool|database/i.test(String(e?.message || ''));
}

export function apiError(e: unknown, fallback = 'Erreur serveur'): NextResponse {
  if (isDbError(e)) {
    console.error('[api-error] base injoignable :', (e as any)?.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Base de donnÃ©es injoignable. RÃ©essayez dans un instant.' },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
  console.error('[api-error]', e);
  return NextResponse.json({ error: fallback }, { status: 500 });
}

// Validation centralisÃ©e des variables d'environnement.
// Ã‰choue TÃ”T avec un message clair au lieu de produire `undefined/undefined/clÃ©`.

function clean(v: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  return v.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
}

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = clean(process.env[name]);
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Variable d'environnement manquante ou vide : ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function optional(name: string, def = ''): string {
  return clean(process.env[name]) ?? def;
}

export function requireS3(): { endpoint: string; bucket: string; region: string } {
  const endpoint = required('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = required('S3_BUCKET').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const region = optional('AWS_REGION', 'us-west-004');
  return { endpoint, bucket, region };
}

export function requireDb(): string {
  return required('DATABASE_URL');
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}

// En-tÃªte .ots complet (31 octets) :
// \x00 + "OpenTimestamps" (14) + \x00\x00 + "Proof" (5) + \x00 + 8 octets magiques
const HEADER_MAGIC = Buffer.from(
  '004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e89294',
  'hex'
);

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

const CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

export type OtsResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  // Si le calendar a renvoyÃ© une preuve partielle sans header, on l'encapsule proprement
  const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash);
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    hashBuffer,
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

  const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'portrait', unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' });
  
  // Fond
  doc.setFillColor(253, 248, 240);
  doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');

  doc.setLineWidth(2);

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(24);
  doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
  doc.text("CERTIFICAT D'INTÃ‰GRITÃ‰", 105, 30, { align: 'center' });
  
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(122, 90, 58);
  doc.text("Dossier Miroir (Arbre de Merkle)", 105, 40, { align: 'center' });

  doc.setFontSize(14);
  doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
  doc.text(`Projet : ${title}`, 20, 55);
  doc.text(`CrÃ©ateur : @${author}`, 20, 63);
  doc.text(`Date de scellement : ${new Date(date).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`, 20, 71);

  doc.setFont('courier', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.text("EMPREINTE RACINE (MERKLE ROOT) :", 20, 85);
  
  const chunks = merkleRoot.match(/.{1,50}/g) || [merkleRoot];
  doc.setFont('courier', 'normal');
  chunks.forEach((chunk, i) => {
    doc.text(chunk, 20, 91 + i * 5);
  });

  // Liste des fichiers
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.text("FICHIERS INCLUS :", 20, 115);
  
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  let y = 122;
  files.slice(0, 30).forEach((f) => {
    if (y > 270) return; // Limite de page
    doc.text(`- ${f.file_name}`, 20, y);
    doc.text(`  Hash: ${f.file_hash.slice(0, 20)}...`, 25, y + 4);
    y += 10;
  });

  if (files.length > 30) {
    doc.text(`... et ${files.length - 30} autres fichiers.`, 20, y + 5);
  }

  doc.save(`Projet-${title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-')}.pdf`);
}

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

FICHIER : ./src/lib/robots.ts

// Cache mÃ©moire des robots.txt (TTL 1h)
const cache = new Map<string, { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean; expires: number }>();
const TTL = 3600_000;

export async function isAllowedByRobots(url: string, userAgent = 'SCEAU-Bot'): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    const root = `${u.protocol}//${u.hostname}`;
    const cached = cache.get(root);
    if (cached && cached.expires > Date.now()) {
      return evaluate(cached, u.pathname, userAgent);
    }

    const res = await fetch(`${root}/robots.txt`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': userAgent },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      // Pas de robots.txt = tout autorisÃ©
      const entry = { rules: [], allowAll: true, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
      cache.set(root, entry);
      return true;
    }

    const text = await res.text();
    const lines = text.split('\n').map(l => l.trim());
    const rules: string[] = [];
    let inOurSection = false;
    let allowAll = false;

    for (const line of lines) {
      if (line.startsWith('#') || !line) continue;
      const [key, ...rest] = line.split(':');
      const k = key.trim().toLowerCase();
      const v = rest.join(':').trim();
      
      if (k === 'user-agent') {
        inOurSection = v === '*' || v.toLowerCase().includes('sceau');
        if (inOurSection && v === '*') allowAll = true;
      } else if (inOurSection && (k === 'disallow' || k === 'allow')) {
        rules.push(`${k}:${v}`);
      }
    }

    const entry = { rules, allowAll, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
    cache.set(root, entry);
    return evaluate(entry, u.pathname, userAgent);
  } catch {
    // Erreur rÃ©seau : on refuse par prudence
    return false;
  }
}

function evaluate(entry: { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean }, path: string, _ua: string): boolean {
  // RÃ¨gles les plus longues d'abord (spÃ©cifiques)
  const sorted = [...entry.rules].sort((a, b) => {
    const al = a.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    const bl = b.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    return bl - al;
  });

  for (const rule of sorted) {
    const [type, pattern] = rule.split(':');
    if (!pattern) {
      if (type === 'disallow') return false;
      continue;
    }
    const regex = new RegExp('^' + pattern.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*/g, '.*'));
    if (regex.test(path)) {
      return type === 'allow';
    }
  }

  return true; // Par dÃ©faut, autorisÃ©
}

// Module unique de tÃ©lÃ©chargement pour Archive, Cron et Oracle.
// RÃ¨gles : HTTPS only, pas d'IP internes, robots.txt, timeout, taille max, redirections validÃ©es.

import { isAllowedByRobots } from './robots';

const USER_AGENT = 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0 (+https://sceau-app.vercel.app)';
const TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;

function isPrivateIp(hostname: string): boolean {
  const h = hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1' || h === '0.0.0.0') return true;
  if (/^10\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^192\.168\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^169\.254\./.test(h)) return true;
  if (/^fc00:/i.test(h) || /^fe80:/i.test(h)) return true;
  return false;
}

function isSafeProtocol(url: URL): boolean {
  return url.protocol === 'https:';
}

export type FetchResult =
  | { ok: true; html: string; finalUrl: string; statusCode: number }
  | { ok: false; error: string; statusCode?: number };

export async function safeFetch(inputUrl: string): Promise<FetchResult> {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(inputUrl);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL invalide' };
  }

  if (!isSafeProtocol(url)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'HTTPS obligatoire' };
  }

  if (isPrivateIp(url.hostname)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Adresse interne interdite' };
  }

  if (url.username || url.password) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL avec identifiants interdite' };
  }

  // VÃ©rifie robots.txt
  const allowed = await isAllowedByRobots(url.toString(), USER_AGENT);
  if (!allowed) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'BloquÃ© par robots.txt' };
  }

  let currentUrl = url.toString();
  let redirects = 0;

  while (redirects <= MAX_REDIRECTS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(currentUrl, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': USER_AGENT, 'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        redirect: 'manual',
      });

      // GÃ¨re les redirections manuellement
      if (res.status >= 300 && res.status < 400) {
        const location = res.headers.get('location');
        if (!location) return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection sans location', statusCode: res.status };
        
        const nextUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
        if (!isSafeProtocol(nextUrl) || isPrivateIp(nextUrl.hostname)) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection vers destination interdite', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        currentUrl = nextUrl.toString();
        redirects++;
        continue;
      }

      if (!res.ok) {
        return { ok: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}`, statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // VÃ©rifie Content-Length
      const contentLength = res.headers.get('content-length');
      if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > MAX_BYTES) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // Lit en streaming avec limite
      const reader = res.body?.getReader();
      if (!reader) return { ok: false, error: 'Pas de body', statusCode: res.status };

      let bytes = 0;
      const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        bytes += value.byteLength;
        if (bytes > MAX_BYTES) {
          reader.cancel();
          return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        chunks.push(value);
      }

      const html = new TextDecoder().decode(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      return { ok: true, html, finalUrl: currentUrl, statusCode: res.status };
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.name === 'TimeoutError' || e?.name === 'AbortError') {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Timeout' };
      }
      return { ok: false, error: e?.message || 'Erreur rÃ©seau' };
    }
  }

  return { ok: false, error: 'Trop de redirections' };
}

export function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  return html
    .replace(/<script\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/script>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<style\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/style>/gim, '')
    .replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '\n')
    .replace(/\n\s*\n/g, '\n')
    .trim();
}

export function extractTitle(html: string, fallbackUrl: string): string {
  const t = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  if (t?.[1]) {
    const clean = t[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 200) return clean;
  }
  const h1 = html.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);
  if (h1?.[1]) {
    const clean = h1[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 100) return clean;
  }
  try {
    const u = new URL(fallbackUrl);
    return u.pathname === '/' ? u.hostname : `${u.hostname}${u.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return fallbackUrl;
  }
}

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

<?php
class SceauClient {
    private $apiUrl = "https://sceau-app.vercel.app/api/v1/public/seal";

    public function sealFile($filePath) {
        $cFile = new CURLFile($filePath);
        $data = array('file' => $cFile);
        
        $ch = curl_init();
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_URL, $this->apiUrl);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POST, 1);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS, $data);
        curl_setopt($ch, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
        
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        
        return json_decode($response, true);
    }
}
?>

        self.api_url = api_url

    def seal_file(self, file_path):
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            response = requests.post(self.api_url, files={'file': f})
        return response.json()

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { writeFile, mkdir } from 'fs/promises';
import { join } from 'path';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const hash = data.get('hash') as string;
    const title = data.get('title') as string;
    const description = data.get('description') as string;
    const category = data.get('category') as string;
    const isHosted = data.get('isHosted') === 'true';
    const isPublic = data.get('isPublic') === 'true';
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const file = data.get('file') as File;

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const authorId = user.rows[0].id;

    let filePath = null;
    if (isHosted && file) {
      const bytes = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const buffer = Buffer.from(bytes);
      const filename = hash.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 20) + '-' + file.name;
      const dir = join(process.cwd(), 'public/uploads');
      await mkdir(dir, { recursive: true });
      await writeFile(join(dir, filename), buffer);
      filePath = '/uploads/' + filename;
    }

    const protocolRes = await fetch('http://localhost:8080/v1/seal', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash, title }) });
    const protocolData = await protocolRes.json();

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO seals (hash, timestamp, author_id, title, description, category, is_public, is_hosted, file_path) VALUES (decode($1, 'base64'), $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)",
      [hash, protocolData.timestamp, authorId, title, description, category, isPublic, isHosted, filePath]
    );
    return NextResponse.json(protocolData);
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

      formData.append('isPublic', isPublic.toString());

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export default function Verify() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('file');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function verifyFile(file: File) {
    setLoading(true);
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const hash = sha256(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: btoa(hashStr) }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function verifyHash(input: string) {
    if(!input) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: input }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-serif mb-2 text-center">VÃ©rifier.</h1>

      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Collez le hash (ex: b2e7...)" className="w-full border-2 border-[#EFE0CA] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none font-mono" onChange={e=>verifyHash(e.target.value)} />

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { safeFetch, extractTitle } from '@/lib/safe-fetcher';
import { cleanHtmlToText, CLEANER_VERSION } from '@/lib/html-cleaner';
import { ensureArchiveSchema, hashText, scanArchive, type ArchiveRow, type ScanOutcome } from '@/lib/archive-scan';
import { apiError } from '@/lib/api-error';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';
export const maxDuration = 30;

type Row = {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  site_root: string | null;
  title: string | null;
  status: string | null;
  last_checked_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  scan_count: number | null;
  ai_summary: string | null;
};

type ChangeRow = {
  archive_id: string;
  detected_at: string;
  ai_summary: string | null;
  diff_data: { details?: { type: string; text: string }[] } | null;
  url: string;
  title: string | null;
};

function originOf(url: string): string {
  try {
    return new URL(url).origin;
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

async function getUser(pubkey: string) {
  const r = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
  return r.rows[0] as { id: string; is_pro: boolean } | undefined;
}

// GET : liste Ã  plat (`archives`, utilisÃ©e par /archive) ET regroupÃ©e par site (`sites`, utilisÃ©e par /archive/[id])
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await getUser(pubkey);
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    await ensureArchiveSchema();

    const rowsQ = await pool.query(
      `SELECT id, url, site_root, title, COALESCE(last_status, status, 'intact') AS status,
              last_checked_at, created_at, scan_count, ai_summary
       FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at ASC`,
      [user.id]
    );
    const rows = rowsQ.rows as Row[];

    // Historique des changements (derniers 200)
    let changes: ChangeRow[] = [];
    try {
      const cq = await pool.query(
        `SELECT c.archive_id, c.detected_at, c.ai_summary, c.diff_data, a.url, a.title
         FROM web_archive_changes c JOIN web_archives a ON a.id = c.archive_id
         WHERE a.user_id = $1 ORDER BY c.detected_at DESC LIMIT 200`,
        [user.id]
      );
      changes = cq.rows as ChangeRow[];
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[archive] historique indisponible :', (e as Error).message);
    }

    // Regroupement par site : la racine est la page dont l'URL est la racine du site, sinon la plus ancienne
    const groups = new Map<string, Row[]>();
    for (const r of rows) {
      const key = r.site_root || originOf(r.url);
      const list = groups.get(key) || [];
      list.push(r);
      groups.set(key, list);
    }

    const sites = [...groups.entries()].map(([siteRoot, pages]) => {
      const root =
        pages.find((p) => p.url.replace(/\/+$/, '') === siteRoot.replace(/\/+$/, '')) || pages[0];
      const ids = new Set(pages.map((p) => p.id));
      const siteChanges = changes.filter((c) => ids.has(c.archive_id)).slice(0, 20);
      const lastChecked = pages
        .map((p) => p.last_checked_at)
        .filter((d): d is string => !!d)
        .sort()
        .pop();

      return {
        root_id: root.id,
        site_root: siteRoot,
        main_title: (() => {
          try {
            return new URL(siteRoot).hostname;
          } catch {
            return root.title || siteRoot;
          }
        })(),
        children_count: pages.length - 1,
        children_modified: pages.filter((p) => p.status === 'modified').length,
        scan_count: Math.max(...pages.map((p) => p.scan_count || 0)),
        last_checked_at: lastChecked || root.created_at,
        pages: pages.map((p) => ({
          id: p.id,
          url: p.url,
          title: p.title,
          status: p.status,
          is_root: p.id === root.id,
          last_checked_at: p.last_checked_at,
        })),
        recent_changes: siteChanges.map((c) => {
          const d = c.diff_data?.details || [];
          return {
            page_id: c.archive_id,
            page_url: c.url,
            page_title: c.title,
            changed_at: c.detected_at,
            ai_summary: c.ai_summary,
            preview: {
              removed: d.find((x) => x.type === 'removed')?.text ?? null,
              added: d.find((x) => x.type === 'added')?.text ?? null,
            },
          };
        }),
      };
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      archives: [...rows].reverse(), // plus rÃ©centes d'abord (liste /archive)
      sites,
      is_pro: user.is_pro,
      limit: user.is_pro ? 50 : 3,
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur');
  }
}

// POST : ajouter une URL, ou { action: 'check', url: <id>, scope?: 'site' } pour revÃ©rifier
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const body = (await req.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { pubkey?: string; url?: string; action?: string; scope?: string };
  const { pubkey, url, action, scope } = body;
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await getUser(pubkey);
    if (!user) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    await ensureArchiveSchema();

    // --- VÃ©rification (le champ `url` contient l'identifiant de l'archive, comme avant) ---
    if (action === 'check') {
      const one = await pool.query(
        `SELECT id, url, title, last_hash, last_content, clean_version, site_root FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
        [url, user.id]
      );
      if (one.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      const first = one.rows[0] as ArchiveRow & { site_root: string | null };

      let targets: ArchiveRow[] = [first];
      if (scope === 'site') {
        const root = first.site_root || originOf(first.url);
        const all = await pool.query(
          `SELECT id, url, title, last_hash, last_content, clean_version FROM web_archives
           WHERE user_id = $1 AND COALESCE(site_root, '') IN ($2, '') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 8`,
          [user.id, root]
        );
        const sameSite = (all.rows as ArchiveRow[]).filter((r) => originOf(r.url) === root || r.id === first.id);
        if (sameSite.length) targets = sameSite;
      }

      const results: ScanOutcome[] = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < targets.length; i += 4) {
        const part = await Promise.all(
          targets.slice(i, i + 4).map((t) =>
            scanArchive(t).catch((e): ScanOutcome => ({ id: t.id, url: t.url, status: 'error', error: (e as Error).message, logs: [] }))
          )
        );
        results.push(...part);
      }
      const modified = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'modified').length;
      const errors = results.filter((r) => r.status === 'error');

      if (errors.length === results.length) {
        return NextResponse.json({ error: `VÃ©rification impossible : ${errors[0].error}` }, { status: 502 });
      }
      return NextResponse.json({
        status: modified > 0 ? 'modified' : 'intact',
        scanned: results.length - errors.length,
        modified,
        errors: errors.length,
        results: results.map((r) => ({ id: r.id, status: r.status, summary: r.summary ?? null, error: r.error })),
      });
    }

    // --- Nouvelle URL ---
    let parsed: URL;
    try {
      parsed = new URL(url);
    } catch {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide' }, { status: 400 });
    }
    if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seules les adresses HTTPS sont acceptÃ©es (https://â€¦).' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const countQuery = await pool.query('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1', [user.id]);
    const maxLimit = user.is_pro ? 50 : 3;
    if (parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count, 10) >= maxLimit) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} URLs max). Passez Ã  SCEAU PRO pour en ajouter plus.` },
        { status: 403 }
      );
    }

    const dup = await pool.query('SELECT id FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 AND url = $2', [user.id, parsed.toString()]);
    if (dup.rows.length > 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cette URL est dÃ©jÃ  surveillÃ©e.' }, { status: 409 });

    const f = await safeFetch(parsed.toString());
    if (!f.ok) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Impossible de lire cette page : ${f.error}` }, { status: 400 });
    }
    const text = cleanHtmlToText(f.html);
    if (text.length < 20) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'Cette page ne contient pas de texte lisible (page vide, protÃ©gÃ©e, ou affichÃ©e uniquement par JavaScript).' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    const insert = await pool.query(
      `INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, site_root, title, last_hash, last_content, clean_version, last_status, status, scan_count)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, 'intact', 'intact', 1) RETURNING id`,
      [user.id, parsed.toString(), parsed.origin, extractTitle(f.html, parsed.toString()), hashText(text), text, CLEANER_VERSION]
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, id: insert.rows[0].id });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur lors du traitement');
  }
}

// DELETE : supprimer une URL
export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return apiError(e, 'Erreur');
  }
}

    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

      [user.rows[0].id]

// POST : GÃ©nÃ©rer une nouvelle clÃ©
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, name } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !name) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    // GÃ©nÃ©rer une clÃ© alÃ©atoire (sceau_live_ + 32 caractÃ¨res hexadÃ©cimaux)
    const rawKey = `sceau_live_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')}`;
    
    // On ne stocke que le hash SHA-256 de la clÃ© en base de donnÃ©es
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO api_keys (user_id, key_hash, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
      [user.rows[0].id, keyHash, name]
    );

    // On retourne la clÃ© EN CLAIR une seule fois. Elle ne sera plus jamais visible.
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, key: rawKey });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts
============================================================

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

const loginCache = new Map<string, { count: number, resetAt: number }>();

function checkLimit(ip: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  let e = loginCache.get(ip);
  if (!e || e.resetAt < now) { e = { count: 0, resetAt: now + 60000 }; loginCache.set(ip, e); }
  if (e.count >= 5) return false;
  e.count++;
  return true;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || 'unknown';
  if (!checkLimit(ip)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Trop de tentatives. RÃ©essayez dans 1 minute.' }, { status: 429 });

  try {
    const { email, password } = await req.json();

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.rows[0].password_hash);
    if (!isValid) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // On renvoie le handle et la clÃ© publique (convertie en base64)
    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle,
      pubkey: Buffer.from(user.rows[0].pubkey).toString('base64')
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { token, newPassword } = await req.json();
  if (!token || !newPassword) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs requis' }, { status: 400 });

  const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE reset_token = $1 AND reset_expiry > NOW()", [token]);
  if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Lien invalide ou expirÃ©' }, { status: 400 });

  const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10);
  const password_hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, salt);

  await pool.query("UPDATE users SET password_hash = $1, reset_token = NULL, reset_expiry = NULL WHERE id = $2", [password_hash, user.rows[0].id]);

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

    if (error.code === '23505') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Ce pseudo ou cet email est dÃ©jÃ  pris' }, { status: 409 });
    }
    // On renvoie le VRAI message d'erreur pour le dÃ©bogage

}

      SELECT e.id as entry_id, s.id as seal_id, s.title, s.description, s.file_path, s.category,

      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM challenge_votes WHERE entry_id = e.id) as votes
      FROM challenge_entries e
      JOIN seals s ON e.seal_id = s.id
      JOIN users u ON e.user_id = u.id

      ORDER BY votes DESC
    `, [id, challenge.rows[0].is_anonymous]);

    );
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });

}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { seal_id, pubkey, content } = await req.json();
  if (!seal_id || !pubkey || !content) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, handle FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const myId = user.rows[0].id;

    await pool.query("INSERT INTO comments (seal_id, user_id, content) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)", [seal_id, myId, content]);

      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });

}

    }

    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { r2Client } from '@/lib/r2';
import { PutObjectCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { safeKeyPart } from '@/lib/safe-key';
