function fireConfetti() {
  const colors = ['#E76F51', '#F4A261', '#E9C46A', '#2A9D8F', '#4A90C2'];
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.style.position = 'fixed'; el.style.width = '10px'; el.style.height = '10px';
    el.style.backgroundColor = colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    el.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + 'vw'; el.style.top = '-10px';
    el.style.borderRadius = Math.random() > 0.5 ? '50%' : '0';
    el.style.zIndex = '9999'; el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
    el.style.transition = `transform ${1 + Math.random() * 2}s ease-in, opacity ${1 + Math.random()}s ease-out`;
    document.body.appendChild(el);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      el.style.transform = `translateY(${window.innerHeight + 100}px) rotate(${Math.random() * 360}deg)`;
      el.style.opacity = '0';
    });
    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 3000);
  }
}

function PactMessage({ pactId, onOpen }: { pactId: string, onOpen: (id: string) => void }) {
  const [pact, setPact] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  
  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 8000);

    fetch(`/api/pacts/${pactId}`, { signal: controller.signal })
      .then(async (r) => {
        const data = await r.json();
        if (!r.ok) throw new Error(data.error || 'Erreur');
        return data;
      })
      .then(d => { if (isMounted) { setPact(d); clearTimeout(timeoutId); } })
      .catch(err => { if (isMounted) { setError(err.name === 'AbortError' ? 'DÃ©lai dÃ©passÃ©' : err.message); clearTimeout(timeoutId); } });

    return () => { isMounted = false; controller.abort(); clearTimeout(timeoutId); };
  }, [pactId]);

  if (error) return <div className="p-4 bg-[#FDF4F0] rounded-xl text-center text-xs font-mono my-2 border border-[#FCE0D6] text-[#C44A2E]">âŒ Impossible de charger le pacte ({error}).</div>;
  if (!pact) return <div className="p-4 bg-[var(--bg-main)] rounded-xl text-center text-xs font-mono my-2 border border-[var(--border-color)]">Chargement du pacte...</div>;

  const isSealed = pact.status === 'scelle';
  const progress = Math.min(100, ((pact.signataires?.length || 0) / pact.required_signatures) * 100);

  return (
    <div className={`w-full max-w-md bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border-2 rounded-xl p-4 my-2 shadow-sm ${isSealed ? 'border-[#E9C46A]' : 'border-[#4A90C2]'}`}>
      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
         <div>
           <h3 className="font-bold text-lg leading-tight" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{pact.title}</h3>
           <p className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Pacte de @{pact.creator}</p>
         </div>
         {isSealed && <span className="bg-[#E9C46A] text-[#2C1810] px-2 py-1 rounded text-[0.6rem] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">ScellÃ©</span>}
      </div>
      
      {pact.description && <p className="text-sm mb-3 italic" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>"{pact.description}"</p>}

      {pact.media_urls && pact.media_urls.length > 0 && (
        <div className="mb-4 space-y-1">
          <p className="text-[0.65rem] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>Documents joints</p>
          {pact.media_urls.map((url: string, i: number) => (
             <a key={i} href={url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-[#4A90C2] hover:underline bg-[#F0F6FC] p-2 rounded border border-[#C9D8E8]">
                PiÃ¨ce jointe {i+1}
             </a>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="mb-4">
         <div className="flex justify-between text-[0.65rem] font-bold mb-1" style={{ color: 'var(--text-muted)' }}>
           <span>Signatures</span>
           <span>{pact.signataires?.length || 0} / {pact.required_signatures}</span>
         </div>
         <div className="w-full bg-[var(--border-color)] rounded-full h-1.5 mb-2">
            <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-500 ${isSealed ? 'bg-[#E9C46A]' : 'bg-[#4A90C2]'}`} style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}></div>
         </div>
         <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
            {pact.signataires?.map((s: string) => (
              <span key={s} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] text-[var(--text-main)] text-[0.65rem] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-[var(--border-color)]">@{s}</span>
            ))}
         </div>
      </div>

      <button onClick={() => onOpen(pactId)} className={`w-full py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition ${isSealed ? 'bg-[var(--bg-main)] text-[var(--text-main)] hover:opacity-80' : 'bg-[#4A90C2] text-white hover:bg-[#2D6A9E]'}`}>
        {isSealed ? 'Voir le certificat' : 'Ouvrir / Signer'}
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function MessagesInner() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const targetUser = searchParams.get('user');

  const [myHandle, setMyHandle] = useState('');
  const [myPubkey, setMyPubkey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [friendHandles, setFriendHandles] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [groups, setGroups] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [activeChat, setActiveChat] = useState<any>(null);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [newMessage, setNewMessage] = useState('');

  const [showGroupModal, setShowGroupModal] = useState(false);
  const [groupName, setGroupName] = useState('');
  const [activePact, setActivePact] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSealingChat, setIsSealingChat] = useState(false);
  const [showSharedVault, setShowSharedVault] = useState(false);

  const [showSearch, setShowSearch] = useState(false);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [searchResults, setSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [showAddMemberModal, setShowAddMemberModal] = useState(false);
  const [memberSearchQuery, setMemberSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [memberSearchResults, setMemberSearchResults] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [recordingTime, setRecordingTime] = useState(0);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);
  const recordingIntervalRef = useRef<any>(null);

  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const prevMessagesLength = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handle = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle') || '';
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setMyHandle(handle);
    setMyPubkey(pubkey);

    if (handle) {
      fetch(`/api/messages?me=${handle}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => setContacts(d.contacts || []));
      fetch(`/api/groups/list?me=${handle}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => setGroups(d.groups || []));
      fetch(`/api/friends?me=${handle}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
        const handles = new Set<string>((d.friends || []).map((f: any) => f.handle));
        setFriendHandles(handles);
      }).catch(() => {});
    }

    if (targetUser) setActiveChat({ type: 'dm', id: targetUser, name: targetUser });
  }, [targetUser]);

  // Recherche pour l'invitation au groupe
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!memberSearchQuery || memberSearchQuery.length < 2) { setMemberSearchResults([]); return; }
    const delay = setTimeout(async () => {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/users/search?q=${memberSearchQuery}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      setMemberSearchResults(d.users || []);
    }, 400);
    return () => clearTimeout(delay);
  }, [memberSearchQuery]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activeChat || !myHandle) return;
    const load = () => {
      const endpoint = activeChat.type === 'dm' ? `/api/messages/${activeChat.id}?me=${myHandle}` : `/api/groups/messages?id=${activeChat.id}`;
      fetch(endpoint).then(r => r.json()).then(data => {
        const serverMessages = data.messages || [];
        setMessages(prev => {
          const tempMessages = prev.filter(m => m.isTemp);
          const merged = [...serverMessages];
          tempMessages.forEach(temp => {
            if (!serverMessages.some((sm: any) => sm.content === temp.content && sm.sender === temp.sender)) merged.push(temp);
          });
          return merged;
        });
      });
    };
    load();
    const interval = setInterval(load, 3000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [activeChat, myHandle]);

  useEffect(() => { prevMessagesLength.current = 0; }, [activeChat]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (messages.length > prevMessagesLength.current) {
      messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      prevMessagesLength.current = messages.length;
    }
  }, [messages]);

  async function sendMessage() {
    if (!newMessage.trim() || !activeChat) return;
    const msg = newMessage;
    setNewMessage('');
    const tempId = `temp-${Date.now()}`;
    
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, { content: msg, sender: myHandle, created_at: new Date().toISOString(), isTemp: true, id: tempId }]);

    try {
      if (activeChat.type === 'dm') {
        const myPriv = localStorage.getItem('sceau_secret');
        const targetUser = await fetch(`/api/user-profile/${activeChat.id}`).then(r => r.json());
        const theirPub = targetUser.pubkey;
        if (!myPriv || !theirPub) throw new Error("ClÃ©s manquantes");
        const { ciphertext, iv } = await encryptForRecipient(msg, myPriv, theirPub);
        await fetch('/api/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ sender_handle: myHandle, receiver_handle: activeChat.id, content: ciphertext, iv }) });
      } else {
        await fetch('/api/groups/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ group_id: activeChat.id, sender_handle: myHandle, content: msg }) });
      }
      setTimeout(() => setMessages(prev => prev.filter(m => m.id !== tempId)), 500);
    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
  }

  async function startRecording() {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      setRecordingTime(0);
      recordingIntervalRef.current = setInterval(() => setRecordingTime(t => t + 1), 1000);

      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = async () => {
        clearInterval(recordingIntervalRef.current);
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        if (audioBlob.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) return alert("Audio trop lourd (max 2 Mo).");
        if (!myPubkey) return;
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('pubkey', myPubkey);
        formData.append('audio', new File([audioBlob], `voice-${Date.now()}.webm`, { type: 'audio/webm' }));
        const res = await fetch('/api/messages/upload-audio', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
        const data = await res.json();
        if (!res.ok || !data.url) return alert('Erreur upload audio');
        const msg = `[AUDIO]${data.url}`;
        if (activeChat.type === 'dm') {
          await fetch('/api/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ sender_handle: myHandle, receiver_handle: activeChat.id, content: msg, is_audio: true }) });
        } else {
          await fetch('/api/groups/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ group_id: activeChat.id, sender_handle: myHandle, content: msg, is_audio: true }) });
        }
      };
      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
    } catch (err) { alert("Impossible d'accÃ©der au micro."); }
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      setIsRecording(false);
      clearInterval(recordingIntervalRef.current);
    }
  }

  async function sealDiscussion() {
    if (!messages.length || !myPubkey) return;
    const confirm = window.confirm(`Sceller les ${Math.min(messages.length, 50)} derniers messages dans ton Coffre PrivÃ© ?`);
    if (!confirm) return;

    setIsSealingChat(true);
    const lastMessages = messages.slice(-50);
    const textToSeal = lastMessages.map(m => `[@${m.sender} - ${new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleString()}]\n${m.content.startsWith('[AUDIO]') ? 'Message vocal' : m.content}`).join('\n\n');

    const hash = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(textToSeal));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('hash', btoa(hashStr));
    formData.append('title', `Discussion avec ${activeChat.name} â€” ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`);
    formData.append('description', textToSeal);
    formData.append('pubkey', myPubkey);
    formData.append('visibility', 'private');
    formData.append('isHosted', 'false');

    const res = await fetch('/api/seal', { method: 'POST', body: formData });
    if (res.ok) alert("âœ… Discussion scellÃ©e ! Retrouve-la dans ton Coffre PrivÃ©.");
    else alert("Erreur lors du scellement.");
    setIsSealingChat(false);
  }

  async function createGroup() {
    if (!groupName || !myPubkey) return;
    const res = await fetch('/api/groups/create', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ name: groupName, creator_pubkey: myPubkey }) });
    if (res.ok) { alert("Groupe crÃ©Ã© !"); setShowGroupModal(false); window.location.reload(); }
  }

  async function addFriend(targetHandle: string) {
    await fetch('/api/friends', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ me: myHandle, target: targetHandle }) });
    alert(`Demande d'ami envoyÃ©e Ã  @${targetHandle} !`);
  }

  async function addMemberToGroup(targetHandle: string) {
    if (!myPubkey || !activeChat) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/groups/${activeChat.id}/members`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey: myPubkey, targetHandle }) });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { alert('Membre ajoutÃ© !'); setMemberSearchQuery(''); setMemberSearchResults([]); }
    else alert(d.error);
  }

  const startPact = () => router.push(`/seal?pact=true&chat_id=${activeChat.id}&chat_type=${activeChat.type}`);

  const getHandleColor = (handle: string) => {
    if (handle === myHandle) return 'var(--text-main)';
    return friendHandles.has(handle) ? '#4A90C2' : '#C75A22';
  };

  const sharedPacts = Array.from(
    new Map(messages.filter(m => m.content.startsWith('[PACTE]')).map(m => {
          const [id, title] = m.content.replace('[PACTE]', '').split('|');
          return [id, { id, title }];
    })).values()
  );

  const activeContacts = contacts.filter(c => c.has_chat);
  const suggestions = contacts.filter(c => !c.has_chat);

  return (
    <div className="p-4 md:p-6 flex gap-4 font-serif w-full max-w-5xl md:max-w-none mx-auto relative h-full">
      {/* LISTE */}
      <div className={`bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-2xl p-4 overflow-y-auto ${activeChat ? 'hidden md:block md:w-1/3' : 'w-full md:w-1/3'}`}>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Messages</h1>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={() => setShowSearch(!showSearch)} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] border text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">ğŸ”</button>
            <button onClick={() => setShowGroupModal(true)} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] border text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">Groupe</button>
            <button onClick={() => setActiveChat({ type: 'dm', id: 'nouveau', name: 'Nouveau contact' })} className="bg-[#1A1513] text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1 rounded-lg">+ Pacte</button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {showSearch && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <input type="text" placeholder="Chercher un pseudo..." className="w-full border p-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--bg-main)] text-sm mb-2" value={searchQuery} onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)} />
            {searchResults.map(u => (
              <div key={u.handle} className="flex justify-between items-center p-2 bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border rounded-lg mb-1">
                <span className="font-bold text-sm cursor-pointer hover:underline" onClick={() => { setActiveChat({type:'dm', id:u.handle, name:u.handle}); setShowSearch(false); setSearchQuery(''); }}>@{u.handle}</span>
                <button onClick={() => addFriend(u.handle)} className="text-[0.65rem] bg-[#E76F51] text-white px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold">+ Ami</button>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        {groups.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-4">
            <h2 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2">Groupes</h2>
            {groups.map(g => (
              <div key={g.id} onClick={() => setActiveChat({ type: 'group', id: g.id, name: g.name })} className="p-2 rounded-xl cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-main)] flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#2C1810] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm">G</div>
                <div className="font-bold text-sm truncate" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{g.name}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <h2 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-2">Discussions</h2>
        {activeContacts.map(c => (
          <div key={c.id} onClick={() => setActiveChat({ type: 'dm', id: c.handle, name: c.handle })} className="p-2 rounded-xl cursor-pointer hover:bg-[var(--bg-main)] flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm text-white" style={{ background: friendHandles.has(c.handle) ? '#4A90C2' : '#C75A22' }}>{c.handle[0].toUpperCase()}</div>
            <div className="font-bold text-sm" style={{color: friendHandles.has(c.handle) ? '#4A90C2' : '#C75A22'}}>@{c.handle}</div>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {/* CHAT */}
      {activeChat ? (
        <div className={`bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-2xl flex flex-col overflow-hidden w-full md:w-2/3 relative`}>
          <div className="p-4 border-b border-[var(--border-color)] flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <button onClick={() => setActiveChat(null)} className="md:hidden text-xl font-bold">â†</button>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{activeChat.type === 'group' ? `ğŸ‘¥ ${activeChat.name}` : `@${activeChat.name}`}</h2>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              {activeChat.type === 'group' && (
                <button onClick={() => setShowAddMemberModal(true)} className="bg-[#4A90C2] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg">+ Ajouter</button>
              )}
              <button onClick={() => setShowSharedVault(true)} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] border text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg">Coffre</button>
              <button onClick={sealDiscussion} disabled={isSealingChat} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] border text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg">{isSealingChat ? '...' : 'Sceller'}</button>
              <button onClick={startPact} className="bg-[#4A90C2] text-white text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-lg">+ Pacte</button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto space-y-3">
            {messages.map((m, i) => {
              if (m.content.startsWith('[PACTE]')) {
                const [id] = m.content.replace('[PACTE]', '').split('|');
                return <PactMessage key={i} pactId={id} onOpen={setActivePact} />;
              }
              return <DecryptedMessage key={i} message={m} myHandle={myHandle} activeChat={activeChat} getHandleColor={getHandleColor} />;
            })}
            <div ref={messagesEndRef} />
          </div>

          <div className="p-4 border-t border-[var(--border-color)] flex gap-2 items-center">
            <button onClick={isRecording ? stopRecording : startRecording} className={`p-2 rounded-xl font-bold text-xl ${isRecording ? 'bg-red-500 text-white animate-pulse' : 'bg-[var(--bg-main)] border'}`}>
              {isRecording ? `${recordingTime}s` : 'M'}
            </button>
            <input type="text" value={newMessage} onChange={e => setNewMessage(e.target.value)} placeholder="Ã‰crire..." className="flex-1 bg-[var(--bg-main)] border rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm outline-none" onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && sendMessage()} />
            <button onClick={sendMessage} className="bg-[#E76F51] text-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">Envoyer</button>
          </div>

          {showSharedVault && (
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[var(--bg-surface)] z-20 flex flex-col rounded-2xl">
              <div className="p-4 border-b flex justify-between items-center">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-lg">Coffre PartagÃ©</h3>
                <button onClick={() => setShowSharedVault(false)} className="text-xl opacity-50">âœ•</button>
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1 p-4 overflow-y-auto">
                {sharedPacts.map(p => (
                  <div key={p.id} onClick={() => { setShowSharedVault(false); setActivePact(p.id); }} className="bg-[var(--bg-main)] border p-4 rounded-xl cursor-pointer hover:border-[#E76F51] mb-2">
                    <div className="font-bold">{p.title}</div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="hidden md:flex flex-1 bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border rounded-2xl items-center justify-center text-[var(--text-muted)]">SÃ©lectionnez une discussion.</div>
      )}

      {showGroupModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl p-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-4">CrÃ©er un Groupe</h2>
            <input type="text" placeholder="Nom du groupe" className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl mb-4" value={groupName} onChange={e => setGroupName(e.target.value)} />
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <button onClick={() => setShowGroupModal(false)} className="flex-1 py-2 font-bold opacity-50">Annuler</button>
              <button onClick={createGroup} className="flex-1 bg-[#4A90C2] text-white py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">CrÃ©er</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {activePact && <PactModal pactId={activePact} onClose={() => setActivePact(null)} />}

      {showAddMemberModal && activeChat && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
          <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl p-6 flex flex-col max-h-[80vh]">
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Ajouter un membre</h2>
            <input type="text" placeholder="Chercher un pseudo..." className="w-full border p-3 rounded-xl mb-4" value={memberSearchQuery} onChange={e => setMemberSearchQuery(e.target.value)} />
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto mb-4">
              {memberSearchResults.map(u => (
                <div key={u.handle} className="flex justify-between items-center p-2 border-b">
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm">@{u.handle}</span>
                  <button onClick={() => addMemberToGroup(u.handle)} className="bg-[#4A90C2] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold">Ajouter</button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => setShowAddMemberModal(false)} className="w-full py-2 rounded-lg bg-[var(--bg-main)] font-bold">Fermer</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function DecryptedMessage({ message, myHandle, activeChat, getHandleColor }: any) {
  const [decrypted, setDecrypted] = useState<string>('ğŸ”’ DÃ©chiffrement...');

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;
    if (message.isTemp) { setDecrypted(message.content); return; }
    if (message.iv && message.content) {
      const myPriv = localStorage.getItem('sceau_secret');
      const otherHandle = message.sender === myHandle ? activeChat.id : message.sender;
      fetch(`/api/user-profile/${otherHandle}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => {
        if (d.pubkey && myPriv) {
          decryptFromSender(message.content, message.iv, myPriv, d.pubkey).then(txt => { if (isMounted) setDecrypted(txt); });
        } else { setDecrypted('ğŸ”’ ClÃ© introuvable'); }
      }).catch(() => setDecrypted('ğŸ”’ Erreur de clÃ©'));
    } else { setDecrypted(message.content); }
    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [message, activeChat]);

  const isAudio = decrypted.startsWith('[AUDIO]');
  const audioSrc = isAudio ? decrypted.replace('[AUDIO]', '') : null;

  return (
    <div className={`max-w-[80%] p-3 rounded-xl text-sm ${message.sender === myHandle ? 'bg-[#E76F51] text-white ml-auto rounded-br-none' : 'bg-[var(--bg-main)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-bl-none'} ${message.isTemp ? 'opacity-60' : ''}`}>
      {activeChat.type === 'group' && message.sender !== myHandle && (
        <div className="text-[0.6rem] font-bold mb-1" style={{ color: getHandleColor(message.sender) }}>@{message.sender}</div>
      )}
      {isAudio ? <audio controls src={audioSrc!} className="h-10 w-56" /> : decrypted}
    </div>
  );
}

function PactModal({ pactId, onClose }: { pactId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [pact, setPact] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);
  const [isSigning, setIsSigning] = useState(false);
  const [justSealed, setJustSealed] = useState(false);
  
  const loadPact = () => fetch(`/api/pacts/${pactId}`).then(r => r.json()).then(d => setPact(d));
  useEffect(() => { loadPact(); }, [pactId]);

  async function signPact() {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return alert("Connecte-toi.");
    setIsSigning(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/pacts/sign', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pact_id: pactId, pubkey }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      if (data.isNowSealed) { fireConfetti(); setJustSealed(true); }
      loadPact();
    } else { alert(data.error); }
    setIsSigning(false);
  }

  async function downloadCertificate() {
    if (!pact) return;
    setIsDownloading(true);
    const verifyUrl = `${window.location.origin}/o/${pact.id}`;
    const qrDataUrl = await QRCode.toDataURL(verifyUrl, { width: 300, margin: 1 });
    generatePactCertificate(pact.title, pact.description, pact.creator, pact.signataires || [], pact.hash_str || 'Hash en cours', qrDataUrl, pact.id);
    setIsDownloading(false);
  }

  if (!pact) return null;
  const myHandle = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
  const hasSigned = pact.signataires?.includes(myHandle);
  const isSealed = pact.status === 'scelle';

  if (justSealed) {
    return (
      <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/80 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-md">
        <div className="bg-[#FDF8F0] w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl p-8 border-4 border-[#E9C46A] shadow-2xl relative text-center">
           <div className="text-6xl mb-4">ğŸ†</div>
           <h2 className="text-3xl font-serif font-bold text-[#2C1810] mb-2">Pacte ScellÃ© !</h2>
           <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-6">L'empreinte de ce contrat a Ã©tÃ© gravÃ©e sur Bitcoin pour l'Ã©ternitÃ©.</p>
           <div className="space-y-3">
             <a href={`/api/pacts/${pact.id}/ots`} download className="w-full block bg-[#5D7A3A] text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-[#4A6330] transition">TÃ©lÃ©charger la preuve .ots</a>
             <button onClick={downloadCertificate} disabled={isDownloading} className="w-full bg-[#E9C46A] text-[#2C1810] py-3 rounded-xl font-bold shadow-md hover:bg-[#F4D03F] transition">{isDownloading ? 'GÃ©nÃ©ration...' : 'TÃ©lÃ©charger le Certificat PDF'}</button>
             <button onClick={onClose} className="w-full py-2 font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 transition">Fermer</button>
           </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const progress = Math.min(100, ((pact.signataires?.length || 0) / pact.required_signatures) * 100);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/70 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm">
      <div className={`bg-white w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border shadow-2xl relative max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto ${isSealed ? 'border-[#E9C46A]' : 'border-[#E5E5E5]'}`}>
        {isSealed && (
          <div className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full bg-[#E9C46A] text-[#2C1810] py-1.5 rounded-t-2xl text-center text-xs font-bold tracking-widest uppercase">Contrat ScellÃ© sur Bitcoin</div>
        )}
        <div className={`p-6 ${isSealed ? 'mt-6' : ''}`}>
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 leading-tight">{pact.title}</h2>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono text-gray-500 mt-1">ProposÃ© par @{pact.creator}</p>
          </div>

          <div className="mb-6">
            <h3 className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Description</h3>

          {pact.media_urls && pact.media_urls.length > 0 && (

            </div>
          )}

          <div className="mb-8">

              <span>Signatures ({pact.signataires?.length || 0} / {pact.required_signatures})</span>

            </div>

              <div className={`h-1.5 rounded-full transition-all duration-700 ${isSealed ? 'bg-[#E9C46A]' : 'bg-black'}`} style={{ width: `${progress}%` }}></div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              {(pact.signataires || []).map((s: string) => (
                <span key={s} className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium">@{s}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {isSealed ? (
              <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 p-3 rounded-lg text-center mb-2">
                <p className="text-[0.65rem] text-gray-500 font-bold uppercase mb-1">Empreinte SHA-256</p>
                <p className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono text-gray-800 break-all">{pact.hash_str}</p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <button onClick={signPact} disabled={hasSigned || isSigning} className={`w-full py-3.5 rounded-xl font-bold text-white transition ${hasSigned ? 'bg-green-600 cursor-default' : 'bg-black hover:bg-gray-800'}`}>

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

type Message = {
  role: 'user' | 'assistant';
  content: string;
  sources?: any[];
  captures?: number;
};

export default function OraclePage() {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState('');
  const [question, setQuestion] = useState('');
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const messagesEndRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    messagesEndRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [messages]);

  async function ask() {
    if (!url.trim() || !question.trim()) return;
    if (!pubkey) { setError('Connecte-toi pour utiliser Oracle.'); return; }

    setError('');
    const userMsg: Message = { role: 'user', content: question };
    setMessages(prev => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setQuestion('');
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/oracle/ask', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url: url.trim(), question }),
      });

      const d = await res.json();

      if (!res.ok) {
        setError(d.error || 'Erreur');
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, { role: 'assistant', content: `âŒ ${d.error}` }]);
      } else {
        setMessages(prev => [...prev, {

          captures: d.captures_used,
        }]);

    } catch (e: any) {
      setError('Erreur rÃ©seau');

          URL Ã  interroger
        </label>

          type="url"

          className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl bg-transparent outline-none focus:border-[#4A90C2] text-sm"

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export default function AccessLogModal({ sealId, onClose }: { sealId: string; onClose: () => void }) {
  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState('recent');

  useEffect(() => {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setLoading(true);
    fetch(`/api/seal/${sealId}/access-log?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey || '')}&search=${search}&sort=${sort}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { setEntries(d.entries || []); setLoading(false); });
  }, [sealId, search, sort]);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm" onClick={onClose}>

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { generatePortfolioPDF } from '@/lib/pdf';
import AccessLogModal from './AccessLogModal';

export default function Profil() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('public');
  const [showPortfolioModal, setShowPortfolioModal] = useState(false);
  const [selectedSeals, setSelectedSeals] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState('all');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');
  const [accessLogSealId, setAccessLogSealId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showAccessLogList, setShowAccessLogList] = useState(false);
  const [showTechProofs, setShowTechProofs] = useState(false);
  const [refreshingId, setRefreshingId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function loadProfil() {
    const handle = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    if (!handle) { router.replace('/login'); return; }
    try {
      const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
      const res = await fetch(`/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle)}${pubkey ? `&pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}` : ''}`, { cache: 'no-store' });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(d.error || "Erreur");
      setData({ ...d, seals: d.seals || [], badges: d.badges || [], favorites: d.favorites || [], projects: d.projects || [] });
    } catch (e: any) { setError(e.message); }
  }

  useEffect(() => { loadProfil(); }, [router]);

  const applyFilters = (type: string, start: string, end: string) => {
    let filtered = data.seals;
    if (type !== 'all') {
      if (type === 'flash') filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => s.is_flash);
      else filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => s.visibility === type && !s.is_flash);
    }
    if (start) filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp) >= new Date(start));
    if (end) filtered = filtered.filter((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp) <= new Date(end));
    setSelectedSeals(filtered.map((s: any) => s.id));
  };

  const toggleSeal = (id: string) => {
    if (selectedSeals.includes(id)) setSelectedSeals(selectedSeals.filter(sid => sid !== id));
    else setSelectedSeals([...selectedSeals, id]);
  };

  const generatePDF = () => {
    const sealsToInclude = data.seals.filter((s: any) => selectedSeals.includes(s.id));
    if (sealsToInclude.length === 0) return alert("SÃ©lectionne au moins une Å“uvre !");
    generatePortfolioPDF(data.handle, sealsToInclude, startDate, endDate, data.is_pro);
    setShowPortfolioModal(false);
  };

  async function changeVisibility(sealId: string, newVisibility: string) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    await fetch('/api/seal/update-visibility', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ seal_id: sealId, pubkey, visibility: newVisibility })
    });
    loadProfil();
  }

  async function refreshOts(sealId: string) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return alert('Connecte-toi.');
    setRefreshingId(sealId);
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/seal/${sealId}/ots/refresh?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`, { method: 'POST' });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (d.status === 'upgraded') { alert('âœ… Preuve mise Ã  jour !'); await loadProfil(); }
      else alert('â³ ' + (d.message || 'Pas encore confirmÃ©.'));
    } catch { alert('âŒ Erreur'); } finally { setRefreshingId(null); }
  }

  if (error) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono text-red-500">{error}</div>;
  if (!data) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono">Chargement...</div>;

  const counts = {
    public: data.seals.filter((s:any) => s.visibility === 'public' && !s.is_flash).length,
    friends: data.seals.filter((s:any) => s.visibility === 'friends' && !s.is_flash).length,
    private: data.seals.filter((s:any) => s.visibility === 'private' && !s.is_flash).length,
    flash: data.seals.filter((s:any) => s.is_flash).length,
    projects: data.projects.length,
    extensions: data.seals.filter((s:any) => s.category === 'Web').length,
  };

  if (activeTab === 'favorites') {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 pb-32 max-w-2xl mx-auto font-sans">
        <button onClick={() => setActiveTab('public')} className="text-sm font-bold text-[#A89070] mb-4 hover:underline">â† Retour au coffre</button>

          {data.favorites?.map((fav: any) => (
            <Link href={`/o/${fav.id}`} key={fav.id} className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-4 rounded-xl border block hover:border-[#E76F51]">
              <div className="font-bold text-lg" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{fav.title}</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)]">Par @{fav.author} â€¢ {new Date(fav.timestamp).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</div>
            </Link>
          ))}

import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ProjetDetail() {
  const params = useParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const [project, setProject] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [showUpdate, setShowUpdate] = useState(false);
  const [showInvite, setShowInvite] = useState(false);
  const [inviteHandle, setInviteHandle] = useState('');
  const [inviteError, setInviteError] = useState('');
  const [filesToDelete, setFilesToDelete] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newFiles, setNewFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [updating, setUpdating] = useState(false);

  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;
  const myHandle = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle') : null;

  const loadProject = async () => {
    if (!params.id) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${params.id}`);
      const d = await res.json();
      if (d && d.id) setProject(d);
    } catch (e) {}
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadProject(); }, [params.id]);

  const amIOwner = project?.author === myHandle;
  const amIMember = project?.members?.some((m: any) => m.handle === myHandle);

  async function handleUpdate() {
    if (!project || !pubkey) return;
    setUpdating(true);
    try {
      const filesToKeep = project.files.filter((f: any) => !filesToDelete.includes(f.file_name)).map((f: any) => f.file_name);
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('pubkey', pubkey);
      fd.append('files_to_keep', JSON.stringify(filesToKeep));
      newFiles.forEach(f => fd.append('new_files', f));
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}/update`, { method: 'POST', body: fd });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) router.push(`/projets/${d.project_id}`);
      else alert('Erreur : ' + d.error);
    } catch (e) { alert('Erreur rÃ©seau'); }
    setUpdating(false);
  }

  async function handleInvite() {
    if (!project || !pubkey || !inviteHandle) return;
    setInviteError('');
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}/members`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, handle: inviteHandle }),
      });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) { setInviteHandle(''); setShowInvite(false); loadProject(); }
      else setInviteError(d.error || 'Erreur');
    } catch (e) { setInviteError('Erreur rÃ©seau'); }
  }

  async function handleRollback() {
    if (!project || !pubkey) return;
    if (!confirm('CrÃ©er une nouvelle version basÃ©e sur celle-ci ?')) return;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}/rollback`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey }),
      });
      const d = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) router.push(`/projets/${d.project_id}`);
      else alert('Erreur : ' + d.error);
    } catch (e) { alert('Erreur rÃ©seau'); }
  }

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono">Chargement...</div>;

    return (
      <div className="p-10 text-center font-sans flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[50vh]">
        <div className="text-5xl mb-4">ğŸ”</div>
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold mb-2" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Oups...</h2>
        <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-6 max-w-md mx-auto">{errorMsg || "Ce projet n'existe pas."}</p>
        <Link href="/projets" className="bg-[#1A1513] text-white px-6 py-2 rounded-xl font-bold">
          Retour aux projets
        </Link>
      </div>
    );

      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
        <div className="bg-[#1E1E1E] p-6 text-white flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between md:items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold font-serif">{project.title}</h1>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 mt-1">Version {project.version_number || 1} Â· Dossier Miroir (Merkle)</p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-left md:text-right">
            <p className="text-[0.65rem] font-mono uppercase text-gray-400">Hash Racine</p>
            <p className="text-xs font-mono bg-gray-800 px-2 py-1 rounded mt-1 break-all max-w-full md:max-w-[200px]">{project.merkle_root}</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="p-6">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-6">
            {amIOwner && (
              <button 
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (!confirm("âš ï¸ Supprimer dÃ©finitivement ce projet et TOUS ses fichiers ? Cette action est irrÃ©versible.")) return;
                  const res = await fetch(`/api/projects/${project.id}?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey!)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
                  if (res.ok) router.push('/projets');
                  else alert("Erreur lors de la suppression");

'use client';
import { useState, Suspense } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

function ResetForm() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const token = searchParams.get('token');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [show, setShow] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  async function handleReset() {
    if (!password) return setStatus('Mot de passe requis');
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/reset-password', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ token, newPassword: password }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      setStatus('âœ… Mot de passe modifiÃ© !');
      setTimeout(() => router.push('/login'), 1500);
    } else setStatus('âŒ ' + data.error);
  }

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto bg-[#FFFCF7] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[#EFE0CA] shadow-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 font-serif">Nouveau mot de passe</h1>
      <div className="relative mb-4">
        <input type={show ? "text" : "password"} placeholder="Nouveau mot de passe" className="w-full border-2 border-[#EFE0CA] p-3 rounded-xl pr-10" value={password} onChange={e => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <button onClick={() => setShow(!show)} className="absolute right-3 top-3">{show ? "ğŸ™ˆ" : "ğŸ‘ï¸"}</button>
      </div>
      <button onClick={handleReset} className="w-full bg-[#2C1810] text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-bold">Valider</button>
      {status && <p className="mt-4 text-center font-bold">{status}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ResetPassword() {
  return <Suspense fallback={<div>Chargement...</div>}><ResetForm /></Suspense>;
}

'use client';
import { useState, useRef, Suspense } from 'react';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { useSearchParams } from 'next/navigation';

function SealContent() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const isPactMode = searchParams.get('pact') === 'true';
  const chatId = searchParams.get('chat_id');
  const chatType = searchParams.get('chat_type');
  const challengeIdParam = searchParams.get('challenge_id');

  const [isFlashMode, setIsFlashMode] = useState(false);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'file' | 'text' | 'media' | 'audio' | 'project'>(
    (searchParams.get('mode') === 'project' ? 'project' : 'file') as any
  );
  const [projectFiles, setProjectFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  const [title, setTitle] = useState('');
  const [desc, setDesc] = useState('');
  const [textContent, setTextContent] = useState('');
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [pactFiles, setPactFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  const [visibility, setVisibility] = useState('public');
  const [isHosted, setIsHosted] = useState(true);
  const [isMystery, setIsMystery] = useState(false);
  
  const [unlockLikes, setUnlockLikes] = useState(10);
  const [revealAt, setRevealAt] = useState('');
  const [requiredSignatures, setRequiredSignatures] = useState(2);
  const [pactTheme, setPactTheme] = useState('serieux');

  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');
  const [sealedResult, setSealedResult] = useState<any>(null);

  const [isRecording, setIsRecording] = useState(false);
  const [audioUrl, setAudioUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const mediaRecorderRef = useRef<MediaRecorder | null>(null);
  const audioChunksRef = useRef<Blob[]>([]);

  async function startRecording() {
    try {
      const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
      const mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);
      mediaRecorderRef.current = mediaRecorder;
      audioChunksRef.current = [];
      mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (event) => { if (event.data.size > 0) audioChunksRef.current.push(event.data); };
      mediaRecorder.onstop = () => {
        const audioBlob = new Blob(audioChunksRef.current, { type: 'audio/webm' });
        setFile(new File([audioBlob], `audio-${Date.now()}.webm`, { type: 'audio/webm' }));
        setAudioUrl(URL.createObjectURL(audioBlob));
      };
      mediaRecorder.start();
      setIsRecording(true);
    } catch { setStatus(" Impossible d'accÃ©der au micro."); }
  }

  function stopRecording() {
    if (mediaRecorderRef.current && isRecording) {
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stop();
      mediaRecorderRef.current.stream.getTracks().forEach(track => track.stop());
      setIsRecording(false);
    }
  }

  async function handleSeal() {
    setStatus('');

    if (!title.trim()) return setStatus(" Un titre est requis");
    if (mode === 'project' && projectFiles.length === 0) return setStatus(" SÃ©lectionne des fichiers pour ton projet");
    if (isPactMode && pactFiles.length === 0) return setStatus(" Ajoute au moins un fichier au pacte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'text' && !textContent.trim()) return setStatus(" Ã‰cris ton texte");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'file' && !file) return setStatus(" Choisis un fichier Ã  sceller");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'media' && !file) return setStatus(" Prends une photo ou une vidÃ©o");
    if (!isPactMode && mode === 'audio' && !file) return setStatus(" Enregistre un audio");

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "PrÃ©paration du pacte..." : "Calcul de l'empreinte...");
    try {
      let hashContent: Uint8Array;
      let projectManifest: any[] = [];
      let merkleRoot = '';

      if (mode === 'project') {
        // On calcule les hashs de tous les fichiers localement
        for (const f of projectFiles) {
          const buf = await f.arrayBuffer();
          const h = sha256(new Uint8Array(buf));
          const hB64 = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...h));
          projectManifest.push({ name: f.name, hash: hB64, size: f.size });
        }
        merkleRoot = buildMerkleRoot(projectManifest.map(m => m.hash));
        // Le hash principal du sceau (pour l'affichage) sera le Merkle Root
        hashContent = new Uint8Array(Array.from(atob(merkleRoot), c => c.charCodeAt(0)));
      } else if (isPactMode) {
        const metaString = `${title}-${desc}-${pactFiles.map(f => f.name).join(',')}`;
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(metaString));
      } else if (mode === 'text') {
        hashContent = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(textContent));
      } else {
        if (!file) return setStatus(" Fichier manquant");
        hashContent = sha256(new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()));
      }

      let hashStr = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < hashContent.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hashContent[i]);
      if (mode === 'project') {
        await sendToServer(merkleRoot, merkleRoot, projectManifest);
      } else {
        await sendToServer(btoa(hashStr));
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus(" Erreur de gravure : " + (e?.message || 'inconnue'));
    }
  }

  async function sendToServer(hashB64: string, merkleRoot?: string, projectManifest?: any[]) {
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!pubkey) return setStatus(" Connecte-toi d'abord !");

    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('hash', hashB64);
    formData.append('title', title);
    formData.append('description', mode === 'text' ? textContent : desc);
    formData.append('pubkey', pubkey);

    let endpoint = '/api/seal';

    if (mode === 'project') {
      endpoint = '/api/projects';
      formData.append('isHosted', isHosted.toString());
      formData.append('merkle_root', merkleRoot as string); // On ajoute le root calculÃ© client
      formData.append('manifest', JSON.stringify(projectManifest || []));
      projectFiles.forEach(f => formData.append('files', f));
    } else if (isPactMode) {
      endpoint = '/api/pacts/create';
      formData.append('group_id', chatType === 'group' ? (chatId as string) : '');
      formData.append('required_signatures', requiredSignatures.toString());
      formData.append('theme', pactTheme);
      
      // CHIFFREMENT E2EE de la description du pacte
      const ciphertext = desc; const iv = '';
      formData.set('description', desc); // On remplace la description en clair
      formData.append('iv', iv);

      pactFiles.forEach(f => formData.append('files', f));
    } else {
      formData.append('isFlash', isFlashMode.toString());
      formData.append('visibility', visibility);
      formData.append('isMystery', isMystery.toString());
      formData.append('isEphemeral', 'false');
      formData.append('unlockLikes', unlockLikes.toString());
      formData.append('reveal_at', revealAt);
      formData.append('isHosted', isHosted.toString());
      if (challengeIdParam) formData.append('challenge_id', challengeIdParam);
      if (mode !== 'text' && file) formData.append('file', file);
    }

    setStatus(isPactMode ? "Envoi du pacte..." : "Ancrage dans la blockchain (max 8s)â€¦");

    try {
      const res = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: formData });
      const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({} as any));

      if (!res.ok) {
        return setStatus(" " + (data?.error || `Erreur serveur (${res.status})`));
      }

      if (isPactMode) {
        const msg = `[PACTE]${data.id}|${data.title}`;
        if (chatType === 'dm') {
          await fetch('/api/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), receiver_handle: chatId, content: msg }) });
        } else {
          await fetch('/api/groups/messages', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ group_id: chatId, sender_handle: localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle'), content: msg }) });
        }
        window.location.href = '/messages';
      } else {
        setStatus(" ScellÃ© !");
        setSealedResult({ title, hash: hashB64, date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR'), isFlash: isFlashMode, ots: !!data.ots_secured });
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      console.error(e);
      setStatus(" Erreur rÃ©seau : " + (e?.message || 'impossible de contacter le serveur'));
    }
  }

  if (sealedResult) {
    return (
      <div className="p-6 font-sans text-center flex flex-col items-center max-w-md mx-auto">
        <div className="text-6xl mb-4">{sealedResult.isFlash ? 'âš¡' : ''}</div>
        <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>C'est gravÃ©.</h1>
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] w-full text-left shadow-sm mt-6">
          <h3 className="font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>{sealedResult.title}</h3>
          <p className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono break-all text-[var(--text-muted)] bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-2 rounded border border-[var(--border-color)]">{sealedResult.hash}</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-right mt-3 text-[var(--text-muted)]">ScellÃ© le {sealedResult.date}</p>
          {sealedResult.ots && <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-[#5D7A3A] font-bold"> Preuve horodatÃ©e</p>}
        </div>
        <button onClick={() => window.location.reload()} className="mt-8 bg-[#2C1810] text-white p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full">Sceller une autre Å“uvre</button>
        <Link href="/feed" className="mt-3 border border-[var(--border-soft)] text-[var(--text-main)] p-3 rounded-xl font-bold w-full text-center">Voir le Feed</Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 font-sans max-w-md md:max-w-4xl mx-auto w-full">

      {/* === ONGLETS SCeller / VÃ©rifier === */}
      {!isPactMode && (
        <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
          <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
            <Link href="/seal" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]">Sceller</Link>
            <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>VÃ©rifier</Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="text-center mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-4xl font-bold mb-2" style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>
          {isPactMode ? "Nouveau Pacte." : (isFlashMode ? "Flash." : "L'Atelier.")}
        </h1>
      </div>

      {/* === Toggle Normal / Flash === */}
      {!isPactMode && (
        <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl mb-4 border border-[var(--border-color)]">
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setIsFlashMode(false); setMode('file'); setIsHosted(true); setVisibility('public'); }} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition ${!isFlashMode ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Standard</button>
          <button type="button" onClick={() => { setIsFlashMode(true); setIsHosted(false); setVisibility('private'); }} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm transition ${isFlashMode ? 'bg-[#2C1810] text-white shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Mode Flash</button>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="space-y-4 bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-6 rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm">

        {/* === SÃ©lecteur de mode === */}
        {!isPactMode && (
          <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('file')} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${mode === 'file' ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Fichier</button>
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setMode('text')} className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold transition ${mode === 'text' ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow' : 'opacity-50'}`} style={{ color: 'var(--text-main)' }}>Texte</button>

            {status}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Seal() {
  return <Suspense fallback={<div className="p-10 text-center font-mono">Chargement...</div>}><SealContent /></Suspense>;

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function ApiKeysPage() {
  const [keys, setKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [newKeyName, setNewKeyName] = useState('');
  const [generatedKey, setGeneratedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const pubkey = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey') : null;

  const loadKeys = async () => {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
    const d = await res.json();
    setKeys(d.keys || []);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadKeys(); }, [pubkey]);

  async function createKey() {
    if (!newKeyName.trim() || !pubkey) return;
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/api-keys', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, name: newKeyName })
    });
    const d = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) {
      setGeneratedKey(d.key);
      setNewKeyName('');
      loadKeys();
    } else alert(d.error);
  }

  async function revokeKey(id: string) {
    if (!confirm('RÃ©voquer cette clÃ© ? Les extensions qui l\'utilisent cesseront de fonctionner.')) return;
    await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey!)}&id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    loadKeys();
  }

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 max-w-2xl mx-auto font-sans w-full min-h-screen">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-8">

        {generatedKey && (
          <div className="bg-[#FFFCF7] border border-[#E9C46A] p-4 rounded-xl mb-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#A88620] mb-1">âš ï¸ Copiez cette clÃ© maintenant, elle ne sera plus jamais affichÃ©e :</p>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <code className="flex-1 bg-white p-2 rounded text-xs break-all border">{generatedKey}</code>
              <button onClick={() => { navigator.clipboard.writeText(generatedKey); alert('CopiÃ© !'); }} className="bg-[#E9C46A] text-white px-3 rounded font-bold text-xs">Copier</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="flex gap-2">

            onChange={e => setNewKeyName(e.target.value)}

      <h2 className="text-lg font-bold mb-4" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Mes clÃ©s actives</h2>
      <div className="space-y-2">
        {loading ? <p className="text-center font-mono">Chargement...</p> : keys.length === 0 ? <p className="text-sm italic text-[var(--text-muted)]">Aucune clÃ© pour le moment.</p> : (
          keys.map(k => (
            <div key={k.id} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm">

'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Settings() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState('');
  const [oldHandle, setOldHandle] = useState('');
  const [newHandle, setNewHandle] = useState('');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState('');
  const [role, setRole] = useState('createur');
  const [openToCollab, setOpenToCollab] = useState(false);
  const [firstName, setFirstName] = useState('');
  const [lastName, setLastName] = useState('');
  const [birthDate, setBirthDate] = useState('');
  const [identityCount, setIdentityCount] = useState(0);
  const [pubkey, setPubkey] = useState('');
  const [apiKeys, setApiKeys] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [newKeyName, setNewKeyName] = useState('');
  const [generatedKey, setGeneratedKey] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const p = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    if (!h || !p) { router.push('/login'); return; }
    setOldHandle(h); setNewHandle(h); setPubkey(p);

    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(p)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => {
        if (d.handle) {
          setBio(d.bio || ''); setRole(d.role || 'createur');
          setOpenToCollab(d.open_to_collaboration === true);
          setFirstName(d.first_name || ''); setLastName(d.last_name || '');
          setBirthDate(d.birth_date ? d.birth_date.split('T')[0] : '');
          setIdentityCount(d.identity_changes_count || 0);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      }).catch(() => setLoading(false));
  }, [router]);

  async function saveProfile() {
    setSaving(true); setMsg('');
    const res = await fetch('/api/profil/update', {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, old_handle: oldHandle, new_handle: newHandle, bio, role, open_to_collaboration: openToCollab, first_name: firstName, last_name: lastName, birth_date: birthDate }),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { setMsg('âœ… Profil mis Ã  jour !'); localStorage.setItem('sceau_handle', data.new_handle); setOldHandle(data.new_handle); }
    else setMsg('âŒ ' + data.error);
    setSaving(false);
  }

  async function loadApiKeys() {
    if (!pubkey) return;
    const res = await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`);
    if (res.ok) { const d = await res.json(); setApiKeys(d.keys || []); }
  }

  useEffect(() => { if (pubkey) loadApiKeys(); }, [pubkey]);

  async function generateApiKey() {
    if (!newKeyName.trim()) return alert("Donne un nom Ã  ta clÃ©");
    const res = await fetch('/api/auth/api-keys', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, name: newKeyName }) });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { setGeneratedKey(data.key); setNewKeyName(''); loadApiKeys(); }
    else alert('Erreur: ' + data.error);
  }

  async function revokeApiKey(id: string) {
    if (!confirm('RÃ©voquer cette clÃ© ?')) return;
    await fetch(`/api/auth/api-keys?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}&id=${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    loadApiKeys();
  }

  function logout() { localStorage.clear(); router.push('/login'); }

  if (loading) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono">Chargement...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 md:pb-6 max-w-2xl md:max-w-4xl mx-auto font-sans w-full">

'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ed25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Signup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  async function handleSignup() {
    if (!handle || !email || !password) return setStatus("Tous les champs sont requis");
    setStatus("CrÃ©ation en cours...");
    
    try {
      const secret = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
      const pubkey = ed25519.getPublicKey(secret);
      let pubkeyStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < pubkey.length; i++) pubkeyStr += String.fromCharCode(pubkey[i]);
      let secretStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < secret.length; i++) secretStr += String.fromCharCode(secret[i]);
      const pubkeyB64 = btoa(pubkeyStr);

      localStorage.setItem('sceau_secret', btoa(secretStr));

      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/signup', { 
        method: 'POST', 
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, 
        body: JSON.stringify({ handle, email, password, pubkey: pubkeyB64 }) 
      });
      
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (res.ok) {
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_pubkey', pubkeyB64);
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_handle', handle);
        setStatus("âœ… Compte crÃ©Ã© !");
        setTimeout(() => router.push('/feed'), 500);
      } else {
        setStatus("âŒ " + (data.error || "Une erreur est survenue"));
      }
    } catch (e) { setStatus("âŒ Impossible de contacter le serveur. VÃ©rifiez votre connexion."); }
  }

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSignup(); };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 font-serif" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>CrÃ©er un compte</h1>
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Pseudo</label>
      <input type="text" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={handle} onChange={(e) => setHandle(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Email</label>
      <input type="email" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Mot de passe</label>
      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <input type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl pr-10 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)} className="absolute right-3 top-3 opacity-50">{showPassword ? "ğŸ™ˆ" : "ğŸ‘ï¸"}</button>
      </div>
      
      <button onClick={handleSignup} className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E76F51] to-[#F4A261] text-white p-4 rounded-xl font-bold">S'inscrire</button>
      {status && <p className="mt-4 text-center font-bold text-[#E76F51]">{status}</p>}
      
      <p className="text-center mt-4 text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">DÃ©jÃ  un compte ? <Link href="/login" className="underline font-bold">Se connecter</Link></p>
    </div>
  );
}

                ScellÃ© le {new Date(seal.timestamp).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}
              </div>
            </Link>
          ))}
          {data.seals.length === 0 && (
            <div className="col-span-full text-center py-16 bg-[var(--bg-surface)] rounded-2xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
              <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] italic">Ce crÃ©ateur n'a pas encore publiÃ© d'Å“uvre publique.</p>

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link'; // L'IMPORT MANQUANT EST ICI
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export default function Verify() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('file');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [titleQuery, setTitleQuery] = useState('');
  
  const [timelineData, setTimelineData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [timelineLoading, setTimelineLoading] = useState(true);
  const [timelineMode, setTimelineMode] = useState<'live' | 'period'>('live');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'timeline') return;
    const fetchTimeline = () => {
      setTimelineLoading(true);
      const url = timelineMode === 'live' 
        ? '/api/verify/timeline?live=true'
        : `/api/verify/timeline?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}`;
        
      fetch(url).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
        setTimelineData(data.timeline || []);
        setTimelineLoading(false);
      });
    };
    fetchTimeline();
    if (timelineMode === 'live') {
      const interval = setInterval(fetchTimeline, 5000);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [tab, timelineMode, startDate, endDate]);

  async function verifyFile(file: File) {
    setLoading(true);
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const hash = sha256(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: btoa(hashStr) }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function verifyHash(input: string) {
    if(!input) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: input }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function searchByTitle() {
    if(!titleQuery) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: titleQuery }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return "Ã€ l'instant";
    if (diff === 1) return "Il y a 1 minute";
    if (diff < 60) return `Il y a ${diff} minutes`;
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR');
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 pb-32 md:pb-6 max-w-2xl md:max-w-5xl mx-auto font-sans w-full">
      <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
        <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
          <Link href="/seal" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition">âœï¸ Sceller</Link>
          <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]">ğŸ” VÃ©rifier</Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2 text-center" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>VÃ©rifier & DÃ©couvrir.</h1>
      <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] italic mb-6 text-center">Prouvez l'authenticitÃ© ou dÃ©couvrez le monde.</p>
      
      <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-1 rounded-xl mb-6">
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('file');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='file'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Fichier</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('hash');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='hash'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Hash</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('title');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='title'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Titre</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('timeline');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='timeline'?'bg-[#E76F51] text-white shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: tab==='timeline' ? '#FFF' : 'var(--text-main)'}}>Chronologie</button>
      </div>

      {tab === 'file' && (
        <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-[#4A90C2] bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-xl text-center">
          <input type="file" onChange={e=>e.target.files?.[0] && verifyFile(e.target.files[0])} className="w-full text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
        </div>

        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'title' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Titre de l'Å“uvre (ex: Mon premier roman)" className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={titleQuery} onChange={e=>setTitleQuery(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && searchByTitle()} />
          <button onClick={searchByTitle} className="w-full bg-[#4A90C2] text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold">Rechercher</button>

      {tab === 'timeline' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">

              <button onClick={() => setTimelineMode('period')} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition ${timelineMode === 'period' ? 'bg-white shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Par pÃ©riode</button>

            {timelineMode === 'period' && (

            )}
          </div>

          {timelineLoading ? (

              <div className="absolute left-2.5 top-2 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-[#E76F51] opacity-30"></div>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {timelineData.map((item, index) => (

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setHandle(h);

    if (!pubkey) { setLoading(false); return; }

    // Profil
    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { if (d.handle) setProfile(d); })
      .catch(() => {});

    // ActivitÃ© (rafraÃ®chie toutes les 30s)
    const fetchActivity = () => {
      fetch(`/api/profil/activity?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setActivities(d.activities || []))
        .catch(() => {});

    fetchActivity();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchActivity, 30000);

      .then(r => r.json())

  // Stockage dynamique

    return `il y a ${Math.floor(diff/1440)}j`;
  }

  return (
    <aside className="hidden lg:flex flex-col w-[340px] bg-[var(--bg-main)] border-l border-[var(--border-color)] h-full overflow-y-auto shrink-0">

          <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-main)]">Stockage</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">{usedGB} Go / {maxQuotaGB} Go</span>

            <div className={`h-2 rounded-full ${percentage > 90 ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-[#4A90C2]'}`} style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}></div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-3">

FICHIER : ./src/db/pool.ts

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { requireDb } from '@/lib/env';

let _pool: Pool | null = null;

function create(): Pool {
  const url = requireDb();
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: url,
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: true },
  });
  pool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[pg] idle client error:', err.message);
  });
  return pool;
}

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!_pool) _pool = create();
  return _pool;
}

// Compat : `import { pool } from '@/db/pool'` continue de fonctionner.
export const pool = new Proxy({} as Pool, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getPool() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function isDbError(e: any): boolean {
  const code = e?.code;
  if (['ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ETIMEDOUT', '28P01', '3D000', '57P01'].includes(code)) return true;
  return /ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|timeout|connect.*pool|database/i.test(String(e?.message || ''));
}

export function apiError(e: unknown, fallback = 'Erreur serveur'): NextResponse {
  if (isDbError(e)) {
    console.error('[api-error] base injoignable :', (e as any)?.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Base de donnÃ©es injoignable. RÃ©essayez dans un instant.' },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
  console.error('[api-error]', e);
  return NextResponse.json({ error: fallback }, { status: 500 });
}
