// Moteur de scan partagÃ© : cron nocturne, bouton Â« VÃ©rifier Â» et endpoint de test utilisent
// EXACTEMENT le mÃªme code (mÃªmes rÃ¨gles de tÃ©lÃ©chargement, nettoyage, diff et rÃ©sumÃ©).

import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';
import { Resend } from 'resend';
import { safeFetch, extractTitle } from '@/lib/safe-fetcher';
import { crawlSite } from '@/lib/crawler';
import { submitToOts } from '@/lib/ots';
import { cleanHtmlToText, significantDiff, CLEANER_VERSION, type LineDiff } from '@/lib/html-cleaner';
import { summarizeDiff, describeDiff } from '@/lib/oracle-summary';

export type ArchiveRow = {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  title: string | null;
  last_hash: string | null;
  last_content: string | null;
  clean_version: number | null;
  user_id?: string;
  email?: string | null;
};

export type ScanStatus = 'intact' | 'modified' | 'error';

export type ScanOutcome = {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  status: ScanStatus;
  baseline?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  added?: number;
  removed?: number;
  summary?: string | null;
  summaryError?: string;
  model?: string;
  hash?: string;
  lines?: number;
  logs: string[];
};

export function hashText(text: string): string {
  return Buffer.from(sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text))).toString('hex');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// SchÃ©ma : ajoutÃ© automatiquement et sans risque (IF NOT EXISTS) au premier usage.
// Ã‰vite d'avoir Ã  lancer un script SQL Ã  la main avant chaque dÃ©ploiement.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
let schemaReady: Promise<void> | null = null;

export function ensureArchiveSchema(): Promise<void> {
  if (!schemaReady) {
    schemaReady = (async () => {
      const stmts = [
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS site_root TEXT`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_content TEXT`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS last_status TEXT DEFAULT 'intact'`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status TEXT DEFAULT 'intact'`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS diff_data JSONB`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pages_scanned INTEGER DEFAULT 1`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS scan_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_summary TEXT`,
        `ALTER TABLE web_archives ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS clean_version INTEGER DEFAULT 1`,
        `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS web_archive_changes (
           id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
           archive_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES web_archives(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
           detected_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
           old_hash TEXT,
           new_hash TEXT,
           added_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
           removed_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
           diff_data JSONB,
           ai_summary TEXT,
           summary_model TEXT
         )`,
        `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_archive_changes_archive ON web_archive_changes(archive_id, detected_at DESC)`,
      ];
      for (const s of stmts) {
        try {
          await pool.query(s);
        } catch (e) {
          console.warn('[archive schema]', (e as Error).message);
        }
      }
    })();
    // en cas d'Ã©chec global on retentera au prochain appel
    schemaReady.catch(() => {
      schemaReady = null;
    });
  }
  return schemaReady;
}

function diffPayload(diff: LineDiff) {
  const cut = (l: string) => l.slice(0, 300);
  return {
    changesCount: Math.max(diff.added.length, diff.removed.length),
    added: diff.added.length,
    removed: diff.removed.length,
    details: [
      ...diff.removed.slice(0, 50).map((t: string) => ({ type: 'removed', text: cut(t) })),
      ...diff.added.slice(0, 50).map((t: string) => ({ type: 'added', text: cut(t) })),
    ],
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Scan d'UNE page
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function scanArchive(
  row: ArchiveRow,
  opts: { persist?: boolean; log?: (m: string) => void; baselineOverride?: string } = {}
): Promise<ScanOutcome> {
  const persist = opts.persist !== false;
  const logs: string[] = [];
  const log = (m: string) => {
    logs.push(m);
    console.log(`[scan ${row.id.slice(0, 8)}] ${m}`);
    opts.log?.(m);
  };
  const out = (o: Omit<ScanOutcome, 'id' | 'url' | 'logs'>): ScanOutcome => ({ id: row.id, url: row.url, logs, ...o });

  if (persist) await ensureArchiveSchema();

  // 1. TÃ©lÃ©chargement sÃ©curisÃ© + Crawl BFS
  log(`1/5 tÃ©lÃ©chargement de ${row.url}`);
  
  // On utilise notre Crawler (qui respecte safe-fetcher, robots.txt et fait le BFS)
  const pages = await crawlSite(row.url);
  if (pages.length === 0) {
    log(`âœ— Ã©chec du tÃ©lÃ©chargement : aucune page trouvÃ©e`);
    if (persist) await pool.query('UPDATE web_archives SET last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [row.id]).catch(() => {});
    return out({ status: 'error', error: 'Aucune page trouvÃ©e' });
  }
  
  // On prend la page principale pour le diff (la premiÃ¨re du tableau)
  const f = pages[0];
  log(`   ${pages.length} page(s) scannÃ©e(s). ${f.text.length} caractÃ¨res sur la page principale.`);

  // 2. Nettoyage (dÃ©jÃ  fait par le crawler, mais on garde la variable pour le diff)
  const text = f.text;
  const lines = text ? text.split('\n').length : 0;
  log(`2/5 nettoyage : ${lines} lignes de contenu utile (${text.length} caractÃ¨res)`);
  if (text.length < 20) {
    log('âœ— contenu vide aprÃ¨s nettoyage (page vide, protÃ©gÃ©e, ou affichÃ©e uniquement par JavaScript)');
    if (persist) await pool.query('UPDATE web_archives SET last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1', [row.id]).catch(() => {});
    return out({ status: 'error', error: 'Contenu vide aprÃ¨s nettoyage (page rendue par JavaScript ou protÃ©gÃ©e)', lines });
  }

  // 3. Empreinte + Ancrage Bitcoin
  const hash = hashText(text);
  log(`3/5 empreinte SHA-256 : ${hash.slice(0, 16)}â€¦`);

  // Ancrage OpenTimestamps
  let otsProof = null;
  try {
    const ots = await submitToOts(new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(hash, 'hex')));
    if (ots.ok && ots.proof) {
      otsProof = ots.proof.toString('base64');
      log(`   â›“ï¸ ancrage Bitcoin rÃ©ussi`);
    }
  } catch (e) {
    log(`   âš ï¸ ancrage Bitcoin Ã©chouÃ©`);
  }

  const baselineText = opts.baselineOverride ?? row.last_content;
  const hasBaseline = !!baselineText && !!row.last_hash && (opts.baselineOverride !== undefined || (row.clean_version ?? 1) >= CLEANER_VERSION);

  // 4a. PremiÃ¨re capture, ou capture faite avec l'ancien format de nettoyage : nouvelle rÃ©fÃ©rence
  if (!hasBaseline) {
    log('4/5 pas de rÃ©fÃ©rence compatible â†’ cette capture devient la rÃ©fÃ©rence (aucune alerte)');
    if (persist) {
      await pool.query(
        `UPDATE web_archives SET last_hash = $1, last_content = $2, clean_version = $3, last_status = 'intact', status = 'intact',
           last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1, title = COALESCE(NULLIF(title, ''), $4)
         WHERE id = $5`,
        [hash, text, CLEANER_VERSION, extractTitle(f.html, row.url), row.id]
      );
    }
    return out({ status: 'intact', baseline: true, hash, lines });
  }

  // 4b. Identique
  if (hash === row.last_hash && opts.baselineOverride === undefined) {
    log('4/5 contenu identique â†’ intact');
    if (persist) {
      await pool.query(
        `UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'intact', status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(), scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $1`,
        [row.id]
      );
    }
    return out({ status: 'intact', hash, lines });
  }

  // 4c. DiffÃ©rent : calcul du diff par le code, puis filtre des lignes Â« temporelles Â»
  const diff = significantDiff(baselineText as string, text);
  if (diff.added.length + diff.removed.length === 0) {
    log('4/5 seules des lignes temporelles ont changÃ© (date de mise Ã  jour, compteursâ€¦) â†’ ignorÃ©');
    if (persist) {
      await pool.query(
        `UPDATE web_archives SET last_hash = $1, last_content = $2, last_status = 'intact', status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW(),
           scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1 WHERE id = $3`,
        [hash, text, row.id]
      );
    }
    return out({ status: 'intact', hash, lines });
  }
  log(`4/5 changement significatif : ${diff.removed.length} ligne(s) retirÃ©e(s), ${diff.added.length} ajoutÃ©e(s)`);

  // 5. RÃ©sumÃ© IA (jamais bloquant : si Groq Ã©choue, le changement est quand mÃªme enregistrÃ©)
  log('5/5 rÃ©sumÃ© IAâ€¦');
  const s = await summarizeDiff(diff, row.url);
  if (s.summary) log(`   âœ“ rÃ©sumÃ© (${s.model}) : ${s.summary}`);
  else log(`   âœ— rÃ©sumÃ© indisponible (${s.error}) â†’ Â« rÃ©sumÃ© IA en attente Â», nouvel essai au prochain passage`);

  if (persist) {
    const payload = diffPayload(diff);
    const client = await pool.connect();
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      await client.query(
        `UPDATE web_archives SET last_status = 'modified', status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW(), diff_data = $1, last_hash = $2,
           last_content = $3, ai_summary = $4, clean_version = $5, scan_count = COALESCE(scan_count, 0) + 1, ots_proof = $7 WHERE id = $6`,
        [JSON.stringify(payload), hash, text, s.summary, CLEANER_VERSION, row.id, otsProof]
      );
      await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO web_archive_changes (archive_id, old_hash, new_hash, added_count, removed_count, diff_data, ai_summary, summary_model)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8)`,
        [row.id, row.last_hash, hash, diff.added.length, diff.removed.length, JSON.stringify(payload), s.summary, s.model ?? null]
      );
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) {
      await client.query('ROLLBACK').catch(() => {});
      throw e;
    } finally {
      client.release();
    }
  }

  return out({
    status: 'modified',
    added: diff.added.length,
    removed: diff.removed.length,
    summary: s.summary,
    summaryError: s.error,
    model: s.model,
    hash,
    lines,
  });
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// RÃ©sumÃ©s manquants : on retente ceux dont Groq avait Ã©chouÃ© (7 derniers jours)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function backfillSummaries(max = 5): Promise<number> {
  await ensureArchiveSchema();
  let done = 0;
  const q = await pool.query(
    `SELECT c.id, c.archive_id, c.diff_data, a.url
     FROM web_archive_changes c JOIN web_archives a ON a.id = c.archive_id
     WHERE c.ai_summary IS NULL AND c.detected_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
     ORDER BY c.detected_at DESC LIMIT $1`,
    [max]
  );
  for (const r of q.rows as { id: string; archive_id: string; diff_data: { details?: { type: string; text: string }[] } | null; url: string }[]) {
    const details = r.diff_data?.details || [];
    const diff: LineDiff = {
      removed: details.filter((d) => d.type === 'removed').map((d) => d.text),
      added: details.filter((d) => d.type === 'added').map((d) => d.text),
    };
    const s = await summarizeDiff(diff, r.url);
    if (!s.summary) continue;
    await pool.query('UPDATE web_archive_changes SET ai_summary = $1, summary_model = $2 WHERE id = $3', [s.summary, s.model ?? null, r.id]);
    await pool.query(
      `UPDATE web_archives SET ai_summary = $1 WHERE id = $2 AND ai_summary IS NULL AND COALESCE(last_status, status) = 'modified'`,
      [s.summary, r.archive_id]
    );
    done++;
  }
  return done;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// E-mail d'alerte (le contenu vient d'un site tiers et de l'IA : tout est Ã©chappÃ©)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function esc(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

async function notify(resend: Resend, row: ArchiveRow, o: ScanOutcome): Promise<void> {
  if (!row.email) return;
  const appUrl = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL || 'https://sceau-app.vercel.app').replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const from = process.env.MAIL_FROM || 'SCEAU Archive <onboarding@resend.dev>';
  const summary = o.summary ? esc(o.summary) : `${o.removed ?? 0} ligne(s) retirÃ©e(s), ${o.added ?? 0} ajoutÃ©e(s)`;
  const r = await resend.emails.send({
    from,
    to: row.email,
    subject: `Modification dÃ©tectÃ©e sur ${row.url.slice(0, 80)}`,
    html: `<div style="font-family:sans-serif;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto">
      <h2 style="color:#E76F51">SCEAU Archive</h2>
      <p>Une modification a Ã©tÃ© dÃ©tectÃ©e sur une page que vous surveillez :</p>
      <p><a href="${esc(row.url)}">${esc(row.url)}</a></p>
      <p><strong>${summary}</strong></p>
      <p><a href="${esc(appUrl)}/archive" style="background:#1A1513;color:#fff;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none">Voir le dÃ©tail</a></p>
    </div>`,
  });
  if (r.error) console.error('[cron] e-mail non envoyÃ© :', r.error.message);
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Passage complet (cron) : toutes les pages, par lots, dans la limite de temps de la fonction
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
export async function runArchiveScan(opts: { limit?: number; budgetMs?: number } = {}) {
  await ensureArchiveSchema();
  const started = Date.now();
  const budget = opts.budgetMs ?? 45_000;
  const limit = Math.min(Math.max(opts.limit ?? 100, 1), 500);

  const q = await pool.query(
    `SELECT a.id, a.url, a.title, a.last_hash, a.last_content, a.clean_version, a.user_id, u.email
     FROM web_archives a JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
     ORDER BY a.last_checked_at ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT $1`,
    [limit]
  );
  const rows = q.rows as ArchiveRow[];
  const resend = process.env.RESEND_API_KEY ? new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY) : null;

  const results: { url: string; status: ScanStatus; error?: string; summary?: string | null }[] = [];
  let scanned = 0;
  let modified = 0;
  let errors = 0;
  let skipped = 0;
  const BATCH = 4;

  for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i += BATCH) {
    if (Date.now() - started > budget) {
      skipped = rows.length - i;
      console.warn(`[cron] budget de temps atteint : ${skipped} page(s) reportÃ©e(s) au prochain passage`);
      break;
    }
    const batch = rows.slice(i, i + BATCH);
    const outs = await Promise.all(
      batch.map((row) =>
        scanArchive(row).catch((e): ScanOutcome => ({
          id: row.id,
          url: row.url,
          status: 'error',
          error: (e as Error).message,
          logs: [],
        }))
      )
    );
    for (let j = 0; j < outs.length; j++) {
      const o = outs[j];
      results.push({ url: o.url, status: o.status, error: o.error, summary: o.summary });
      if (o.status === 'error') errors++;
      else scanned++;
      if (o.status === 'modified') {
        modified++;
        if (resend) await notify(resend, batch[j], o).catch((e) => console.error('[cron] e-mail :', (e as Error).message));
      }
    }
  }

  let backfilled = 0;
  try {
    if (Date.now() - started < budget) backfilled = await backfillSummaries(5);
  } catch (e) {
    console.warn('[cron] rattrapage des rÃ©sumÃ©s :', (e as Error).message);
  }

  return { total: rows.length, scanned, modified, errors, skipped, backfilled, ms: Date.now() - started, results };
}

export { describeDiff };

import { safeFetch } from './safe-fetcher';
import { parse } from 'node-html-parser';
import { submitToOts } from './ots';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const MAX_PAGES = 10; // RÃ©duit pour Vercel (timeout 30s), le Cron fera le reste
const TIME_LIMIT_MS = 20000;

export type CrawledPage = {
  url: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  html: string;
  hash: string;
  ots_proof: string | null;
};

export async function crawlSite(startUrl: string): Promise<CrawledPage[]> {
  const startTime = Date.now();
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const queue = [startUrl];
  const results: CrawledPage[] = [];

  while (queue.length > 0 && Date.now() - startTime < TIME_LIMIT_MS && results.length < MAX_PAGES) {
    const url = queue.shift()!;
    if (visited.has(url)) continue;
    visited.add(url);

    const res = await safeFetch(url);
    if (!res.ok) continue;

    // 1. Nettoyage et Hachage
    const root = parse(res.html);
    const text = root.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    const hashBytes = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(text));
    const hashHex = Buffer.from(hashBytes).toString('hex');

    // 2. Ancrage Bitcoin
    let otsProof = null;
    try {
      const ots = await submitToOts(hashBytes);
      if (ots.ok && ots.proof) otsProof = ots.proof.toString('base64');
    } catch (e) {}

    results.push({
      url: res.finalUrl,
      title: root.querySelector('title')?.text || url,
      text,
      html: res.html,
      hash: hashHex,
      ots_proof: otsProof
    });

    // 3. Liens internes (typage strict)
    const base = new URL(url);
    root.querySelectorAll('a').forEach((a: any) => {
      try {
        const link = new URL(a.getAttribute('href') || '', url);
        if (link.hostname === base.hostname && link.protocol.startsWith('http') && !visited.has(link.toString())) {
          queue.push(link.toString());
        }
      } catch {}
    });
  }
  return results;
}

import { timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto';
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function same(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  const x = Buffer.from(a);
  const y = Buffer.from(b);
  return x.length === y.length && timingSafeEqual(x, y);
}

/**
 * ProtÃ¨ge les routes cron. Vercel envoie automatiquement `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>`
 * quand la variable CRON_SECRET existe dans le projet.
 * - En production, si CRON_SECRET n'est PAS dÃ©fini : tout est refusÃ© (fail-closed).
 * - En dÃ©veloppement local sans secret : accÃ¨s autorisÃ© pour faciliter les tests.
 * Renvoie null si l'accÃ¨s est autorisÃ©, sinon la rÃ©ponse d'erreur Ã  retourner.
 */
export function cronGuard(req: Request, opts: { allowQuerySecret?: boolean } = {}): NextResponse | null {
  const secret = process.env.CRON_SECRET?.trim();
  if (!secret) {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'CRON_SECRET non configurÃ© sur le serveur (accÃ¨s refusÃ©).' }, { status: 503 });
    }
    return null;
  }
  const bearer = (req.headers.get('authorization') || '').replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
  if (bearer && same(bearer, secret)) return null;
  if (opts.allowQuerySecret) {
    const q = new URL(req.url).searchParams.get('secret') || '';
    if (q && same(q, secret)) return null;
  }
  return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 401 });
}

// E2EE avec Diffie-Hellman (X25519) + AES-GCM 256
import { ed25519, x25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519';

// Helper pour convertir en Base64
function bufferToBase64(buffer: ArrayBuffer | Uint8Array): string {
  const bytes = buffer instanceof Uint8Array ? buffer : new Uint8Array(buffer);
  let binary = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < bytes.byteLength; i++) binary += String.fromCharCode(bytes[i]);
  return btoa(binary);
}

// Helper pour convertir depuis Base64
function base64ToBuffer(base64: string): Uint8Array {
  const binary = atob(base64);
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(binary.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < binary.length; i++) bytes[i] = binary.charCodeAt(i);
  return bytes;
}

// Helper ULTIME pour satisfaire TypeScript et l'API Web Crypto
// On crÃ©e une copie stricte pour s'assurer que c'est un ArrayBuffer et pas un SharedArrayBuffer
function toArrayBuffer(buf: Uint8Array): ArrayBuffer {
  return new Uint8Array(buf).buffer as ArrayBuffer;
}

// Conversion Ed25519 -> X25519 (Public)
function edPubToX25519(edPubBase64: string): Uint8Array {
  const edPub = base64ToBuffer(edPubBase64);
  return ed25519.utils.toMontgomery(edPub);
}

// Conversion Ed25519 -> X25519 (PrivÃ©)
function edPrivToX25519(edPrivBase64: string): Uint8Array {
  const edPriv = base64ToBuffer(edPrivBase64);
  return ed25519.utils.toMontgomerySecret(edPriv);
}

// DÃ©rive une clÃ© AES-GCM Ã  partir du secret partagÃ©
async function deriveAesKey(sharedSecret: Uint8Array): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const secretBuffer = toArrayBuffer(sharedSecret);
  const keyMaterial = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw', secretBuffer, { name: 'HKDF' }, false, ['deriveKey']
  );
  
  return crypto.subtle.deriveKey(
    { 
      name: 'HKDF', 
      hash: 'SHA-256', 
      salt: new Uint8Array(0).buffer as ArrayBuffer, 
      info: new Uint8Array(0).buffer as ArrayBuffer 
    },
    keyMaterial,
    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 },
    false,
    ['encrypt', 'decrypt']
  );
}

// Calcule le secret partagÃ©
async function getSharedKey(myEdPrivBase64: string, theirEdPubBase64: string): Promise<CryptoKey> {
  const myXPriv = edPrivToX25519(myEdPrivBase64);
  const theirXPub = edPubToX25519(theirEdPubBase64);
  const sharedSecret = x25519.getSharedSecret(myXPriv, theirXPub);
  return deriveAesKey(sharedSecret);
}

// CHIFFRER
export async function encryptForRecipient(
  text: string,
  myEdPrivBase64: string,
  theirEdPubBase64: string
): Promise<{ ciphertext: string, iv: string }> {
  if (!text) return { ciphertext: '', iv: '' };
  
  const aesKey = await getSharedKey(myEdPrivBase64, theirEdPubBase64);
  const iv = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
  const encoded = new TextEncoder().encode(text);
  
  const encrypted = await crypto.subtle.encrypt(
    { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: toArrayBuffer(iv) }, 
    aesKey, 
    toArrayBuffer(encoded)
  );
  
  return {
    ciphertext: bufferToBase64(encrypted),
    iv: bufferToBase64(iv)
  };
}

// DÃ‰CHIFFRER
export async function decryptFromSender(
  ciphertextBase64: string,
  ivBase64: string,
  myEdPrivBase64: string,
  theirEdPubBase64: string
): Promise<string> {
  if (!ciphertextBase64 || !ivBase64) return ciphertextBase64;
  
  try {
    const aesKey = await getSharedKey(myEdPrivBase64, theirEdPubBase64);
    const iv = base64ToBuffer(ivBase64);
    const ciphertext = base64ToBuffer(ciphertextBase64);
    
    const decrypted = await crypto.subtle.decrypt(
      { name: 'AES-GCM', iv: toArrayBuffer(iv) }, 
      aesKey, 
      toArrayBuffer(ciphertext)
    );
    
    return new TextDecoder().decode(decrypted);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[E2EE] Impossible de dÃ©chiffrer');
    return 'ğŸ”’ [Message chiffrÃ© - ClÃ© incompatible]';
  }
}

// Validation centralisÃ©e des variables d'environnement.
// Ã‰choue TÃ”T avec un message clair au lieu de produire `undefined/undefined/clÃ©`.

function clean(v: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  return v.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
}

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = clean(process.env[name]);
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Variable d'environnement manquante ou vide : ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function optional(name: string, def = ''): string {
  return clean(process.env[name]) ?? def;
}

export function requireS3(): { endpoint: string; bucket: string; region: string } {
  const endpoint = required('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = required('S3_BUCKET').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const region = optional('AWS_REGION', 'us-west-004');
  return { endpoint, bucket, region };
}

export function requireDb(): string {
  return required('DATABASE_URL');
}

// AccÃ¨s Ã  Groq avec choix DYNAMIQUE du modÃ¨le.
// Pourquoi : Groq retire rÃ©guliÃ¨rement des modÃ¨les (llama-3.1-70b-versatile en janvier 2025,
// llama-3.3-70b-versatile et llama-3.1-8b-instant en aoÃ»t 2026). Un nom de modÃ¨le Ã©crit en dur finit
// toujours par renvoyer "model_not_found". Ici on interroge /models, on choisit le meilleur modÃ¨le
// disponible, et on bascule automatiquement sur le suivant si un modÃ¨le disparaÃ®t.
//
// ForÃ§age manuel possible via la variable d'environnement GROQ_MODEL (ex. openai/gpt-oss-120b).

const API_BASE = 'https://api.groq.com/openai/v1';

// Ordre de prÃ©fÃ©rence. Remplacements recommandÃ©s par Groq pour les Llama retirÃ©s en tÃªte.
const PREFERRED = [
  'openai/gpt-oss-120b',
  'qwen/qwen3.6-27b',
  'openai/gpt-oss-20b',
  // anciens noms : gardÃ©s en dernier recours (encore actifs pour certains comptes entreprise)
  'llama-3.3-70b-versatile',
  'llama-3.1-8b-instant',
];

// ModÃ¨les qui ne sont pas des modÃ¨les de discussion texte
const NOT_CHAT = /(whisper|tts|orpheus|guard|safeguard|embed|playai|allam|compound|distil)/i;

const MODELS_TTL_MS = 10 * 60_000;
const DEAD_TTL_MS = 60 * 60_000;

let modelsCache: { ids: string[]; at: number } | null = null;
const deadModels = new Map<string, number>();

export type GroqMessage = { role: 'system' | 'user' | 'assistant'; content: string };

export type GroqResult =
  | { ok: true; text: string; model: string }
  | { ok: false; error: string; status?: number; tried: string[] };

async function listModels(apiKey: string): Promise<string[] | null> {
  if (modelsCache && Date.now() - modelsCache.at < MODELS_TTL_MS) return modelsCache.ids;
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/models`, {
      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}` },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
      cache: 'no-store',
    });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = (await res.json()) as { data?: { id?: string }[] };
    const ids = (data.data || []).map((m) => m.id || '').filter(Boolean);
    if (ids.length === 0) return null;
    modelsCache = { ids, at: Date.now() };
    return ids;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

/** Liste ordonnÃ©e des modÃ¨les Ã  essayer. */
export async function candidateModels(apiKey: string): Promise<string[]> {
  const forced = process.env.GROQ_MODEL?.trim();
  const available = await listModels(apiKey);
  const now = Date.now();
  const alive = (id: string) => (deadModels.get(id) ?? 0) < now;

  const out: string[] = [];
  const push = (id: string) => {
    if (id && !out.includes(id) && alive(id)) out.push(id);
  };

  if (forced) push(forced);

  if (available) {
    // 1) nos prÃ©fÃ©rÃ©s, dans l'ordre, s'ils sont rÃ©ellement disponibles
    for (const id of PREFERRED) if (available.includes(id)) push(id);
    // 2) sinon, n'importe quel modÃ¨le texte disponible (les plus rÃ©cents d'abord, 3 max)
    const others = available.filter((id) => !NOT_CHAT.test(id) && !PREFERRED.includes(id)).sort().reverse();
    for (const id of others.slice(0, 3)) push(id);
  } else {
    // /models injoignable : on tente nos prÃ©fÃ©rÃ©s Ã  l'aveugle
    for (const id of PREFERRED) push(id);
  }
  return out;
}

function stripThinking(s: string): string {
  return s.replace(/<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>/gi, '').trim();
}

type RawError = { error?: { message?: string; code?: string; type?: string } };

function isModelGone(status: number, body: RawError): boolean {
  const code = (body.error?.code || '').toLowerCase();
  const msg = (body.error?.message || '').toLowerCase();
  return (
    status === 404 ||
    code === 'model_not_found' ||
    code === 'model_decommissioned' ||
    msg.includes('decommissioned') ||
    msg.includes('does not exist') ||
    msg.includes('no longer supported')
  );
}

export async function groqChat(opts: {
  messages: GroqMessage[];
  maxTokens?: number;
  temperature?: number;
  /** DurÃ©e totale maximale (tous essais confondus) */
  budgetMs?: number;
}): Promise<GroqResult> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (!apiKey) return { ok: false, error: 'GROQ_API_KEY manquante', tried: [] };

  const started = Date.now();
  const budget = opts.budgetMs ?? 20_000;
  const models = await candidateModels(apiKey);
  const tried: string[] = [];
  let lastError = 'Aucun modÃ¨le Groq disponible';
  let lastStatus: number | undefined;

  for (const model of models.slice(0, 4)) {
    const remaining = budget - (Date.now() - started);
    if (remaining < 2000) break;
    tried.push(model);

    // Les modÃ¨les "raisonneurs" dÃ©pensent des jetons Ã  rÃ©flÃ©chir : on leur laisse de la marge
    // et on limite l'effort de raisonnement pour garder les rÃ©ponses courtes et rapides.
    const isReasoner = /gpt-oss|qwen3/i.test(model);
    const baseBody: Record<string, unknown> = {
      model,
      messages: opts.messages,
      max_tokens: isReasoner ? Math.max(opts.maxTokens ?? 300, 600) : opts.maxTokens ?? 300,
      temperature: opts.temperature ?? 0.2,
    };
    const variants: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
    if (/gpt-oss/i.test(model)) variants.push({ ...baseBody, reasoning_effort: 'low' });
    variants.push(baseBody);

    for (const body of variants) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/chat/completions`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify(body),
          signal: AbortSignal.timeout(Math.min(remaining, 15_000)),
          cache: 'no-store',
        });

        if (!res.ok) {
          const raw = await res.text();
          let parsed: RawError = {};
          try {
            parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as RawError;
          } catch {}
          lastStatus = res.status;
          lastError = `${model} â†’ HTTP ${res.status}: ${(parsed.error?.message || raw).slice(0, 160)}`;
          console.error('[groq]', lastError);

          if (isModelGone(res.status, parsed)) {
            deadModels.set(model, Date.now() + DEAD_TTL_MS);
            modelsCache = null; // force un nouveau listing
            break; // passe au modÃ¨le suivant
          }
          // paramÃ¨tre non supportÃ© (ex. reasoning_effort) : on retente la variante suivante
          if (res.status === 400 && body !== variants[variants.length - 1]) continue;
          break; // 401/429/5xx : modÃ¨le suivant
        }

        const data = (await res.json()) as { choices?: { message?: { content?: string } }[] };
        const text = stripThinking(data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '');
        if (text) return { ok: true, text, model };
        lastError = `${model} â†’ rÃ©ponse vide`;
        break;
      } catch (e) {
        const err = e as { name?: string; message?: string };
        lastError = `${model} â†’ ${err?.name === 'TimeoutError' ? 'timeout' : err?.message || 'erreur rÃ©seau'}`;
        console.error('[groq]', lastError);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, error: lastError, status: lastStatus, tried };
}

/** Diagnostic : quels modÃ¨les seraient utilisÃ©s (sans consommer de jetons). */
export async function groqStatus(): Promise<{ configured: boolean; available?: string[]; candidates: string[] }> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY?.trim();
  if (!apiKey) return { configured: false, candidates: [] };
  const available = (await listModels(apiKey)) || undefined;
  return { configured: true, available, candidates: await candidateModels(apiKey) };
}

import { parse } from 'node-html-parser';

export const CLEANER_VERSION = 2;

export type LineDiff = {
  removed: string[];
  added: string[];
};

export function cleanHtmlToText(html: string): string {
  const root = parse(html);
  
  // Suppression des scripts, styles, nav, footer, etc.
  root.querySelectorAll('script, style, noscript, iframe, svg, nav, header, footer, aside, form, button, select, .cookie-banner').forEach(el => el.remove());

  // PrioritÃ© au contenu principal
  const main = root.querySelector('main') || root.querySelector('article') || root;
  let text = main.textContent;

  // Nettoyage des lignes
  const lines = text.split('\n')
    .map(l => l.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim())
    .filter(l => l.length > 4 && !/^(menu|accueil|recherche|s'abonner|se connecter|fr|en)$/i.test(l));

  // DÃ©duplication
  const deduped: string[] = [];
  for (const line of lines) {
    if (deduped.length === 0 || deduped[deduped.length - 1] !== line) {
      deduped.push(line);
    }
  }
  return deduped.join('\n');
}

// Calcule le diff ligne par ligne
export function significantDiff(oldText: string, newText: string): LineDiff {
  const oldLines = new Set(oldText.split('\n').filter(Boolean));
  const newLines = new Set(newText.split('\n').filter(Boolean));

  const removed: string[] = [];
  const added: string[] = [];

  for (const l of oldLines) if (!newLines.has(l)) removed.push(l);
  for (const l of newLines) if (!oldLines.has(l)) added.push(l);

  return { removed, added };
}

// Alias pour la compatibilitÃ© avec les routes API existantes
export function isSignificantChange(oldText: string, newText: string): boolean {
  const diff = significantDiff(oldText, newText);
  // On considÃ¨re que c'est significatif s'il y a au moins une ligne ajoutÃ©e ou supprimÃ©e
  return diff.added.length > 0 || diff.removed.length > 0;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}

import { LineDiff } from './html-cleaner';

export async function summarizeDiff(diff: LineDiff, url: string): Promise<{ summary: string | null; error?: string; model?: string }> {
  const apiKey = process.env.GROQ_API_KEY;
  if (!apiKey) return { summary: null, error: 'GROQ_API_KEY manquante' };

  const context = `URL: ${url}\nRetirÃ©: ${diff.removed.join(' | ')}\nAjoutÃ©: ${diff.added.join(' | ')}`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${apiKey}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },

        messages: [
          { role: 'system', content: SYSTEM_PROMPT },
          { role: 'user', content: context },
        ],
        max_tokens: 100,
        temperature: 0.1,
      }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(8000),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      const err = await res.text();

  }

// En-tÃªte .ots complet (31 octets) :
// \x00 + "OpenTimestamps" (14) + \x00\x00 + "Proof" (5) + \x00 + 8 octets magiques
const HEADER_MAGIC = Buffer.from(
  '004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e89294',
  'hex'
);

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

const CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

export type OtsResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  // Si le calendar a renvoyÃ© une preuve partielle sans header, on l'encapsule proprement
  const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash);
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    hashBuffer,
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

// Cache mÃ©moire des robots.txt (TTL 1h)
const cache = new Map<string, { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean; expires: number }>();
const TTL = 3600_000;

export async function isAllowedByRobots(url: string, userAgent = 'SCEAU-Bot'): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    const root = `${u.protocol}//${u.hostname}`;
    const cached = cache.get(root);
    if (cached && cached.expires > Date.now()) {
      return evaluate(cached, u.pathname, userAgent);
    }

    const res = await fetch(`${root}/robots.txt`, {
      headers: { 'User-Agent': userAgent },
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000),
    });

    if (!res.ok) {
      // Pas de robots.txt = tout autorisÃ©
      const entry = { rules: [], allowAll: true, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
      cache.set(root, entry);
      return true;
    }

    const text = await res.text();
    const lines = text.split('\n').map(l => l.trim());
    const rules: string[] = [];
    let inOurSection = false;
    let allowAll = false;

    for (const line of lines) {
      if (line.startsWith('#') || !line) continue;
      const [key, ...rest] = line.split(':');
      const k = key.trim().toLowerCase();
      const v = rest.join(':').trim();
      
      if (k === 'user-agent') {
        inOurSection = v === '*' || v.toLowerCase().includes('sceau');
        if (inOurSection && v === '*') allowAll = true;
      } else if (inOurSection && (k === 'disallow' || k === 'allow')) {
        rules.push(`${k}:${v}`);
      }
    }

    const entry = { rules, allowAll, expires: Date.now() + TTL };
    cache.set(root, entry);
    return evaluate(entry, u.pathname, userAgent);
  } catch {
    // Erreur rÃ©seau : on refuse par prudence
    return false;
  }
}

function evaluate(entry: { rules: string[]; allowAll: boolean }, path: string, _ua: string): boolean {
  // RÃ¨gles les plus longues d'abord (spÃ©cifiques)
  const sorted = [...entry.rules].sort((a, b) => {
    const al = a.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    const bl = b.split(':').slice(1).join(':').length;
    return bl - al;
  });

  for (const rule of sorted) {
    const [type, pattern] = rule.split(':');
    if (!pattern) {
      if (type === 'disallow') return false;
      continue;
    }
    const regex = new RegExp('^' + pattern.replace(/[.+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*/g, '.*'));
    if (regex.test(path)) {
      return type === 'allow';
    }
  }

  return true; // Par dÃ©faut, autorisÃ©
}

// Module unique de tÃ©lÃ©chargement pour Archive, Cron et Oracle.
// RÃ¨gles : HTTPS only, pas d'IP internes, robots.txt, timeout, taille max, redirections validÃ©es.

import { isAllowedByRobots } from './robots';

const USER_AGENT = 'SCEAU-Bot/1.0 (+https://sceau-app.vercel.app)';
const TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;
const MAX_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024;
const MAX_REDIRECTS = 3;

import dns from 'dns/promises';

async function isPrivateIp(hostname: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const h = hostname.toLowerCase();
  if (h === 'localhost' || h === '127.0.0.1' || h === '::1' || h === '0.0.0.0') return true;
  
  // 1. VÃ©rification textuelle (rapide)
  if (/^10\./.test(h) || /^192\.168\./.test(h) || /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(h) || /^169\.254\./.test(h) || /^fc00:/i.test(h) || /^fe80:/i.test(h)) {
    return true;
  }

  // 2. VÃ©rification DNS (anti-rebinding)
  try {
    const addresses = await dns.resolve4(h);
    for (const ip of addresses) {
      if (
        /^10\./.test(ip) || /^127\./.test(ip) || /^192\.168\./.test(ip) ||
        /^172\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\./.test(ip) || /^169\.254\./.test(ip)
      ) return true;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return true; // Si on ne peut pas rÃ©soudre, on bloque par prÃ©caution
  }
  return false;
}

function isSafeProtocol(url: URL): boolean {
  return url.protocol === 'https:';
}

export type FetchResult =
  | { ok: true; html: string; finalUrl: string; statusCode: number }
  | { ok: false; error: string; statusCode?: number };

export async function safeFetch(inputUrl: string): Promise<FetchResult> {
  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(inputUrl);
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL invalide' };
  }

  if (!isSafeProtocol(url)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'HTTPS obligatoire' };
  }

  if (await isPrivateIp(url.hostname)) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'Adresse interne interdite' };
  }

  if (url.username || url.password) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'URL avec identifiants interdite' };
  }

  // VÃ©rifie robots.txt
  const allowed = await isAllowedByRobots(url.toString(), USER_AGENT);
  if (!allowed) {
    return { ok: false, error: 'BloquÃ© par robots.txt' };
  }

  let currentUrl = url.toString();
  let redirects = 0;

  while (redirects <= MAX_REDIRECTS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(currentUrl, {
        headers: { 'User-Agent': USER_AGENT, 'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml' },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(TIMEOUT_MS),
        redirect: 'manual',
      });

      // GÃ¨re les redirections manuellement
      if (res.status >= 300 && res.status < 400) {
        const location = res.headers.get('location');
        if (!location) return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection sans location', statusCode: res.status };
        
        const nextUrl = new URL(location, currentUrl);
        if (!isSafeProtocol(nextUrl) || await isPrivateIp(nextUrl.hostname)) {
          return { ok: false, error: 'Redirection vers destination interdite', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        currentUrl = nextUrl.toString();
        redirects++;
        continue;
      }

      if (!res.ok) {
        return { ok: false, error: `HTTP ${res.status}`, statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // VÃ©rifie Content-Length
      const contentLength = res.headers.get('content-length');
      if (contentLength && parseInt(contentLength) > MAX_BYTES) {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
      }

      // Lit en streaming avec limite
      const reader = res.body?.getReader();
      if (!reader) return { ok: false, error: 'Pas de body', statusCode: res.status };

      let bytes = 0;
      const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
      while (true) {
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (done) break;
        bytes += value.byteLength;
        if (bytes > MAX_BYTES) {
          reader.cancel();
          return { ok: false, error: 'Contenu trop lourd', statusCode: res.status };
        }
        chunks.push(value);
      }

      const html = new TextDecoder().decode(Buffer.concat(chunks));
      return { ok: true, html, finalUrl: currentUrl, statusCode: res.status };
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (e?.name === 'TimeoutError' || e?.name === 'AbortError') {
        return { ok: false, error: 'Timeout' };
      }
      return { ok: false, error: e?.message || 'Erreur rÃ©seau' };
    }
  }

  return { ok: false, error: 'Trop de redirections' };
}

// Le nettoyage du HTML vit dans un seul module (html-cleaner) pour tout le pipeline.
export { cleanHtmlToText } from './html-cleaner';

export function extractTitle(html: string, fallbackUrl: string): string {
  const t = html.match(/<title[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/title>/i);
  if (t?.[1]) {
    const clean = t[1].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 200) return clean;
  }
  const h1 = html.match(/<h1[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/h1>/i);
  if (h1?.[1]) {
    const clean = h1[1].replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (clean.length > 0 && clean.length < 100) return clean;
  }
  try {
    const u = new URL(fallbackUrl);
    return u.pathname === '/' ? u.hostname : `${u.hostname}${u.pathname}`;
  } catch {
    return fallbackUrl;
  }
}

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const projRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT p.*, u.handle as author, parent.title as parent_title
      FROM projects p
      JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id
      LEFT JOIN projects parent ON p.parent_id = parent.id
      WHERE p.id = $1
    `, [id]);
    if (projRes.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    const project = projRes.rows[0];
    const rootId = project.root_id || project.id;

    const filesRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT pf.id, pf.file_name, pf.file_hash, pf.file_size, pf.file_path, pf.uploaded_by,
             u.handle as uploaded_by_handle
      FROM project_files pf
      LEFT JOIN users u ON pf.uploaded_by = u.id
      WHERE pf.project_id = $1 ORDER BY pf.file_name ASC
    `, [id]);

    const membersRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT u.handle, u.id as user_id, pm.role, pm.added_at
      FROM project_members pm JOIN users u ON pm.user_id = u.id
      WHERE pm.project_id = $1 ORDER BY pm.added_at ASC
    `, [id]);

    const versionsRes = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, title, version_number, created_at, ots_proof
      FROM projects WHERE root_id = $1
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
    `, [rootId]);

    const latestId = versionsRes.rows[versionsRes.rows.length - 1]?.id;
    const isLatest = latestId === id;

    return NextResponse.json({
      ...project,
      files: filesRes.rows,
      members: membersRes.rows,
      versions: versionsRes.rows,
      is_latest: isLatest,
    });
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('[projects/[id] GET]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const { pubkey, handle } = await req.json();
    if (!pubkey || !handle) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const project = await pool.query("SELECT author_id FROM projects WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (project.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    if (project.rows[0].author_id !== user.rows[0].id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 403 });
    const target = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1)", [handle.replace('@','')]);
    if (target.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Utilisateur introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    await pool.query("INSERT INTO project_members (project_id, user_id, role) VALUES ($1, $2, 'member') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING", [id, target.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { buildMerkleRoot } from '@/lib/merkle';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const data = await req.formData();
    const pubkey = data.get('pubkey') as string;
    const filesToKeepStr = (data.get('files_to_keep') as string) || '[]';
    if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    const oldRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (oldRes.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    const oldProject = oldRes.rows[0];

    const isOwner = oldProject.author_id === userId;
    const isMember = (await pool.query("SELECT 1 FROM project_members WHERE project_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, userId])).rows.length > 0;
    if (!isOwner && !isMember) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 403 });

    const filesToKeep = JSON.parse(filesToKeepStr) as string[];
    const keptFilesRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM project_files WHERE project_id = $1 AND file_name = ANY($2)", [id, filesToKeep]);

    // Nouveaux fichiers (juste leurs hashs, pas d'upload pour l'instant)
    const newFiles = (data.getAll('new_files') as File[]).filter(f => f && f.size > 0);
    const newFileRecords: { name: string; hash: string; size: number; path: string | null }[] = [];
    for (const file of newFiles) {
      const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
      const hash = Buffer.from(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buffer)).toString('base64');
      newFileRecords.push({ name: file.name, hash, size: buffer.length, path: null });
    }

    const allHashes = [...keptFilesRes.rows.map(f => f.file_hash), ...newFileRecords.map(f => f.hash)];
    const merkleRoot = buildMerkleRoot(allHashes);

    const client = await pool.connect();
    let newId: string;
    try {
      await client.query('BEGIN');
      const maxVRes = await client.query("SELECT MAX(version_number) as m FROM projects WHERE root_id = $1", [oldProject.root_id || oldProject.id]);
      const newVersion = (maxVRes.rows[0].m || 0) + 1;
      
      const newProjectRes = await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO projects (author_id, title, description, merkle_root, parent_id, root_id, version_number)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7) RETURNING id`,
        [oldProject.author_id, oldProject.title, oldProject.description, merkleRoot, id, oldProject.root_id || oldProject.id, newVersion]
      );
      newId = newProjectRes.rows[0].id;

      for (const f of keptFilesRes.rows) {
        await client.query(`INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path, uploaded_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
          [newId, f.file_name, f.file_hash, f.file_size, f.file_path, f.uploaded_by]);
      }
      for (const f of newFileRecords) {
        await client.query(`INSERT INTO project_files (project_id, file_name, file_hash, file_size, file_path, uploaded_by) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)`,
          [newId, f.name, f.hash, f.size, f.path, userId]);
      }
      await client.query('COMMIT');
    } catch (e) { await client.query('ROLLBACK'); throw e; }
    finally { client.release(); }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, project_id: newId });
  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function POST(req: Request, { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const { id } = await params;
  try {
    const { pubkey } = await req.json();
    if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    const sourceRes = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = $1", [id]);
    if (sourceRes.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
    const source = sourceRes.rows[0];
    if (source.author_id !== user.rows[0].id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Non autorisÃ©' }, { status: 403 });

    const latestRes = await pool.query("SELECT id, version_number FROM projects WHERE root_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1", [source.root_id || source.id]);

    finally { client.release(); }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, project_id: newId });

    return NextResponse.json({ error: e?.message || 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  const pubkeyInput = document.getElementById('pubkey');
  const sealBtn = document.getElementById('sealBtn');
  const status = document.getElementById('status');

  chrome.storage.local.get(['sceau_pubkey'], (result) => {
    if (result.sceau_pubkey) pubkeyInput.value = result.sceau_pubkey;
  });

  sealBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const pubkey = pubkeyInput.value.trim();
    if (!pubkey) return alert("Veuillez entrer votre clÃ© publique.");

    chrome.storage.local.set({ sceau_pubkey: pubkey });
    sealBtn.innerText = 'Envoi en cours...';

    chrome.tabs.query({ active: true, currentWindow: true }, async (tabs) => {
      const url = tabs[0].url;
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch('https://sceau-app.vercel.app/api/archive', {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ pubkey, url })
        });
        
        if (res.ok) {
          sealBtn.style.display = 'none';
          status.style.display = 'block';
        } else {
          const d = await res.json();
          alert("Erreur : " + d.error);
          sealBtn.innerText = 'Sceller cette page';
        }
      } catch (e) {
        alert("Erreur rÃ©seau. VÃ©rifiez votre connexion.");
        sealBtn.innerText = 'Sceller cette page';
      }
    });
  });
});

// Service Worker de base pour la PWA SCEAU
self.addEventListener('install', (event) => {
  self.skipWaiting();
});

self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(clients.claim());
});

// Ã‰couteur pour les notifications Push (simulÃ© pour le lancement)
self.addEventListener('push', function(event) {
  const data = event.data ? event.data.json() : { title: 'SCEAU', body: 'Nouvelle preuve gravÃ©e.' };
  
  const options = {
    body: data.body,
    icon: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=S&background=E76F51&color=fff&size=192',
    badge: 'https://ui-avatars.com/api/?name=S&background=E76F51&color=fff&size=96',
    vibrate: [100, 50, 100],
    data: { url: data.url || '/feed' }
  };

  event.waitUntil(
    self.registration.showNotification(data.title, options)
  );
});

// Clic sur la notification
self.addEventListener('notificationclick', function(event) {
  event.notification.close();
  event.waitUntil(
    clients.openWindow(event.notification.data.url)
  );
});

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';
export const maxDuration = 30; // NÃ©cessaire pour le temps de fetch

// Fonction utilitaire pour hasher le contenu
function hashContent(content: string): string {
  const hash = sha256(new TextEncoder().encode(content));
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

// GET : Lister les archives de l'utilisateur
export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  if (!pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'ClÃ© manquante' }, { status: 401 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const result = await pool.query(`
      SELECT id, url, title, status, last_checked_at, created_at 
      FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC
    `, [user.rows[0].id]);
    
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      archives: result.rows, 
      is_pro: user.rows[0].is_pro,
      limit: user.rows[0].is_pro ? 50 : 3
    });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// POST : Ajouter une URL
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, url, action } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !url) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, is_pro FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro;

    // 1. VÃ©rification du quota
    const countQuery = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM web_archives WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
    const currentCount = parseInt(countQuery.rows[0].count);
    const maxLimit = isPro ? 50 : 3;

    if (currentCount >= maxLimit && action !== 'check') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: `Quota atteint (${maxLimit} URLs max). Passez Ã  SCEAU PRO pour en ajouter plus.` }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // 2. Si c'est une vÃ©rification (action === 'check')
    if (action === 'check') {
      const archive = await pool.query("SELECT id, url, last_hash FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [url, userId]); // Ici 'url' contient l'ID
      if (archive.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Archive introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
      
      const targetUrl = archive.rows[0].url;
      const oldHash = archive.rows[0].last_hash;

      const res = await fetch(targetUrl, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
      const html = await res.text();
      const newHash = hashContent(html);

      const isModified = oldHash !== newHash;
      
      if (isModified) {
        await pool.query("UPDATE web_archives SET status = 'modified', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1", [url]); // 'url' = id
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'modified' });
      } else {
        await pool.query("UPDATE web_archives SET status = 'intact', last_checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1", [url]);
        return NextResponse.json({ status: 'intact' });
      }
    }

    // 3. Sinon, c'est une nouvelle URL
    if (!url.startsWith('http://') && !url.startsWith('https://')) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'URL invalide (doit commencer par http)' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Fetch initial
    const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'SCEAU-Archive-Bot/1.0' } });
    if (!res.ok) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Impossible de joindre le site web.' }, { status: 400 });
    
    const html = await res.text();
    const newHash = hashContent(html);
    const title = new URL(url).hostname;

    const insert = await pool.query(`
      INSERT INTO web_archives (user_id, url, title, last_hash, status) 
      VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'intact') RETURNING id
    `, [userId, url, title, newHash]);

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, id: insert.rows[0].id });

  } catch (e: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur lors du traitement : ' + e.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE : Supprimer une URL
export async function DELETE(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey');
  const id = searchParams.get('id');

  if (!pubkey || !id) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    await pool.query("DELETE FROM web_archives WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [id, user.rows[0].id]);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (e) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

    );

    console.error(e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });

// POST : GÃ©nÃ©rer une nouvelle clÃ©
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { pubkey, name } = await req.json();
  if (!pubkey || !name) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });

    // GÃ©nÃ©rer une clÃ© alÃ©atoire (sceau_live_ + 32 caractÃ¨res hexadÃ©cimaux)
    const rawKey = `sceau_live_${crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex')}`;
    
    // On ne stocke que le hash SHA-256 de la clÃ© en base de donnÃ©es
    const keyHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(rawKey).digest('hex');

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO api_keys (user_id, key_hash, name) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)",
      [user.rows[0].id, keyHash, name]
    );

    // On retourne la clÃ© EN CLAIR une seule fois. Elle ne sera plus jamais visible.
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, key: rawKey });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

// DELETE : RÃ©voquer une clÃ©

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/auth/login/route.ts

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

const loginCache = new Map<string, { count: number, resetAt: number }>();

function checkLimit(ip: string) {
  const now = Date.now();
  let e = loginCache.get(ip);
  if (!e || e.resetAt < now) { e = { count: 0, resetAt: now + 60000 }; loginCache.set(ip, e); }
  if (e.count >= 5) return false;
  e.count++;
  return true;
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const ip = req.headers.get('x-forwarded-for') || 'unknown';
  if (!checkLimit(ip)) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Trop de tentatives. RÃ©essayez dans 1 minute.' }, { status: 429 });

  try {
    const { email, password } = await req.json();

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = $1", [email]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const isValid = await bcrypt.compare(password, user.rows[0].password_hash);
    if (!isValid) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    // On renvoie le handle et la clÃ© publique (convertie en base64)
    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle,
      pubkey: Buffer.from(user.rows[0].pubkey).toString('base64')
    });
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { token, newPassword } = await req.json();
  if (!token || !newPassword) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs requis' }, { status: 400 });

  const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE reset_token = $1 AND reset_expiry > NOW()", [token]);
  if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Lien invalide ou expirÃ©' }, { status: 400 });

  const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10);
  const password_hash = await bcrypt.hash(newPassword, salt);

  await pool.query("UPDATE users SET password_hash = $1, reset_token = NULL, reset_expiry = NULL WHERE id = $2", [password_hash, user.rows[0].id]);

  return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
}

import { pool } from '@/db/pool';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  try {
    const { handle, email, password, pubkey } = await req.json();

    if (!handle || !email || !password || !pubkey) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tous les champs sont requis' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const salt = await bcrypt.genSalt(10);
    const password_hash = await bcrypt.hash(password, salt);

    const result = await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO users (handle, email, password_hash, pubkey) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, decode($4, 'base64')) RETURNING id, handle", 
      [handle, email, password_hash, pubkey]
    );
    
    return NextResponse.json(result.rows[0]);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Erreur d'inscription:", error);
    if (error.code === '23505') {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Ce pseudo ou cet email est dÃ©jÃ  pris' }, { status: 409 });
    }
    // On renvoie le VRAI message d'erreur pour le dÃ©bogage
    return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message || 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const voterId = user.rows[0].id;

    // VÃ©rifier qu'il ne vote pas pour lui-mÃªme
    const entry = await pool.query("SELECT user_id FROM challenge_entries WHERE id = $1", [entry_id]);
    if (entry.rows.length > 0 && entry.rows[0].user_id === voterId) {
      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Tu ne peux pas voter pour ta propre Å“uvre !' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    await pool.query(
      "INSERT INTO challenge_votes (challenge_id, voter_id, entry_id) VALUES ($1, $2, $3) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING",
      [challenge_id, voterId, entry_id]
    );
    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

// Ajouter un commentaire
export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const { seal_id, pubkey, content } = await req.json();
  if (!seal_id || !pubkey || !content) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

  try {
    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id, handle FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const myId = user.rows[0].id;

    await pool.query("INSERT INTO comments (seal_id, user_id, content) VALUES ($1, $2, $3)", [seal_id, myId, content]);

    // CrÃ©er une notification pour l'auteur de l'Å“uvre
    const seal = await pool.query("SELECT author_id, title FROM seals WHERE id = $1", [seal_id]);
    if (seal.rows.length > 0 && seal.rows[0].author_id !== myId) {
      await pool.query(
        "INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, actor_id, type, message, link) VALUES ($1, $2, 'comment', $3, $4)",
        [seal.rows[0].author_id, myId, `a commentÃ© ton Å“uvre "${seal.rows[0].title}"`, `/o/${seal_id}`]
      );
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });
  } catch (error) { return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 }); }
}

  try {
    const { creation_id, pubkey } = await req.json();
    if (!creation_id || !pubkey) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Champs manquants' }, { status: 400 });

    const user = await pool.query("SELECT id FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1", [pubkey]);
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 401 });
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;

    // VÃ©rifier si le like existe dÃ©jÃ 
    const existing = await pool.query("SELECT 1 FROM creation_likes WHERE attachment_id = $1 AND user_id = $2", [creation_id, userId]);

      // On retire le like

      await pool.query("INSERT INTO creation_likes (attachment_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2)", [creation_id, userId]);
      return NextResponse.json({ liked: true });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('[creation_like]', e);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur' }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

FICHIER : ./src/app/api/creations/route.ts
