'use client';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { ed25519 } from '@noble/curves/ed25519';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Signup() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState('');

  async function handleSignup() {
    if (!handle || !email || !password) return setStatus("Tous les champs sont requis");
    setStatus("CrÃ©ation en cours...");
    
    try {
      const secret = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32));
      const pubkey = ed25519.getPublicKey(secret);
      let pubkeyStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < pubkey.length; i++) pubkeyStr += String.fromCharCode(pubkey[i]);
      let secretStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < secret.length; i++) secretStr += String.fromCharCode(secret[i]);
      const pubkeyB64 = btoa(pubkeyStr);

      localStorage.setItem('sceau_secret', btoa(secretStr));

      const res = await fetch('/api/auth/signup', { 
        method: 'POST', 
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, 
        body: JSON.stringify({ handle, email, password, pubkey: pubkeyB64 }) 
      });
      
      const data = await res.json();
      
      if (res.ok) {
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_pubkey', pubkeyB64);
        localStorage.setItem('sceau_handle', handle);
        setStatus("âœ… Compte crÃ©Ã© !");
        setTimeout(() => router.push('/feed'), 500);
      } else {
        setStatus("âŒ " + (data.error || "Une erreur est survenue"));
      }
    } catch (e) { setStatus("âŒ Impossible de contacter le serveur. VÃ©rifiez votre connexion."); }
  }

  const handleKeyPress = (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') handleSignup(); };

  return (
    <div className="max-w-md mx-auto bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-3xl border border-[var(--border-color)] shadow-sm mt-10">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-6 font-serif" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>CrÃ©er un compte</h1>
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Pseudo</label>
      <input type="text" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={handle} onChange={(e) => setHandle(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Email</label>
      <input type="email" onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl mb-4 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={email} onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)} />
      
      <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-1 font-mono">Mot de passe</label>
      <div className="relative mb-6">
        <input type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"} onKeyDown={handleKeyPress} className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl pr-10 bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={password} onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)} />
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)} className="absolute right-3 top-3 opacity-50">{showPassword ? "ğŸ™ˆ" : "ğŸ‘ï¸"}</button>
      </div>
      
      <button onClick={handleSignup} className="w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E76F51] to-[#F4A261] text-white p-4 rounded-xl font-bold">S'inscrire</button>
      {status && <p className="mt-4 text-center font-bold text-[#E76F51]">{status}</p>}
      
      <p className="text-center mt-4 text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">DÃ©jÃ  un compte ? <Link href="/login" className="underline font-bold">Se connecter</Link></p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useParams } from 'next/navigation';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function PublicProfile() {
  const params = useParams();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [myHandle, setMyHandle] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    setMyHandle(h);
    if (params.handle) {
      fetch(`/api/user-profile/${params.handle}?viewer=${h || ''}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => { setData(d); setLoading(false); });
    }
  }, [params.handle]);

  async function addFriend() {
    await fetch('/api/friends', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ me: myHandle, target: data.handle }) });
    alert(`Demande d'ami envoyÃ©e Ã  @${data.handle} !`);

  };

  if (data?.error) return <div className="p-10 text-center font-mono text-red-500">{data.error}</div>;

  );

'use client';
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link'; // L'IMPORT MANQUANT EST ICI
import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

export default function Verify() {
  const [tab, setTab] = useState('file');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [titleQuery, setTitleQuery] = useState('');
  
  const [timelineData, setTimelineData] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [timelineLoading, setTimelineLoading] = useState(true);
  const [timelineMode, setTimelineMode] = useState<'live' | 'period'>('live');
  const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState('');
  const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (tab !== 'timeline') return;
    const fetchTimeline = () => {
      setTimelineLoading(true);
      const url = timelineMode === 'live' 
        ? '/api/verify/timeline?live=true'
        : `/api/verify/timeline?start=${startDate}&end=${endDate}`;
        
      fetch(url).then(res => res.json()).then(data => {
        setTimelineData(data.timeline || []);
        setTimelineLoading(false);
      });
    };
    fetchTimeline();
    if (timelineMode === 'live') {
      const interval = setInterval(fetchTimeline, 5000);
      return () => clearInterval(interval);
    }
  }, [tab, timelineMode, startDate, endDate]);

  async function verifyFile(file: File) {
    setLoading(true);
    const buffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const hash = sha256(new Uint8Array(buffer));
    let hashStr = ''; for (let i = 0; i < hash.length; i++) hashStr += String.fromCharCode(hash[i]);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: btoa(hashStr) }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function verifyHash(input: string) {
    if(!input) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ hash: input }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  async function searchByTitle() {
    if(!titleQuery) return; setLoading(true);
    const res = await fetch('/api/verify', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ query: titleQuery }) });
    const data = await res.json(); setResult(data); setLoading(false);
  }

  const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((new Date().getTime() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return "Ã€ l'instant";
    if (diff === 1) return "Il y a 1 minute";
    if (diff < 60) return `Il y a ${diff} minutes`;
    return new Date(dateStr).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR');
  };

  return (
    <div className="p-6 max-w-2xl md:max-w-5xl mx-auto font-sans w-full">
      <div className="flex justify-center mb-6">
        <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-xl border border-[var(--border-color)]">
          <Link href="/seal" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm opacity-50 hover:opacity-100 transition">âœï¸ Sceller</Link>
          <Link href="/verify" className="px-6 py-2 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm bg-[var(--bg-surface)] shadow text-[#E76F51]">ğŸ” VÃ©rifier</Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold mb-2 text-center" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>VÃ©rifier & DÃ©couvrir.</h1>
      <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)] italic mb-6 text-center">Prouvez l'authenticitÃ© ou dÃ©couvrez le monde.</p>
      
      <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-1 rounded-xl mb-6">
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('file');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='file'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Fichier</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('hash');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='hash'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Hash</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('title');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='title'?'bg-[var(--bg-main)] shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>Titre</button>
        <button onClick={()=>{setTab('timeline');setResult(null)}} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-xs font-mono font-bold rounded-lg ${tab==='timeline'?'bg-[#E76F51] text-white shadow':'opacity-50'}`} style={{color: tab==='timeline' ? '#FFF' : 'var(--text-main)'}}>Chronologie</button>
      </div>

      {tab === 'file' && (
        <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-[#4A90C2] bg-[var(--bg-surface)] p-8 rounded-xl text-center">
          <input type="file" onChange={e=>e.target.files?.[0] && verifyFile(e.target.files[0])} className="w-full text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'hash' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Collez le hash (ex: b2e7...)" className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none font-mono bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} onChange={e=>verifyHash(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'title' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <input type="text" placeholder="Titre de l'Å“uvre (ex: Mon premier roman)" className="w-full border-2 border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl outline-none bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} value={titleQuery} onChange={e=>setTitleQuery(e.target.value)} onKeyDown={e => e.key === 'Enter' && searchByTitle()} />
          <button onClick={searchByTitle} className="w-full bg-[#4A90C2] text-white py-3 rounded-xl font-bold">Rechercher</button>
        </div>
      )}

      {tab === 'timeline' && (
        <div className="space-y-5">
          
          {/* Filtres de la frise */}
          <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-col gap-3">
            <div className="flex bg-[var(--bg-main)] p-1 rounded-lg">
              <button onClick={() => setTimelineMode('live')} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition ${timelineMode === 'live' ? 'bg-white shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>En direct</button>
              <button onClick={() => setTimelineMode('period')} className={`flex-1 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-md transition ${timelineMode === 'period' ? 'bg-white shadow text-[#E76F51]' : 'opacity-50'}`}>Par pÃ©riode</button>
            </div>
            
            {timelineMode === 'period' && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <input type="date" value={startDate} onChange={e => setStartDate(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
                <input type="date" value={endDate} onChange={e => setEndDate(e.target.value)} className="flex-1 border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-2 text-xs bg-transparent" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}} />
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {timelineLoading ? (
            <p className="text-center font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] py-10">Synchronisation...</p>
          ) : timelineData.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-center italic text-[var(--text-muted)] py-10">Aucun sceau sur cette pÃ©riode.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="relative pl-6">
              {/* La ligne verticale */}
              <div className="absolute left-2.5 top-2 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-[#E76F51] opacity-30"></div>

              <div className="space-y-6">
                {timelineData.map((item, index) => (
                  <div key={item.id} className="relative animate-fade-in">
                    {/* Le point */}
                    <div className="absolute -left-[1.35rem] top-1.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[#E76F51] border-2 border-[var(--bg-main)] shadow-sm"></div>
                    
                    <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] p-3 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:border-[#E76F51] transition">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
                        <span className="font-bold text-xs" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>@{item.author}</span>
                        <span className="text-[0.6rem] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">{timeAgo(item.timestamp)}</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="font-bold text-sm" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{item.title}</div>
                      <div className="text-[0.65rem] font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">{item.category}</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {tab !== 'pulse' && result && (
        <div className={`mt-8 p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 ${result.found ? 'bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border-[#7A9B5A]' : 'bg-[#FDF4F0] border-[#D64545]'}`}>
          {result.found ? (
            <div>
              <div className="text-center mb-6">
                <div className="text-3xl mb-2"></div>
                <h2 className="font-bold text-xl" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{tab === 'title' ? 'Å’UVRES TROUVÃ‰ES' : 'FICHIER AUTHENTIQUE'}</h2>
                <p className="text-sm text-[var(--text-muted)]">{result.seals.length} preuve(s)</p>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                {result.seals.map((seal: any, index: number) => (
                  <div key={index} className={`p-4 rounded-xl border ${index === 0 ? 'border-[#E76F51] bg-[var(--bg-main)]' : 'border-[var(--border-color)]'}`}>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                      <div>
                        <div className="font-bold" style={{color: 'var(--text-main)'}}>{seal.title}</div>
                        <div className="text-xs text-[var(--text-muted)] mt-1">
                          Par <span className="font-bold text-[#E76F51]">@{seal.author}</span> le {new Date(seal.timestamp).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}
                        </div>
                        {seal.type === 'project' && (
                          <div className="mt-2 inline-block bg-[#F0F6FC] border border-[#C9D8E8] text-[#2D6A9E] px-2 py-1 rounded text-[0.65rem] font-bold">
                            ğŸ›¡ï¸ Fait partie du dossier : {seal.project_title}

                    {seal.is_hosted && seal.file_path && (

'use client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

export default function Cockpit() {
  const [handle, setHandle] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<any>(null);
  const [activities, setActivities] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [pendingPacts, setPendingPacts] = useState(0);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const h = localStorage.getItem('sceau_handle');
    const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
    setHandle(h);

    if (!pubkey) { setLoading(false); return; }

    // Profil
    fetch(`/api/profil?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => { if (d.handle) setProfile(d); })
      .catch(() => {});

    // ActivitÃ© (rafraÃ®chie toutes les 30s)
    const fetchActivity = () => {
      fetch(`/api/profil/activity?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(d => setActivities(d.activities || []))
        .catch(() => {});
    };
    fetchActivity();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchActivity, 30000);

    // Pactes en attente
    fetch(`/api/pacts/pending?pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}`)
      .then(r => r.json())
      .then(d => setPendingPacts(d.count || 0))
      .catch(() => {});

    setLoading(false);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  // Stockage dynamique
  const maxQuotaGB = 0.1; // 100 Mo Free
  const usedBytes = profile?.used_bytes || 0;
  const usedGB = (usedBytes / (1024 * 1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2);
  const percentage = Math.min(100, (parseFloat(usedGB) / maxQuotaGB) * 100);

  // Ã‰quipe dynamique (toi + amis)
  const teamCount = 1 + (profile?.friends_count || 0);
  const teamMax = 1; // Free = 1 siÃ¨ge, PRO = 5

    if (diff < 1440) return `il y a ${Math.floor(diff/60)}h`;
    return `il y a ${Math.floor(diff/1440)}j`;
  }

  return (
    <aside className="hidden lg:flex flex-col w-[340px] bg-[var(--bg-main)] border-l border-[var(--border-color)] h-full overflow-y-auto shrink-0">
      
      {/* BLOC 1 : STATUT & QUOTAS RÃ‰ELS */}
      <div className="p-6 border-b border-[var(--border-color)]">
        <h3 className="text-xs font-mono font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[var(--text-muted)] mb-4">Mon Espace Pro</h3>
        
        <div className="bg-[var(--bg-surface)] border border-[var(--border-color)] rounded-lg p-4 shadow-sm mb-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[var(--text-main)]">Stockage</span>
            <span className="text-xs font-mono text-[var(--text-muted)]">{usedGB} Go / {maxQuotaGB} Go</span>
          </div>
          <div className="w-full bg-[var(--border-color)] rounded-full h-2 mb-4 overflow-hidden">
            <div className={`h-2 rounded-full ${percentage > 90 ? 'bg-red-500' : 'bg-[#4A90C2]'}`} style={{ width: `${percentage}%` }}></div>
          </div>
          
          <div className="flex justify-between text-xs border-t border-[var(--border-color)] pt-3">
            <div>
              <p className="font-bold text-[var(--text-main)]">{profile?.sealed || 0}</p>
              <p className="text-[var(--text-muted)]">Sceaux au total</p>
            </div>
            <div className="text-right">
              <p className="font-bold text-[var(--text-main)]">Ã‰quipe</p>
              <Link href="/friends" className="text-[var(--orange)] hover:underline">{teamCount} / {teamMax} siÃ¨ge{teamCount > 1 ? 's' : ''}</Link>

          </div>

      </div>

FICHIER : ./src/db/pool.ts

import { Pool } from 'pg';
import { requireDb } from '@/lib/env';

let _pool: Pool | null = null;

function create(): Pool {
  const url = requireDb();
  const pool = new Pool({
    connectionString: url,
    max: 5,
    idleTimeoutMillis: 30_000,
    connectionTimeoutMillis: 10_000,
    ssl: { rejectUnauthorized: true },
  });
  pool.on('error', (err) => {
    console.error('[pg] idle client error:', err.message);
  });
  return pool;
}

export function getPool(): Pool {
  if (!_pool) _pool = create();
  return _pool;
}

// Compat : `import { pool } from '@/db/pool'` continue de fonctionner.
export const pool = new Proxy({} as Pool, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getPool() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

function isDbError(e: any): boolean {
  const code = e?.code;
  if (['ECONNREFUSED', 'ENOTFOUND', 'ETIMEDOUT', '28P01', '3D000', '57P01'].includes(code)) return true;
  return /ECONNREFUSED|ENOTFOUND|timeout|connect.*pool|database/i.test(String(e?.message || ''));
}

export function apiError(e: unknown, fallback = 'Erreur serveur'): NextResponse {
  if (isDbError(e)) {
    console.error('[api-error] base injoignable :', (e as any)?.message);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Base de donnÃ©es injoignable. RÃ©essayez dans un instant.' },
      { status: 503 }
    );
  }
  console.error('[api-error]', e);
  return NextResponse.json({ error: fallback }, { status: 500 });
}

// Validation centralisÃ©e des variables d'environnement.
// Ã‰choue TÃ”T avec un message clair au lieu de produire `undefined/undefined/clÃ©`.

function clean(v: string | undefined): string | undefined {
  if (!v) return undefined;
  return v.trim().replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '');
}

function required(name: string): string {
  const v = clean(process.env[name]);
  if (!v) throw new Error(`Variable d'environnement manquante ou vide : ${name}`);
  return v;
}

function optional(name: string, def = ''): string {
  return clean(process.env[name]) ?? def;
}

export function requireS3(): { endpoint: string; bucket: string; region: string } {
  const endpoint = required('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = required('S3_BUCKET').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const region = optional('AWS_REGION', 'us-west-004');
  return { endpoint, bucket, region };
}

export function requireDb(): string {
  return required('DATABASE_URL');
}

FICHIER : ./src/lib/merkle.ts

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

/**
 * Prend une liste de hashs (en Base64) et calcule le Hash Racine (Merkle Root).
 * Utilise Uint8Array pour Ã©viter les conflits de types avec Buffer.
 */
export function buildMerkleRoot(hashesB64: string[]): string {
  if (hashesB64.length === 0) return '';
  if (hashesB64.length === 1) return hashesB64[0];

  // Convertir les hashs Base64 en Uint8Array
  let currentLevel: Uint8Array[] = hashesB64.map(h => {
    const binaryString = atob(h);
    const bytes = new Uint8Array(binaryString.length);
    for (let i = 0; i < binaryString.length; i++) {
      bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
    }
    return bytes;
  });

  while (currentLevel.length > 1) {
    const nextLevel: Uint8Array[] = [];
    
    for (let i = 0; i < currentLevel.length; i += 2) {
      if (i + 1 < currentLevel.length) {
        // ConcatÃ©ner les deux hashs
        const combined = new Uint8Array(currentLevel[i].length + currentLevel[i + 1].length);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i], 0);
        combined.set(currentLevel[i + 1], currentLevel[i].length);
        
        // Calculer le hash du rÃ©sultat
        const hash = sha256(combined);
        nextLevel.push(hash);
      } else {
        // S'il reste un Ã©lÃ©ment impair, on le passe au niveau supÃ©rieur
        nextLevel.push(currentLevel[i]);
      }
    }
    currentLevel = nextLevel;
  }

  // Convertir le Uint8Array final en Base64
  const root = currentLevel[0];
  let binary = '';
  const len = root.byteLength;
  for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(root[i]);
  }
  
  return btoa(binary);
}

FICHIER : ./src/lib/ots.ts

// En-tÃªte .ots complet (31 octets) :
// \x00 + "OpenTimestamps" (14) + \x00\x00 + "Proof" (5) + \x00 + 8 octets magiques
const HEADER_MAGIC = Buffer.from(
  '004f70656e54696d657374616d7073000050726f6f6600bf89e2e884e89294',
  'hex'
);

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

const CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_PROOF_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

export type OtsResult = {
  ok: boolean;
  proof?: Buffer;
  calendars: string[];
  error?: string;
};

function toDetachedOts(hash: Uint8Array, calendarBody: Buffer): Buffer {
  if (calendarBody.length >= HEADER_MAGIC.length &&
      calendarBody.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
    return calendarBody;
  }
  // Si le calendar a renvoyÃ© une preuve partielle sans header, on l'encapsule proprement
  const hashBuffer = Buffer.from(hash);
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_MAGIC,
    Buffer.from([0x01, 0x08]), // version 1 + op SHA-256
    hashBuffer,
    calendarBody,
  ]);
}

async function submitOne(url: string, hash: Uint8Array): Promise<Buffer> {
  const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream',
      Accept: 'application/vnd.opentimestamps.v1',
      'User-Agent': 'sceau/1.0',
    },
    body: Buffer.from(hash),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
    cache: 'no-store',
  });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
  const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
  if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
  if (buf[0] === 0x3c || buf[0] === 0x7b) throw new Error('rÃ©ponse non binaire (HTML/JSON)');
  return buf;
}

export async function submitToOts(hash: Uint8Array): Promise<OtsResult> {
  if (hash.length !== 32) return { ok: false, calendars: [], error: 'hash_invalid_length' };

  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(CALENDARS.map((u) => submitOne(u, hash)));

  const successes: string[] = [];
  let body: Buffer | undefined;
  settled.forEach((r, i) => {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled') {
      successes.push(CALENDARS[i]);
      if (!body) body = r.value;
    }
  });

  if (!body) return { ok: false, calendars: successes, error: 'all_calendars_failed' };
  return { ok: true, proof: toDetachedOts(hash, body), calendars: successes };
}

// Upgrade : interroge les calendars avec le hash de l'ENGAGEMENT contenu dans la preuve
// (pas le hash du fichier â€” sinon Ã§a ne confirme jamais).
export async function upgradeOts(hash: Uint8Array, proofBase64: string): Promise<Buffer | null> {
  let engagement: Uint8Array = hash;
  try {
    const raw = Buffer.from(proofBase64, 'base64');
    if (raw.length > HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34 &&
        raw.subarray(0, HEADER_MAGIC.length).equals(HEADER_MAGIC)) {
      const version = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length];
      const op = raw[HEADER_MAGIC.length + 1];
      if (version === 0x01 && op === 0x08) {
        engagement = raw.subarray(HEADER_MAGIC.length + 2, HEADER_MAGIC.length + 34);
      }
    }
  } catch { /* fallback hash */ }

  const hashHex = Buffer.from(engagement).toString('hex');
  const settled = await Promise.allSettled(
    CALENDARS.map(async (url) => {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/timestamp/${hashHex}`, {
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CALENDAR_TIMEOUT_MS),
        cache: 'no-store',
      });
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`);
      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      if (buf.length === 0 || buf.length > MAX_PROOF_BYTES) throw new Error('taille invalide');
      return buf;
    })
  );

  let best: Buffer | null = null;
  for (const r of settled) {
    if (r.status === 'fulfilled' && (!best || r.value.length > best.length)) best = r.value;
  }
  return best;
}

export function generatePortfolioPDF(

  let dateText = `GÃ©nÃ©rÃ© le ${new Date().toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`;
  if (startDate && endDate) {
    dateText += ` | PÃ©riode : du ${new Date(startDate).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')} au ${new Date(endDate).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}`;
  }
  doc.text(dateText, 105, 142, { align: 'center' });
  doc.text(`${seals.length} Å“uvre(s) certifiÃ©e(s)`, 105, 150, { align: 'center' });

  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.text(`VÃ©rification : ${APP_URL}/o/[id]`, 105, 162, { align: 'center' });

  doc.addPage();
  let y = 20;

  seals.forEach((seal) => {
    if (y > 230) {
      doc.addPage();
      y = 20;
    }

    doc.setDrawColor(239, 224, 202);
    doc.setLineWidth(0.5);
    doc.rect(15, y, 180, 65);

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
    doc.setFontSize(13);
    doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
    doc.text(seal.title || 'Sans titre', 20, y + 10);

    doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
    doc.setFontSize(9);
    doc.setTextColor(122, 90, 58);
    const dateStr = new Date(seal.timestamp).toLocaleString('fr-FR');
    doc.text(`ScellÃ© le : ${dateStr}`, 20, y + 18);

    if (seal.description) {
      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'italic');
      const splitDesc = doc.splitTextToSize(`"${seal.description}"`, 170);
      doc.text(splitDesc.slice(0, 2), 20, y + 26);
    }

    if (seal.has_ots_proof || seal.ots_proof) {
      doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
      doc.setFontSize(8);
      doc.setTextColor(93, 122, 58);
      doc.text('âœ“ AncrÃ© via OpenTimestamps (Bitcoin)', 20, y + 42);
    }

    doc.setTextColor(74, 144, 194);
    doc.setFontSize(8);
    doc.textWithLink('[ VÃ©rifier en ligne ]', 20, y + 52, { url: `${APP_URL}/o/${seal.id}` });

    if (seal.is_hosted && seal.file_path) {
      doc.textWithLink('[ Ouvrir le fichier original ]', 110, y + 52, { url: seal.file_path });
    }

    y += 75;
  });

  if (!isPro) {
    const pageCount = doc.getNumberOfPages();
    for (let i = 1; i <= pageCount; i++) {
      doc.setPage(i);
      doc.setFontSize(50);
      doc.setTextColor(220, 200, 180);
      doc.text('SCEAU FREE', 40, 150, { angle: 45 });
    }
  }

  doc.save(`Portfolio-${author}.pdf`);
}

export function generateProjectCertificate(title: string, author: string, merkleRoot: string, files: any[], date: string) {
  const doc = new jsPDF({ orientation: 'portrait', unit: 'mm', format: 'a4' });
  
  // Fond
  doc.setFillColor(253, 248, 240);
  doc.rect(0, 0, 210, 297, 'F');
  
  // Cadre
  doc.setDrawColor(232, 120, 60);
  doc.setLineWidth(2);
  doc.rect(10, 10, 190, 277);

  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(24);
  doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
  doc.text("CERTIFICAT D'INTÃ‰GRITÃ‰", 105, 30, { align: 'center' });
  
  doc.setFontSize(12);
  doc.setTextColor(122, 90, 58);
  doc.text("Dossier Miroir (Arbre de Merkle)", 105, 40, { align: 'center' });

  doc.setFontSize(14);
  doc.setTextColor(44, 24, 16);
  doc.text(`Projet : ${title}`, 20, 55);
  doc.text(`CrÃ©ateur : @${author}`, 20, 63);
  doc.text(`Date de scellement : ${new Date(date).toLocaleString('fr-FR')}`, 20, 71);

  doc.setFont('courier', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(9);
  doc.text("EMPREINTE RACINE (MERKLE ROOT) :", 20, 85);
  
  const chunks = merkleRoot.match(/.{1,50}/g) || [merkleRoot];
  doc.setFont('courier', 'normal');
  chunks.forEach((chunk, i) => {
    doc.text(chunk, 20, 91 + i * 5);
  });

  // Liste des fichiers
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'bold');
  doc.setFontSize(10);
  doc.text("FICHIERS INCLUS :", 20, 115);
  
  doc.setFont('helvetica', 'normal');
  doc.setFontSize(8);
  let y = 122;
  files.slice(0, 30).forEach((f) => {
    if (y > 270) return; // Limite de page
    doc.text(`- ${f.file_name}`, 20, y);
    doc.text(`  Hash: ${f.file_hash.slice(0, 20)}...`, 25, y + 4);
    y += 10;
  });

  if (files.length > 30) {
    doc.text(`... et ${files.length - 30} autres fichiers.`, 20, y + 5);
  }

  doc.save(`Projet-${title.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '-')}.pdf`);
}

import { S3Client } from '@aws-sdk/client-s3';
import { requireS3 } from '@/lib/env';

let _client: S3Client | null = null;

function create(): S3Client {
  const { endpoint, region } = requireS3();
  const accessKeyId = (process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID || '').trim();
  const secretAccessKey = (process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY || '').trim();
  if (!accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('ClÃ©s S3 manquantes : AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY');
  }
  return new S3Client({
    region,
    endpoint,
    credentials: { accessKeyId, secretAccessKey },
    forcePathStyle: true,
    requestChecksumCalculation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
    responseChecksumValidation: 'WHEN_REQUIRED',
  });
}

export function getR2Client(): S3Client {
  if (!_client) _client = create();
  return _client;
}

export const r2Client = new Proxy({} as S3Client, {
  get(_t, prop) {
    const real = getR2Client() as any;
    const v = real[prop];
    return typeof v === 'function' ? v.bind(real) : v;
  },
});

FICHIER : ./src/lib/safe-key.ts

export function safeKeyPart(input: string, maxLen = 80): string {
  if (!input) return 'file';
  const ascii = input.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '');
  const cleaned = ascii.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g, '-');
  const safe = cleaned.replace(/^\.+/, '').replace(/\.{2,}/g, '.').replace(/-+/g, '-');
  return (safe || 'file').slice(0, maxLen);
}

export function buildS3Key(opts: {
  authorId: string; hashBase64: string; originalName: string; prefix?: string;
}): string {
  const prefix = opts.prefix || 'seal';
  const authorShort = opts.authorId.replace(/-/g, '').slice(0, 8);
  const hashShort = opts.hashBase64.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 16);
  const safeName = safeKeyPart(opts.originalName, 80);
  return `${prefix}/${authorShort}/${hashShort}-${safeName}`;
}

export function extractS3Key(filePath: string): string | null {
  const endpoint = (process.env.AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_S3 || '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const bucket = (process.env.S3_BUCKET || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, '');
  const prefix = `${endpoint}/${bucket}/`;
  if (filePath.startsWith(prefix)) return filePath.slice(prefix.length);
  return filePath.split('/').pop() || null;
}

import { sha256 } from '@noble/hashes/sha256';

const CALENDARS = [
  'https://alice.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://bob.btc.calendar.opentimestamps.org',
  'https://finney.calendar.eternitywall.com',
];

/**
 * Calcule l'empreinte SHA-256 d'un fichier (Buffer ou Uint8Array).
 */
export function hashDocument(content: Uint8Array): string {
  const hash = sha256(content);
  return Buffer.from(hash).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * Ancre un hash sur la blockchain Bitcoin via OpenTimestamps.
 * Retourne la preuve .ots en base64, prÃªte Ã  Ãªtre stockÃ©e.
 */
export async function anchorToBitcoin(hashHex: string): Promise<{ otsProof: string | null, calendars: string[] }> {
  const hashBytes = Buffer.from(hashHex, 'hex');
  const successes: string[] = [];
  let proof: Buffer | undefined;

  for (const url of CALENDARS) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${url}/digest`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/octet-stream' },
        body: hashBytes,
      });
      if (!res.ok) continue;

      const buf = Buffer.from(await res.arrayBuffer());
      const magic = Buffer.from([0x00,0x4f,0x70,0x65,0x6e,0x54,0x69,0x6d,0x65,0x73,0x74,0x61,0x6d,0x70,0x73,0x00,0x00,0x50,0x72,0x6f,0x6f,0x66,0x00]);
      
      if (!buf.subarray(0, magic.length).equals(magic)) continue;

      successes.push(url);
      if (!proof) proof = buf;
    } catch (e) {
      // Calendar indisponible, on tente le suivant
    }
  }

  return {
    otsProof: proof ? proof.toString('base64') : null,
    calendars: successes
  };
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
GREEN='\0;32m'; NC='\033[0m'
say() { echo -e "${GREEN}â–¶ $1${NC}"; }

# ==========================================================
# 1. LE PATCH DE CLAUDE (SÃ©curitÃ© Profil PropriÃ©taire vs Public)
# ==========================================================
say "1/6 â†’ Application du patch de Claude (API Profil)"

cat > "src/app/api/profil/route.ts" << 'EOF'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { pool } from '@/db/pool';

export async function GET(req: Request) {
  const { searchParams } = new URL(req.url);
  const handle = searchParams.get('handle')?.trim();
  const pubkey = searchParams.get('pubkey')?.trim();

  if (!handle && !pubkey) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Pseudo ou clÃ© manquant' }, { status: 400 });
  }

  try {
    let isOwner = false;
    let user;
    
    if (pubkey) {
      user = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE encode(pubkey, 'base64') = $1 LIMIT 1",
        [pubkey]
      );
      isOwner = user.rows.length > 0;
    } else {
      user = await pool.query(
        "SELECT id, handle, bio, role, is_pro, open_to_collaboration, first_name, last_name, birth_date FROM users WHERE LOWER(handle) = LOWER($1) LIMIT 1",
        [handle]
      );
    }
    
    if (user.rows.length === 0) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Inconnu' }, { status: 404 });
    
    const userId = user.rows[0].id;
    const isPro = user.rows[0].is_pro || false;

    let totalSealed = 0, totalHosted = 0, totalSize = 0;
    try {
      const stats = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(id) as total_sealed, SUM(CASE WHEN is_hosted = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as total_hosted, SUM(file_size) as total_size FROM seals WHERE author_id = $1`, [userId]);
      totalSealed = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_sealed || 0);
      totalHosted = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_hosted || 0);
      totalSize = parseInt(stats.rows[0].total_size || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Stats error:', e.message); }

    let seals = [];
    try {
      const sealsQuery = await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.timestamp, s.visibility, s.is_flash, s.is_hosted, s.file_path, s.category, encode(s.hash, 'base64') as hash,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM likes WHERE seal_id = s.id) as likes_count,
        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE seal_id = s.id) as comments_count
        FROM seals s WHERE s.author_id = $1 ${isOwner ? '' : "AND s.visibility = 'public'"} ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      seals = sealsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Seals error:', e.message); }

    let totalPacts = 0;
    try {
      const pacts = await pool.query("SELECT COUNT(*) as total_pacts FROM pact_signatures WHERE user_id = $1", [userId]);
      totalPacts = parseInt(pacts.rows[0].total_pacts || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Pacts error:', e.message); }

    let friendsCount = 0;
    try {
      const friendsRes = await pool.query(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM friendships WHERE (requester_id = $1 OR addressee_id = $1) AND status = 'accepted'`, [userId]);
      friendsCount = parseInt(friendsRes.rows[0].count || 0);
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Friends error:', e.message); }

    let projects = [];
    try {
      const projectsQuery = !isOwner ? { rows: [] } : await pool.query(`
        SELECT p.id, p.title, p.description, p.merkle_root, p.created_at, p.ots_proof,
               (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_files WHERE project_id = p.id) as files_count
        FROM projects p WHERE p.author_id = $1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      projects = projectsQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Projects error:', e.message); }

    let favorites = [];
    try {
      const favoritesQuery = !isOwner ? { rows: [] } : await pool.query(`
        SELECT s.id, s.title, s.category, s.timestamp, u.handle as author
        FROM favorites f JOIN seals s ON f.seal_id = s.id JOIN users u ON s.author_id = u.id
        WHERE f.user_id = $1 ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
      `, [userId]);
      favorites = favoritesQuery.rows;
    } catch (e: any) { console.warn('Favorites error:', e.message); }

    let streak = 0;
    try {
      const uniqueDatesSet = new Set(seals.map((s: any) => new Date(s.timestamp).toISOString().split('T')[0]));
      let cursor = new Date();
      cursor.setUTCHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
      if (!uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1);
      while (uniqueDatesSet.has(cursor.toISOString().split('T')[0])) { streak++; cursor.setDate(cursor.getDate() - 1); }
    } catch (e) {}

    const badges = [];
    if (totalSealed >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸŒ±', name: 'Apprenti', desc: 'PremiÃ¨re Å“uvre scellÃ©e' });
    if (totalSealed >= 10) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‰', name: 'Archiviste', desc: '10 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (totalSealed >= 50) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¥‡', name: 'Gardien', desc: '50 Å“uvres scellÃ©es' });
    if (isPro) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ‘‘', name: 'PRO', desc: 'Compte vÃ©rifiÃ© PRO' });
    if (streak >= 3) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ”¥', name: 'En Feu', desc: '3 jours consÃ©cutifs' });
    if (totalPacts >= 1) badges.push({ icon: 'ğŸ¤', name: 'NÃ©gociateur', desc: 'A signÃ© un pacte' });

    return NextResponse.json({
      handle: user.rows[0].handle, bio: user.rows[0].bio,
      open_to_collaboration: user.rows[0].open_to_collaboration || false,
      first_name: isOwner ? user.rows[0].first_name : null, 
      last_name: isOwner ? user.rows[0].last_name : null, 
      birth_date: isOwner ? user.rows[0].birth_date : null,
      role: user.rows[0].role, is_pro: isPro, streak: streak, favorites: favorites,
      sealed: totalSealed, hosted: totalHosted, used_bytes: totalSize,
      friends_count: friendsCount, pacts: totalPacts, badges: badges, seals: seals, projects: projects
    });
  } catch (error: any) { 
    console.error("[api/profil]", error);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Erreur serveur' }, { status: 500 }); 
  }
}
EOF

import sys

s = open(p, encoding='utf-8').read()

old_fetch = """      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle.trim())}`,
        { cache: 'no-store' }
      );"""

new_fetch = """      const pubkey = localStorage.getItem('sceau_pubkey');
      const res = await fetch(
        `/api/profil?handle=${encodeURIComponent(handle.trim())}${pubkey ? `&pubkey=${encodeURIComponent(pubkey)}` : ''}`,
        { cache: 'no-store' }
      );"""

if old_fetch in s:
    s = s.replace(old_fetch, new_fetch)
    open(p, 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(s)
    print('  âœ“ Page Profil mise Ã  jour (envoie la Pubkey)')
